name: Adam Strach
body_html:
Adam started his career at the Big 4 after graduating from James Madison University. Needing a change, he founded Pipaya Partners in 2009 which was acquired by Prosperity Partners in 2025, where he now co-leads Prosperity’s Transaction Services division. Over the course of his career, Adam has advised on over 200 M&A transactions with a focus on firms whose end customer is the US Government.

EXPERTISE: Quality of Earnings

  • Favorite thing about my job: Making M&A easier for founders, owners, and operators.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Skiing
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Forest bathing
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: A Viking Yurt dinner party in Park City, Utah!

name: Adam Vanderwiel
body_html:
Adam graduated from The University of Iowa in May of 2017 with a bachelor’s in accounting and finance and earned his CPA in 2018. Adam worked in public accounting in Iowa for 4 years specializing in real estate, construction and agriculture. In September of 2020 Adam joined Prosperity Partners as an associate before being promoted to Tax Manager.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax, Tax Compliance and Tax Planning, Employee Stock Option Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: My favorite thing about Prosperity Partners is the people that I work with. Prosperity Partners has a great team environment that makes work enjoyable, while developing professionally at the highest levels.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Collecting, flipping and selling Trading cards
  • Favorite movie quote: “Life a garden, Dig it” – Joe Dirt
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: South Korea
  • Irrational fear: I have an irrational fear of my braces falling off (that I haven’t had for 15 years)
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Wits and Wagers

name: Aesha Patel
body_html:
Aesha Patel graduated from Gujarat University, India with a master’s degree in accounting. After beginning her career in 2019 working with a CPA Firm in Houston & San Antonio, she joined the firm in 2024. As a Senior Accounting Associate, she strives to support our team and help in all the accounting aspects of the work. In her spare time, Aesha loves spending time with her kids.

EXPERTISE: Business & Personal Finance Accounting

  • Favorite thing about my Job: The culture. Everyone is very helpful, supportive & easy to work with. It’s a very comfortable & appreciative work environment. The firm truly cares about employees professional growth.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? There are many, but Paneer Tikka Masala Curry is the best I can cook.
  • Favorite vacation you.ve taken: New York is my favorite place I visited so far. I enjoyed so much when we visited Times Square, The Statue of Liberty, & the Brooklyn Bridge. I loved the view of the whole city from top of the twin towers.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Monopoly. I Llve how we run to buy the different businesses.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Having a peaceful dinner with some music with family at a rooftop restaurant.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I like to do yoga & cardio and my favorite sport is to play badminton.

name: Akshaya Kumar Moharana
body_html:
Akshaya Moharana received a Master of Business Administration from Biju Patnaik University of Technology in Rourkela, Odisha in 2007. In February 2025, Akshaya joined Prosperity Partners. Prior to this, he worked at Thomson Reuters where he focused on reviewing individual tax returns. During his tenure at Thomson Reuters, Akshaya also spent time in Irvine, California supporting the team during both the busy and extension seasons. Additionally, he contributed to the development of the lead sheet in SP Binder, enhancing workflow efficiency.

EXPERTISE: Individual Tax Returns (Expat, Inpat, and Domestic)

  • Favorite thing about my job? I enjoy working hard and finding strategies that help my clients’ tax liabilities. It’s incredibly rewarding to apply my expertise in ways that make a meaningful impact—helping clients navigate complex tax situations and achieve greater financial success.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: One of my most memorable vacations was a week spent with my wife at the VGP Golden Beach Resort in Chennai, India. The breathtaking scenery, combined with the luxurious and relaxing atmosphere, made it an unforgettable experience for both of us.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I love preparing delicious snack items and especially enjoy cooking non-vegetarian dishes for Sunday lunch with my family. It’s a great way to spend quality time together and share a home-cooked meal.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: One of the most memorable concerts I attended was Pritam, Shreya Ghosal, and Kumar Sanu. The energy, live music, and atmosphere were unforgettable. It was an amazing experience to see such talent live and be part of a crowd that shared the same excitement!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Cricket and Badminton

name: Alexander Brunek
body_html:
Alex joined Prosperity Partners in January 2025 out of their Santa Barbara Office, bringing his extensive experience in tax compliance, planning, and consulting across both the U.S. and Germany. A native of Germany, he holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics and Law, specializing in German Tax Law, from Westfälische Wilhelms-Universität in Münster. Alex takes great pride in delivering tailored client support, guiding his clients through the complexities of ever-changing tax laws and regulations while helping them capitalize on opportunities to achieve their financial goals and objectives. When he’s not in the office, Alex enjoys exploring scenic trails around the Santa Barbara Tri-County with his two dogs, catching waves while surfing, and spending quality time with his family.

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance, General Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: Making peoples’ lives easier, allowing them the freedom to focus on what they do best!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Bayerisches Rahmgulasch (a creamy Bavarian beef stew). It’s a traditional German dish featuring melt-in-your-mouth tender meat cooked in a rich and creamy sauce, with a hint of tangy lemon.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Any trip to Italy.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Hitting the gym, shooting hoops, and hiking local trails.

name: Alexi Smith
body_html:
Alexi Smith graduated from Florida Atlantic University with a major in sociology. After working as an office administrator in West Palm Beach for two years, she relocated to Chicago and joined the firm in 2024. As a tax administrator, Alexi strives to provide exceptional service to our clients and is excited to expand her career. In her spare time, Alexi is a cityscape artist and takes inspiration from urban skylines around the world.

EXPERTISE: Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: The team at Prosperity Partners is very supportive of one another. We take care of each other so we can take care of our clients.
  • The best dish that I can cook: I make a tasty meal that I like to call “taco lasagna”. It’s basically a giant enchilada layered up lasagna-style, with a healthy amount of cheese baked in between the layers.
  • Favorite vacation I’ve taken: A road trip from Florida to St. Louis with my dad. I got lost in the tunnels at the city’s Children’s Museum and I would love to do it again.
  • My side passion: Drawing abstract cityscapes. I enjoy finding new ways to view and depict famous skylines.
  • Favorite way to celebrate my birthday: Sitting on the couch while eating mac & cheese

name: Alok Birla
body_html:
Alok Birla has been a veteran in the Tax Automation industry in the USA for over 20+ years. Before joining Prosperity Partners in August 2024, he held multiple senior positions in SurePrep, Part of Thomson Reuters over these 20+ years. As a Client Success Manager, he managed many of the Top 25 firms in the country for all their needs relating to SurePrep products like 1040SCAN, SPbinder, Leadsheets, TaxCaddy, Dashboard, APIs, etc. Alok Birla was the lead trainer on all the products, helping conduct web-based and onsite trainings for clients he was managing and for his team. Alok has presented advanced topics at SurePrep Transform and TR Synergy conferences. Alok Birla managed the Outsource service departments for 10+ years providing exceptional service to SurePrep customers.

Alok Birla possesses a keen knowledge of implementing best practices, identifying problems in current processes, working towards solutions to fix the problems and making firms and their multiple offices on a standardized-process journey.

Alok Birla is a Lean Six Sigma – Green belt professional and a Chartered Accountant from India.

  • Favorite thing about my job: I chose to make a career change, and it could not have been at a better organization than Prosperity Partners. It’s all about “We the People” at Prosperity. The highest value is given to both clients and internal employees. The focus on well-being, growth, freedom to choose, and reasonable time to deliver are some important factors I like about this job.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Indian Masala Chai
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A 3-day road trip to Niagara Falls with my parents, wife, and son. The Toronto Sunset point on Lake Ontario was simply golden.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? “Let’s find who I am”
  • Favorite movie quote: “Ye hath mujhe dede thakur”
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Hulk. I would share the spiciest Indian food and see if he remains green or turns ‘RED’!
  • What would your last meal be? Anything my wife decides to cook before letting me go….

name: Alyvia Clark
body_html:
aclark@prosperityllc.com

Alyvia Clark joined Prosperity Partners in the summer of 2014 as an intern and in her tenure with the firm has gained valuable experience in a wide variety of financial accounting and tax related areas. As she has matured in her career, Alyvia now leads the Family Office Services practice at Prosperity Partners and focuses primarily on high net worth individuals and accounting matters within the firm. Alyvia prides herself on being a well-rounded advisor who earns the trust of her clients by building meaningful relationships and being a reliable, informed consultant.

Alyvia graduated from Loyola University Chicago with a bachelor’s degree in accounting and a minor in marketing. She continued her academic career at Loyola earning her Master’s in Business Administration in 2016. In addition to her education, Alyvia acted as a graduate assistant coach for the cross country and track & field teams at Loyola, where she competed as an undergraduate.

In her free time, Alyvia enjoys running through the neighborhoods of Chicago, tackling jigsaw puzzles, hiking in the American west, and traveling to new places.

EXPERTISE: Personal financial accounting, Small business accounting, Tax.

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Variety. Variety of work and variety of people. Both of which I truly enjoy.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I went out west and hiked four of the National Parks (Zion, Grand Canyon, Bryce Canyon and Joshua Tree), stayed in Vegas but also slept in a van. It was a wonderful combination of isolation, sweat, relaxation and luxury.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Man I Feel Like A Woman – Shania Twain
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Workout = Running, Sport to play = Volleyball

name: Amisha Margaj
body_html:
Amisha is a dedicated tax professional with over three years of experience in U.S. individual taxation, holding a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and Finance. Amisha started her career in US taxation at Datamatics Global Solutions as a Process Associate preparing Individual tax returns. She then earned a Senior Associate title at Sureprep (part of Thomson Reuters) where she gained hands on experience preparing and reviewing Individual (Form 1040) and Estate & Trust Taxes (Form 1041). Prior to joining Prosperity, Amisha gained valuable experience at Vistra International Expansion Ltd where she handled Individual and International tax returns.

Expertise: Individual, Estate and Trust, International and Foreign Tax Returns, E-filings

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite thing about my job is solving complex tax scenarios and ensuring accuracy in every return. It feels rewarding to bring clarity to complicated data.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? The best dish I can cook is chicken, especially chicken curry!
    Favorite vacation you’ve taken? My favorite vacation was a trip to Manali, where I enjoyed the peaceful mountain surroundings, cool climate, and scenic views. The natural beauty, snowcapped mountains, and relaxed atmosphere made it a refreshing and memorable experience.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is near the beach enjoying the calming sound of the waves, fresh sea breeze, and a relaxed atmosphere that makes the day feel peaceful and special.
  • What would your last meal be? My last meal would include chicken and fish, prepared in a simple yet flavourful way, offering comfort, satisfaction, and a sense of completeness.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: My favorite sport to play is badminton, as it is an enjoyable way to stay active while improving agility and coordination.

name: Amita Jasoliya
body_html:
Amita Jasoliya is a finance professional with deep expertise in revenue management, sales and revenue forecasting, and client reporting. Before joining Prosperity Partners in July 2025, she worked with top revenue-generating client accounts analysing performance and delivering strategic insights to leadership. She spent a significant part of her career at Sure Prep, part of Thomson Reuters, where she worked closely with finance, sales, and development teams to improve accuracy and support data-driven decision making. She holds an MBA and is known for her ability to translate numbers into meaningful narratives, contributing to informed and effective business strategies. Outside of work, Amita enjoys being in nature, whether it’s a walk through natural surroundings or simply noticing seasonal changes. These quiet moments help her stay grounded and refreshed.

EXPERTISE: Revenue Management, Sales and Revenue Forecasting, Client Management

  • Favorite thing about my job? The people! Prosperity has such a welcoming and collaborative environment.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Mauritius. From the tropical scenery of Chamarel to the crystal-clear beaches and a boat ride to Île aux Cerf’s, it was unforgettable.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Hulk — he’s my son’s favorite and I’d love to join them both at the table!
  • What is the best disk you can cook? Almost all Indian dishes. I love experimenting in the kitchen!
    Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Getting lots of gifts from friends and family — it never gets old.
  • What would your last meal be? Pizza loaded with extra cheese, of course!

name: Amjad Ali
body_html:
Amjad Ali graduated from Houston Christian University with a master’s degree in international business; Amjad also graduated from City University Peshawar, Pakistan with a master’s degree in Business Administration. After moving to the US in 2013, Amjad began his career as accountant in a Houston based local CPA Firm. Working with various firms, including one of the Big Four, he joined Prosperity Partners in 2024. In his spare time, Amjad loves to study, hike, swim, and play on his Play Station.

EXPERTISE: Tax Preparation and Review, IT, Network, Software, Hardware Diagnosis and Troubleshooting, Research of Laws and Regulations

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love to work with numbers and financials. The ultimate happiness for me is when all balances tie out.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Beef Chapli Kabab
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Trip to Argentina and Chile
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I want to learn how to sketch and paint.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Hasta La Vista, Baby”
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Take Me Home, Country Roads
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Swimming, cycling, working out at the gym.

name: Andres Zimmermann
body_html:
Andres Zimmermann graduated from Georgetown University with a double major in Government and Economics. He began his career in mergers and acquisitions as an Analyst in September 2024. He is passionate about delivering exceptional service for clients, making complex processes feel seamless and accessible. Andres is committed to continuous learning and brings curiosity and drive to every challenge he takes on. Outside of work, he enjoys hiking, running, and exploring museums.

EXPERTISE: Client Service, Detail-Oriented Analysis, Transaction Support

  • Favorite thing about my job: Solving a challenging problem!
  • Desert Island Book: Dune by Frank Herbert
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Backpacking in the Patagonia region of Argentina
  • Best dish I can cook: Steak frites
  • What would your last meal be? Sushi

name: Andrew Blusiewicz
body_html:
Andrew Blusiewicz graduated from Boston College in 2025 with a double major in Finance and Accounting for Finance and Consulting. Andrew started his career as an intern with Prosperity Partners Transaction Advisory Group, then returned full-time in 2025. As an Analyst, he assists the team by using the accounting and financial analysis skills he acquired through his internship. Andrew was a part of Boston College’s Varsity swim team and continues to stay involved with his community’s swim program.

EXPERTISE: Financial Analysis

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people! As a new team member, it is amazing to learn from such helpful and knowledgeable coworkers.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was when I traveled around Central Europe with my friends!
  • What is your go-to Karaoke song? Separate Ways by Journey
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Ramen, with Kraft Mac and Cheese not far behind.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Zedd, but Big Time Rush gives him a run for his money!

name: Andy Yan
body_html:
Andy joined Farkouh, Furman & Faccio in 1998 as a Staff Accountant and has spent his entire professional career with the firm, including the recent transition to Prosperity Partners. Andy currently serves as a Partner, and though he primarily services individuals, closely held businesses, and corporations, he has experience with tax compliance for nearly every entity type.

Initially deciding to pursue accounting due to his aptitude for numbers, Andy most enjoys his field because it offers him an opportunity to help his clients identify meaningful solutions for their tax and financial challenges. Accrediting his success to dedication and caring tremendously about each of his clients, his motivation stems from a desire to not only provide his clients with timely knowledge and expertise, but to create lasting relationships with each of them.

Raised in Queens, Andy currently lives in Flushing, NY, with his wife and two sons. His favorite thing about living in New York City is its fast pace and abundance of good food. In addition to spending time with his family, Andy enjoys watching sports, anime, and reading Sci-Fi in his spare time.

Memberships:

  • American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
  • New York State Society of CPAs (NYSSCPA)

name: Anish Paradkar
body_html:
Anish Paradkar is a Finance Executive with a well-rounded background in accounting and financial operations. In his previous role, he was responsible for preparing detailed sales and management reports, as well as managing sales tax compliance. Anish also brings experience supporting both internal teams and external clients, contributing to operational efficiency through reliable communication and timely execution of finance tasks. His practical, hands-on approach makes him a dependable team member.

EXPERTISE: Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable (AR/AP), Sales and AR Reporting

  • I have an irrational fear of: Heights.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My trip to Rajasthan with my wife in December 2020 was unforgettable. The majestic forts, desert safari, and warm hospitality made it truly special. I’d love to visit again!
  • Dream concert? I’ve been a lifelong Linkin Park fan and attending one of their concerts is still high on my bucket list.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Table Tennis — fast-paced, fun, and a great way to stay active!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Watching shows/movies on Netflix and playing chess online.

name: Ankita Lad
body_html:
Ankita received her Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from Mumbai University in 2020. She began her tax career in 2021 and has gained over three years of hands-on experience in U.S. tax preparation. Prior to joining VGSL (part of Prosperity), she worked full-time as a Process Associate at Thomson Reuters, where she was working for their client CBIZ. Previously, she also held a role as a Tax Associate at Datamatics Global Services Ltd. Throughout her career, she’s been involved in preparing and directly submitting individual (Form 1040) and business tax returns (Forms 1065, 1120S, and 1120C) for clients.

  • Favorite thing about my job: What I enjoy most about working here as a tax preparer is the blend of analytical thinking and constant learning. Every return presents a unique scenario, which challenges me to apply tax laws accurately while staying up to date with evolving regulations.
  • Desert Island Book: If I were stranded on a desert island, I’d take “Agnipankh” by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam. It’s an inspiring read that reflects on resilience, purpose, and dedication. The book’s message about overcoming challenges and staying grounded in values would be a strong source of motivation and hope in any situation.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: One of my favorite work outings was a team-building event where we had a mix of fun activities, great food, and the chance to connect with colleagues outside the usual work setting. It was refreshing to step away from the day-to-day routine and bond with the team in a more relaxed environment.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was a trip to Mahabaleshwar, where I got the perfect mix of relaxation, exploration, and quality time with loved ones.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? The best dish I can cook is Puranpoli—a traditional Maharashtrian sweet. Preparing it connects me to my roots and brings a sense of comfort and celebration.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Dream big, but be prepared to work for them!” This quote inspires me to stay ambitious while reminding me that dedication and effort are key to turning dreams into reality.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Outside of work, I enjoy dancing & nature photography.

name: Ann Simon
body_html:
Ann Simon is from Santa Barbara, California and has previously held the roll of administrative and executive assistant in both the hospitality and accounting industry both in Santa Barbara and Maui, Hawaii. Ann has been the administrative assistant with the Santa Barbara office since 2021. She supports all management and fellow associates as well as clients. In her spare time, Ann enjoys spending time at the beach with her husband and doggie.

EXPERTISE: Administration, Client Services, Event Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: working in a beautiful office with a great group of people
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The Magic Castle in Hollywood, CA
  • Desert island book: “The Dragon Lance Chronicles”
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Shrimp Scampi
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Vacationed and lived on Maui and camping along the California Coast from Santa Barbara to Oregon
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Doggie, Hubbie, Beach
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? Live, Love, Laugh
  • Favorite movie quote: “Cartagena? Angel, you are hell and gone from Cartagena”
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Clue (favorite as a kid)
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: nice dinner and drinks out with friends
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Steve Miller in Maui and Tom Petty in Santa Barbara

name: Annie Cook
body_html:
Annie Cook began her professional journey as a public-school educator, investing over a decade in shaping young minds. Transitioning from the classroom to the world of tax administration, she found her niche at Prosperity Partners, where she plays a pivotal role in the office administration team while also serving as a tax administrator. With a solid educational background, Annie earned her undergraduate degree from Kansas State University and completed her graduate studies at Fort Hays State University in 2019. Based in the Kansas City office, Annie brings her expertise and passion to her work every day. In her spare time Annie enjoys gardening, reading, and spending as much time outside as she can with her family.

EXPERTISE: Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people! The company is growing fast, and comprised of many individuals with diverse backgrounds & interests. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. Although our offices are spread across the United States, we work cohesively and truly get to know each other on a personal basis.
  • Favorite outing you’ve been on: Pinstripes Bowling was my first outing with Prosperity Partners. I enjoyed it because I got to meet so many people from the Chicago office that I hadn’t before!
  • Desert island book: The ACOTAR series. I’ve never been a big fan of fantasy, but this series had me hooked from start to finish! I’ve never finished a book and wished so instantly to relive it as if for the first time.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Sun dried tomato and chicken gnocchi
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Softball

name: Beth Dezon-Gaillard
body_html:
Beth graduated from the University of Vermont as Valedictorian with a BS in Business Administration and Professional Accounting. She joins Prosperity with over 15 years of experience in public accounting and enjoys working closely with clients to help them understand their taxes. Outside of work, she enjoys reading, cooking, and spending time with her family.

EXPERTISE: Tax Planning and Compliance for Businesses, Individuals, and Private Foundations

  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Camping with my family in Joshua Tree National Park.
  • Desert Island Book: The Overstory by Richard Powers.
  • What is your side passion project/hobby? Gardening (vegetables and flowers)!
  • Favorite Workout: Cross Country Skiing

name: Bhadresh Shukal
body_html:
Bhadresh Shukal is a graduate of Mumbai University, where he specialized in Accounting and Taxation. He began his professional journey at an outsourcing firm focused on U.S. taxation, steadily building expertise in accounting and business tax returns. His career path led him to Thomson Reuters, where he held the role of Team Leader and Reviewer. In February 2025, Bhadresh joined Vignesh Global Services LLC, where he now focuses on preparing and reviewing both business and individual tax returns. With a strong command over partnership, corporation, and individual tax compliance, Bhadresh is committed to deepening his knowledge and enjoys working directly with Prosperity Partners to enhance his professional capabilities. Outside of work, Bhadresh cherishes vacation time with family and friends. One of his most memorable trips was a 14-day journey through North India, including visits to Kashmir, the Golden Temple, and Wagah Border.

  • Favorite thing about my job: I choose to make a career change to work directly with a CPA firm and have grown my knowledge!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Khichdi (a comforting Indian classic)
  • Favorite movie quote: “Mogambo khush hua!”
  • Favorite sport to play: Cricket and Kabaddi

name: Blake Foster
body_html:
Blake Foster graduated Cum Laude from Judson University in May of 2023 with a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, and Management. After interning with Prosperity Partners during the spring of 2023 he joined Prosperity Partners full time following graduation in May of 2023. As an accounting associate at Prosperity Partners he’s involved in a variety projects on the CAS side of the company. In his spare time Blake enjoys golfing and spending time with his friends and family.

EXPERTISE: Small business and personal finance accounting

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The opportunities that a firm of Prosperity Partners size offers to an associate new to the accounting field. The variety of unique projects encourages growth during the green stages of your career. Being a year into my career this has been my favorite thing about Prosperity Partners because of how beneficial the exposure has been.
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners Outing: Last summer the company rented a Tiki themed boat where we spent the afternoon enjoying Chicago style food on Lake Michigan. This was a unique experience I didn’t know was a possibility but was glad the admin team at Prosperity Partners did!
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Life moves pretty fast. If you don’t stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it” – “Ferris Bueller’s Day Off”
  • Desert Island Book: “The Book of Basketball” – a book by Bill Simmons that ranks the top NBA coaches, teams, and players. I’d spend my time on the island internally debating and disputing the rankings and coming up with my own theories and ideas.
  • Favorite Vacation: The honeymoon vacation with my wife is by far my favorite vacation.

name: Blake Rath
body_html:
Blake Rath is a Senior Tax Accountant with five years of tax experience gained at reputable public accounting firms. He holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, graduating Cum Laude from Shepherd University. Blake has general working knowledge of S‑corporations, Partnerships, and Individual taxation, along with foundational familiarity in the preparation of C‑corporation and Fiduciary returns. In his free time, he enjoys ballroom dancing and weightlifting.

EXPERTISE: Individual and S-Corporation Taxation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Educating individuals on presented financial information who may not have the aptitude to understand exactly what is being shown.
  • Favorite Song: Never Tear Us Apart by Bishop Briggs
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Ballroom dancing and weightlifting
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A cruise to the Bahamas for a 5-day dance competition!

name: Braden Harsy
body_html:
Braden Harsy graduated from Roosevelt University with a master’s in industrial and organizational psychology. He joined Prosperity Partners in 2022 after beginning his career in healthcare recruitment. As our Lead Recruiter, Braden focuses on the continued growth of our team by connecting with motivated and talented individuals. Braden spends his spare time attending concerts and music festivals with friends.

EXPERTISE: Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Project Management

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The collaborative and friendly culture. We are a passionate team that is always willing to help each other. We always go the extra mile for our coworkers and clients.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My 2019 trip to Rome, Venice, and Barcelona. It had unbelievable sights and amazing food!
  • Favorite movie quote: “We accept the love we think we deserve” – Perks of Being a Wallflower
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I have previously celebrated my birthday at Okeechobee Music Festival. Nothing beats being surrounded by friends and good music!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Electric Forest in Rothbury, Michigan. This festival had amazing energy and artists!

name: Brandon Ginsberg
body_html:
Brandon graduated from THE Ohio State University in May of 2017 with a BBA in Accounting. Brandon joined FF&F (now Prosperity) less than 2 weeks after graduating as a Tax Intern and has been here ever since! He has progressed from an Intern to a Tax Supervisor working on a variety of large Corporate, Small Business, and Individual clients. Outside of work, Brandon loves watching and playing sports (more of the former these days), going to concerts, and hanging out with friends and family.

EXPERTISE: International Tax, Corporate Tax, High-Net-Worth Individual Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: Getting to be part of a team and working together to achieve a common goal. I’ve had the opportunity to work on all different types of returns and clients, and it makes it much easier to learn and get the job done when you have a great team around you.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? I Want You Back by NSYNC
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Nowadays, softball over the summer, but I played baseball competitively growing up.
  • What would your last meal be? Chicken Parm with a side of Mashed Potatoes (weird combo I know). Finishing it off with a Brownie Sundae!

name: Brandon Kagerbauer
body_html:
Brandon graduated from University of Wisconsin – Whitewater in 2017 with a BBA in Accounting and in 2018 with a Masters of Professional Accountancy. Brandon spent the first 4 years of his career in public accounting with Wipfli, leaving as a Senior Accountant in 2022. During his time at Wipfli, Brandon mainly worked in the Construction, Real Estate, and Financial Institution industries, as well as with High Net Worth Individuals. After his time at Wipfli, Brandon shifted his focus from public to industry, where he spent 2.5 years working on the tax planning team at Fiserv focusing on mergers, acquisitions, and how law changes impact entity tax positions. Outside of work, Brandon enjoys being active and exploring the outdoors. Brandon continues to play soccer and water ski during the summer months, and coaches downhill ski racing during the winters!

EXPERTISE: State and Local Tax Compliance, Consolidated Group Tax Compliance and Tax Planning

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Listening to clients – specifically understanding the issues that are giving them heartburn and figuring out ways that we can help them!
  • Favorite Vacation I’ve Taken: Hiking and Exploring Switzerland and Germany for 10 days.
  • What is your Side Gig/Passion Project/Hobby: Coaching Downhill Ski Racing during the winter and Home Improvement Projects throughout the year!
  • Favorite Way to Celebrate My Birthday: A day out on a lake with family and friends!
  • Favorite Concert I’ve Attended: Imaging Dragons at Summerfest in 2013!
  • Favorite Workout or Sport to play? I still play soccer at a high level during the spring and fall. In winter, I love to stay active by getting out on the slopes and going skiing!

name: Brett Shaw
body_html:
Brett Shaw earned his Bachelor’s Degree from the University of Iowa and completed additional accounting coursework through City Colleges of Chicago to meet the educational requirements for the CPA exam. He joined Prosperity Partners as an Accounting Intern in 2025 before transitioning to a full-time Accounting Associate in 2026. Brett primarily works with Family Office clients, helping manage bookkeeping operations, track investment performance, monitor expenses, and prepare client deliverable reports. He enjoys the variety of challenges that come with supporting clients’ financial goals, as well as collaborating with teammates to find solutions. Outside of work, Brett enjoys going to the movies, watching reality competition shows, and spending time with his dog, Kiwi.

EXPERTISE: Family Office Services, Financial Reporting, Account Reconciliation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: I enjoy working with a team that is always willing to collaborate and help one another. Being able to bounce ideas off colleagues, learn from their experience, and work together to solve problems makes the job both rewarding and engaging!
  • Desert Island Book: Our Share of Night by Mariana Enriquez. It’s haunting, immersive, and packed with extremely compelling characters.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Kesha at the Dubuque County Fair in 2016. I got to watch pig races before the show, secured a front-row spot, and even snapped a selfie with Kesha! Best. Day. Ever.
  • Favorite Workout or Sport to Play: Riding Divvy bikes along Chicago’s lakefront. It’s one of the best ways to get around the city while enjoying incredible views of the skyline and Lake Michigan.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: Honestly, the entirety of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie. If I had to choose, I’d probably end up quoting half the film before settling on just one line.

name: Brian Hill
body_html:
Brian began his career at Farkouh, Furman & Faccio, LLP—now Prosperity Partners—in 2015 and is currently based in the New York City office, where he serves as a Tax Manager. In this capacity, Brian offers comprehensive advisory and compliance support to closely held businesses, high-net-worth individuals, and trusts & estates. Outside of tax advisory and compliance, Brian is also adept at financial statement reporting & clean-up, with a particular focus on assisting small businesses. In his spare time, Brian enjoys traveling, discovering new dining experiences, and keeping up with his favorite New York sports teams!

EXPERTISE: Partnership Taxation, High-Net-Worth Individual Taxation, State & Local Tax, Financial Reporting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: My favorite thing about my job is our tight-knit team. Not only because they’re a fun group of people to work with, but they also have and continue to contribute to my career and personal growth. We have a great mix of highly skilled professionals that possess expertise in various areas of tax.
  • Favorite quote: “You know, Quasimodo predicted all this.” – The Sopranos
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Si No Te Hubieras Ido by Marco Antonio Solis
  • What would your last meal be? My last meal would be Buffalo wings, and of course blue cheese over ranch.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I’ve recently gotten back into bowling! As a child, I was an avid bowler but gave it up to focus on other sports.

name: Brittany Smith
body_html:
Brittany graduated from Texas State University with a bachelor’s degree in accounting in 2019 and obtained her master’s in accounting the following year. She went on to obtain her CPA designation shortly after. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners in 2024, Brittany worked for a Big Four accounting firm where she specialized in partnerships, private equity, and state & local tax compliance. In her spare time, Brittany enjoys knitting, trail running, and backpacking.

EXPERTISE: Tax Compliance and Consulting

  • What would your last meal be?:  An irresponsible amount of sushi
  • What is the best dish you can cook?:  Lasagna with homemade pasta
  • Favorite workout or sport to play?:  Running up big, rocky hills
  • Desert island book: Lord of the Rings trilogy
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended:  Insane Clown Posse at a little bar in Austin, TX. Hands down the most entertaining show I’ve been to.

name: Brock Lock
body_html:
Brock Lock graduated from Indiana University with a double major in finance and accounting. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, he worked for a consulting firm specializing in the R&D Tax Credit. Brock joined Prosperity Partners in September of 2023 as an associate and is focusing on tax compliance and preparation. He is currently pursuing his CPA certification.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite thing about Prosperity Partners is how willing and available everyone is with any question I have. It’s a very team-like culture where we are all working towards the same goal.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I am a self-proclaimed grill “master”, so any meats on the grill.
  • Favorite movie quote: “I’m a peacock, you gotta let me fly” – The Other Guys
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Typically my birthday falls on the first week of the NFL Playoffs, so when the Colts actually make it that the far the best way to celebrate is watching them hopefully win!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: By far the best concert I’ve been to is Kenny Chesney. He’s a great entertainer with even better music!

name: Bryan Limoge
body_html:
Bryan Limoge graduated from Saint Michael’s College with a double major in Business and Accounting and a minor in Finance. During his undergrad, he spent a summer working at the Florida Department of Law Enforcement in the Office of Financial Management. Upon his last semester, Bryan worked a spring busy season as a Tax Associate for Davis & Hodgdon Advisory Group. After graduation, he started working at Prosperity Partners fulltime as a Tax Associate in 2026. Outside of work, Bryan enjoys spending time with his family, friends, and his two dogs – whether it’s going on a hike, skiing in the winter, or trying new, local restaurants!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Trust, and Gift Tax Preparation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: My favorite thing about my job is the group of people I get to work with. Being surrounded by talented, supportive, and collaborative people makes difficult projects enjoyable. The teamwork here makes coming to work feel rewarding and creates an environment where I can learn and grow professionally.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Seeing Tame Impala at Barclays Center in Brooklyn on Halloween night. It was my first time in New York City as well!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Outside of work, you’ll usually find me staying active. My hobby is being active – biking, walking, hiking, skiing, weightlifting, and playing any sport. I like trying new activities and challenging myself physically. Staying active helps me maintain a healthy balance and brings out my competitive side!
  • I have an irrational fear of: Getting my picture taken.

name: Cameron Hair
body_html:
Cameron Hair supports clients through the M&A process, providing sell and buy-side financial due diligence and advisory services. Cameron graduated from George Mason University in 2022 with a double major in Finance and Business Management. Prior to Prosperity Partners, he was a Landscaping Manager helping his clients keep their lawns’ clean. In his spare time, you can find Cameron exercising, at the beach, or spending time with friends and family!

EXPERTISE: Sell and Buy-side Transaction Advisory, Quality of Earnings analysis

  • Favorite thing about my job: Figuring out complex problems and making the M&A process easy.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Exploring Iceland
  • Desert island book: Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance by Robert M. Pirsig
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Monopoly
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I enjoy powerlifting and generally seeing how far I can push myself in the gym.

name: Carlos Salgado
body_html:
Carlos Salgado, CPA, CVA is a manager at Prosperity Partners with a focus in business valuations and income taxes. Carlos began his career in 2016 as an accountant helping his clients with bookkeeping and tax related matters. Over the years Carlos began to specialize on working with closely held businesses and their related owners. By working closely with his clients on yearly accounting and income taxes, Carlos developed a strong financial background and financial statement analysis skills. Carlos is considered a trusted advisor by his clients, especially with items concerning income taxes and other financial matters. He works with mid-size enterprises focusing on flow-through taxation within a variety of industries, including manufacturing and distribution, professional services, real estate, and retail. He provides accounting and tax services, including compliance, tax planning, and management consulting. Carlos has published various advisory articles with topics including: income tax credits and cryptocurrency transactions.

Carlos works on business valuation engagements by valuing closely held businesses for tax and strategic business planning purposes. His valuation practice centers on the valuation of closely held businesses, their valuation of closely held equity and debt securities for transaction, litigation, business succession, restructuring, and transfer pricing purposes.

Carlos became a licensed CPA in 2019 and Certified Valuation Analyst in 2023. Carlos is active in a number of professional associations including the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; Illinois CPA Society; and the National Association of Certified Valuation Analysist.
During his free time, you can find Carlos exploring the zoo or museum with his son or playing video games with his with wife.

Formal and Professional Education

  • University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC): Bachelor of Science in Accounting | May 2017
  • University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC): Master of Science in Accounting | December 2017
  • American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) | Member
  • Illinois Certified Public Accountant Society (ICPAS) | Member
  • Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation | CPA
  • National Association of Certified Valuation Analysist (NACVA) | Member and CVA

EXPERTISE:  Individual & Business Tax Compliance, Business Valuations, Tax Planning, Flow-through Taxation

Favorite thing about my job: Contrary to popular belief, accounting is actually more of a people-oriented job. My favorite part of being a CPA/CVA is meeting different people with different backgrounds and learning from those experiences.

I have an irrational fear of large sea creatures. The thought a large predatory (i.e. a Megalodon) in the water where I cannot run or fight scares me.

Favorite workout or sport to play? Without a doubt boxing—I grew up boxing and even competed at the amateur level. Recently, I’ve been building up the home gym with boxing equipment and I hope to teach my son when he’s ready.

name: Cassidy Beshel
body_html:
Cassidy Beshel graduated with Distinction from University of Iowa receiving a BBA in Marketing, as well as an Event Management Certificate. Following graduation, she worked at a Staffing Agency on both the recruitment and training and development teams, but quickly knew she wanted to secure a position within the human resources field. Joining Prosperity in 2024, she currently serves as the firms HR Coordinator, offering recruiting, onboarding, and general employee support! In her spare time, you will find Cassidy walking along the Chicago lakefront, reading her newest fantasy book at a café, or cheering on the Hawkeyes at an Iowa bar.

EXPERTISE: Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: Getting to support my coworkers by building a healthy and fun work environment is incredibly rewarding! I have been lucky to receive immense support and guidance from everyone within the organization and I want to ensure all Prosperity employees feel that same level of continued support. An organization is only as strong as it’s people and it is my job to ensure we are hiring and retaining the best of the best!
  • Desert island book: The Unwind Series by Neal Shusterman. It’s a dystopian YA novel that I first read in Middle School, but I have reread the four books in the series several times since and the plot is just as gripping as an adult!
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Start of Something New from High School Musical (sung as a duet of course)
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Harry Styles Love on Tour
  • What would your last meal be? Honestly as many pints of Ben and Jerry’s ice cream that I can manage to stuff down before getting nauseous (favorite flavors include Half Baked, The Tonight Dough, Phish Food, and Strawberry Cheesecake)
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I have been playing Volleyball my entire life and was even on the Club Volleyball team at Iowa! One of my favorite parts of summer is getting to participate in Chicago Beach Leagues.

name: Catherine Lauber
body_html:
Catherine has been a dedicated professional in the accounting industry since graduating with a bachelor’s in economics and accounting from the University of California, Santa Barbara in 2012. Initially serving local businesses and individuals in the Santa Barbara, California area, she expanded her practice to include Missoula, Montana in 2021. With a strong background in bookkeeping prior to becoming a CPA, she brings a wealth of hands-on experience advising business owners on accounting matters.

Her passion for tax and financial analysis drives her to provide exceptional service to her clients, ensuring they make informed financial and tax-effective decisions year-round. Catherine works closely with investment advisors, business managers, and individuals, bringing teams together to make efficient and strategic tax planning decisions.

Catherine specializes in advising clients on the Real Estate Professional status, 1031 exchange tax deferral, and accelerated depreciation strategies. Her expertise in these areas enables clients to optimize tax benefits, differentiate between passive and nonpassive losses, and with designing tailored tax optimization plans.

Beyond her professional achievements, Catherine is an active community member, serving on the boards of three local nonprofits. When she’s not in the office, you can find Catherine rafting on the Clark Fork River, mountain biking trails across the United States, or throwing pottery on her ceramics wheel.

EXPERTISE: Flow-through Taxation, 1031 Exchange Transactions and Real Estate Professional Elections, Individual and Business Tax Compliance and Planning, and Strategic Tax Planning for Stock Options.

  • Favorite thing about my job: I am passionate about demystifying difficult tax concepts for individuals and business owners, allowing them to focus on what they do best while I handle the intricate details of tax strategy.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was a trip to Bali and Thailand. I loved snorkeling over shipwrecks, meeting the locals, and making lifelong friends. Scooter rides through the jungle were exhilarating, and the long-tail boat rides through the southern Thai islands were unforgettable. The people were so sweet and welcoming, which made the experience even more special.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Ceramics is a passion project of mine, and it all started when I took an intro class and got hooked. Who knew playing with mud could be so therapeutic? I fell in love with the challenge, the creative outlet, and the endless opportunities to get my hands dirty (literally) while creating something beautiful. Plus, there’s nothing quite like the satisfaction of turning a lump of clay into a piece of art—or at least a slightly lopsided mug. It’s my way of staying grounded and constantly learning.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I love celebrating my birthday by paintballing with friends. The adrenaline rush is exhilarating, and I’ve found out that I’m pretty talented at hiding behind hay bales and sneaking up on the other team. It’s always a fun and memorable way to spend the day.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My favorite concert experience was finding Daft Punk at the Trash Fence. The surreal desert setting, combined with their electrifying beats and mesmerizing light show, made it an unforgettable adventure.

name: Catherine Raker
body_html:
Catherine Raker graduated from The University of Massachusetts with a Bachelor of Science in Accounting. She then went on to receive her Master’s in Taxation from Walsh College, and was awarded the Everett M. Hawley Jr. Tax Award for academic achievement! Catherine has a background in international tax disclosures and currently serves as a Tax Manager for Prosperity. In her spare time, she enjoys helping others, volunteering in her community, and practicing yoga.

EXPERTISE: Disclosure of foreign bank accounts and foreign financial assets

  • Favorite thing about my job: Every day there is a new puzzle I get to solve.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I bake goodies and since I don’t like having treats at the house, my co-workers reap the benefits.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.” – Rick Blaine, Casablanca
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Cheeseburger in Paradise by Jimmy Buffett
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Jimmy Buffett with my daughter in my coconuts and grass skirt.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Yoga – I do a handstand and headstand every day – because I can!

name: Cathy Attig
body_html:
Before joining Prosperity Partners, Cathy co-founded Danaher Attig & Plante PLC in 2005, following a decade at KPMG LLP. Her practice centers on Income, Gift, and Estate Planning and Compliance, with a specialized focus on the unique needs of affluent families and business owners.

She holds a B.S. in Accounting from Salisbury University in Salisbury, Maryland. Cathy is a member of both the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) and the Vermont Society of CPAs.

Outside of work, Cathy enjoys boating on Lake Champlain, reading, and spending time with her family in Vermont.

EXPERTISE: Tax Planning and Compliance for Closely Held Businesses, High Net Worth Individuals, and Family Groups including Trusts, Estates, and Private Foundations

  • Favorite thing about my job: What I value most is the people I work with, both my colleagues and our clients. I am fortunate to collaborate with a team of talented, dedicated professionals who challenge and support one another. Equally important is the trust our clients place in us. Building long-term relationships and helping clients navigate complex financial challenges is deeply rewarding and gives meaning to the work we do.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Australia! My husband and I joined our daughter at the end of her semester abroad and traveled the Great Ocean Road from Adelaide to Melbourne, including a stay on Kangaroo Island. We often refer to it as our “trip around the world,” having departed from New York with an overnight in Qatar and returning with a stopover in Hawaii before heading home to the East Coast.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Shrimp Scampi
  • What would your last meal be? Steak frites with Caesar salad!

CERTIFICATIONS:

  • PFS – Personal Financial Specialist
  • CPA – Certified Public Accountant

name: Cathy Kim
body_html:
After earning her BFA from the University of Tennessee – Knoxville, Cathy made the move to Chicago and quickly immersed herself in the city’s vibrant hospitality scene, working with renowned restaurant groups like Lettuce Entertain You and the Boka Restaurant Group. Over the course of 15 years, Cathy developed a broad skill set as an Office Manager, Project Manager, and Executive Assistant, consistently supporting high-energy environments and executive teams while navigating the demands of daily operations. Now, as the Executive Assistant to the CEO of Prosperity Partners, Cathy brings a unique blend of efficiency, flexibility, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to exceptional service that elevates the entire team.

EXPERTISE: Scheduling, Project Management, Customer Service

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The snacks! Keep me well fed, and I’ll always be happy.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Seoul, Korea. Loved going to the place where it all began #motherland
  • What is your go-to Karaoke song? Tequila by The Champs
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Delicious food and wine with friends, followed by an early 2000’s dance party!
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The after, after parties …
  • Desert Island Book: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F&*k by Mark Manson
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Gardening
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? “What a long, strange trip it’s been”
  • I have an irrational fear of: falling through a sidewalk grate.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: In 2000, when I saw Phish at the Big Cypress Festival in Florida.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Ultimate Frisbee (when my knees were good) and Pickleball

name: Cheryl Chambers
body_html:
Cheryl Chambers earned her degree in Business Administration from Champlain College in Burlington, Vermont. She began her career in finance and banking before stepping away to raise her family. Cheryl later reentered the workforce as an intern at KPMG LLP, where she spent several years honing her tax skills before joining Danaher Attig & Plante PLC in 2005. Over the years, she advanced from Tax Preparer to Senior Tax Associate, and ultimately to Tax Manager.

Today, Cheryl is a Tax Manager at Prosperity Partners, where she is a highly valued member of the team! She brings extensive experience and a deep understanding of Fiduciary, Estate, Gift, and High-Net-Worth Individual tax returns.

EXPERTISE: Fiduciary, Estate, and Gift Tax; High-Net-Worth Individual Returns

  • My favorite thing about my job: The incredible team in Burlington! We have a unique camaraderie—supportive, caring, kind—with a great mix of humor, loyalty, and respect.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Bees—or really anything that buzzes! I always assume it’s a bee.
  • What would your last meal be? Thanksgiving dinner with all the trimmings.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Creamy Shrimp Linguine – a family favorite every time my kids come home.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Train at the Shelburne Museum in Vermont. I was front row center, tossed my iPhone on stage, and the lead singer took a selfie with me in the background—amazing, even though it broke my phone case!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Relaxing on a sunny beach with a good book, a Diet Coke, and a slice of chocolate cake.

name: Chirag Solanki
body_html:
Chirag Solanki is a Certified Public Accountant and Certified Management Accountant with a Master’s Degree from Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam University and a Bachelor’s Degree from the University of Mumbai. From 2004 to 2018, he worked in different accounting roles and specialized in management accounting, supporting different functions within Finance and Accounting departments. Since 2023, he has specialized in individual, business, non-profit, and HOA tax preparation to help clients with the completion and submission of accurate tax returns in a timely manner. Chirag joined Prosperity Partners in June 2025, where he is dedicated to preparing and reviewing tax returns. Outside of the office, Chirag enjoys playing cricket and visiting exciting getaways!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: Ensuring the completion and timely submission of accurate tax returns and aiding in tax planning and projections for clients. It is rewarding to know that my expertise can make a tangible difference in their success and help them navigate the complexities of taxes more effectively.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: This would be the trip to different exotic locations in Gujarat with my family, where we got the opportunity to visit historic and religious places, as well as stay close to nature and appreciate local culture.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Captain America.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Cricket.
  • What would your last meal be? Indian Gujarati thali.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Seek elderly blessings, visit temple, spend time with family, and plan a wonderful dinner out with family.

name: Chrisley Reed
body_html:
Chris Reed graduated University of California, Santa Barbara with a bachelor’s degree in Business Economics in 1987. He joined McGowan Guntermann in 1989 after receiving his CPA license and was promoted to a partner of the McGowan Guntermann – Audit and Accounting group in 1999. Chris has expertise in accounting, auditing, and taxation for not-for-profit organizations and employee benefit plans. Chris is a past chair of the California State Peer Review Committee where he served 18 years as a committee member and performed firm-on-firm peer reviews for over 20 years. Chris and his wife, Barbara, love traveling, by air, land, and sea.

EXPERTISE: Not-for-profit accounting and taxation for public charities and private foundations.

  • Favorite thing about my job: They say you have to love what you do, and I certainly love what I do. Since 1985, I love solving accounting puzzles for our clients. Nothing better than breaking out the old t-accounts and making sense of a complicated accounting transaction. Accounting nerd for sure.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: A suite at Staples Center to watch a L.A. Kings game. The bus ride down was epic in many ways.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My wife and I enjoy traveling, including cruising. We spent two and a half weeks in Greece in May 2024. One week on Santorini, in the city of Oia, and another week on a cruise ship from Athens, cruising the Greek islands and Turkey. Incredible adventures!
  • I have an irrational fear of __________  I have an irrational fear of not locking all the doors in the house at night.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: ZZ Top and George Thorogood at the Santa Barbara County Bowl in the early 90’s. I love my classic rock from the 80’s and 90’s. I only wish I could have seen Queen in concert, my favorite band of all time.
  • What would your last meal be? Teriyaki ribeye, sauteed mushrooms and teriyaki rice from Chuck’s of Hawaii in Santa Barbara, and don’t forget the epic salad bar. Oh, and a bottle of Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Christine Maurer
body_html:
Christine Maurer graduated from University of California, Santa Barbara, with a major in economics and accounting. While at UCSB, Christine competed on the soccer team. After beginning her career at Prosperity Partners as an intern in January 2021, she joined the firm fulltime in July 2021. She focuses on client accounting services. In her spare time, Christine enjoys spending time with friends and family, being outdoors and playing soccer.

EXPERTISE: Small business accounting, Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The people – everyone is easy to work with and takes extra time to help out their colleagues. Prosperity Partners fosters a comfortable environment to ask questions and genuinely cares about their employee’s professional growth and passions.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I’m not sure if this counts but, I love to bake and can bake a pretty good blueberry scone.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: After I graduated college, I went to a few different Greek islands for 3 weeks and it was beautiful!
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Any country song, (typically not a fan-favorite), specifically “All Summer Long” by Kid Rock
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? My favorite sport to play is soccer, Prosperity Partners volleyball is a close second.

name: Coby Haim
body_html:
Coby Haim graduated from the University of New York – College of Staten Island with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting. Shortly after graduating, he obtained his CPA and began his career in a small accounting firm where he serviced the average “mom & pop” taxpayer. Eager to expand his knowledge, he later moved to a mid-size firm in New York City where he gained experience in the taxation of ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, privately held businesses, and various investment funds and the planning that comes along with it. After a 5-year tenure, Coby decided his passion was to help mid-size businesses build wealth and create the “next generation” of high-net-worth taxpayers. In 2019, he joined Dorfman, Mizrach, & Thaler, LLP, now merged with Prosperity Partners. Here he has gained expertise in various closely-held operating industries and provides planning, consulting, and tax services to both the businesses and their owners.

EXPERTISE: Pass-through Taxation, Mergers & Acquisitions, Tax and Estate Planning, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Tax Resolution and Representation before Taxing Authorities

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Watching clients grow.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Shakshouka, but I can also throw a mean barbeque.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I spent a month traveling throughout Israel with my wife. We caught up with family, visited holy sites, and relaxed on the beach. Looking forward to doing this again someday with our children!
  • What would your last meal be? My Savta’s (Grandmother’s) Kubbeh Selek – Iraqi semolina dumplings stuffed with meat in a red beet sauce

name: Colleen Callahan
body_html:
Colleen graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a degree in accounting. She started her career in Deloitte’s Chicago audit practice, where she specialized in international manufacturing clients. She joined Kraft Foods’ SEC reporting team, and worked on the spinoff of Kraft Foods from Mondelez International. Following the spin-off, she joined private-equity backed Surgery Partners. Following a successful exit, she worked at 2 venture-capital-backed technology startups. She joined the firm in 2023 to build the accounting, finance, reporting & analysis infrastructure.

EXPERTISE: Start-Ups, Financial Statement Audits, Forecasting, Reporting

  • Favorite thing about my job: The caliber of people I work with. Everyone I’ve met is so knowledgeable about so many tax & accounting topics, puts the client first, and has a positive attitude.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Cupcake with ALL the frosting + family & friends
    I have an irrational fear of: Rodents, the way they can squeeze into the smallest place & multiply quickly
  • What is the best dish you can cook: Despite not having an ounce of Italian blood, homemade pizzas. I make the dough & assemble the pizzas, my husband cooks them in our Ooni pizza oven

name: Dan McNamee
body_html:
Dan McNamee is a Certified Public Accountant with a Master of Accounting Science (MAS) from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a Bachelor’s Degree from Saint Louis University. Since 2021, he has specialized in preparing individual, partnership, and corporate tax returns, with a strong focus on partnership structures and investor allocations. Dan joined Prosperity Partners in August 2025, where he provides personalized tax guidance and collaborates closely with clients to help them navigate complex tax considerations. He brings a practical, detail‑oriented approach to tax compliance and planning, with an emphasis on clear communication and thoughtful analysis. Outside of the office, Dan enjoys trivia nights with friends, running, skiing, and cheering on the Chicago Bears!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance; Mergers & Acquisitions

Favorite Thing About Prosperity: Learning something new every day and working with positive, like‑minded people. The firm has a strong culture, and I enjoy collaborating with teammates across the practice.

  • Favorite Movie Quote: “You miss 100% of the shots you don’t take.” – Wayne Gretzky – Michael Scott
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Move Along by All American Rejects
  • What would your last meal be? Lou Malnati’s deep dish pizza
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Anything active and outdoors! Especially trips that involve skiing or hiking.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Gotta love going for long runs along Lake Michigan

name: Daniel Moore
body_html:
Daniel Moore graduated from Carthage College with a bachelor’s degree in accounting. Prior to joining the team here, he worked on the tax team at Baker Tilly. Daniel joined Prosperity Partners in May of 2023 as an associate and is focusing on tax compliance and preparation. He is currently pursuing his CPA certification.

EXPERTISE: Tax Compliance and Preparation

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Getting to meet the team at various outings. I love to connect with people outside of work and get to know them!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I play drums for my local Church as well as in a Christian band, where I played in an album featuring the Christian rock band, Skillet.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Colorado Springs to visit Pike’s Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park, and Garden of the Gods. My wife and I love to explore nature and go on hikes in our free time!
  • What would your last meal be? Fettuccine Alfredo
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Favorite workout – strength training , specifically chest and triceps (can’t start my day without a trip to the gym!) Favorite sport to play – Right now, golf, but I enjoy playing tennis (which I played in college), basketball, and ping pong too.

name: Danielle Azzollini
body_html:
Danielle graduated from Widener University with a bachelor’s in Accounting and a master’s of tax and financial planning. Danielle joined Prosperity Partners in January 2021 as a Senior Tax Associate and focuses primarily on individual and business tax compliance. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, Danielle focused exclusively on international tax consulting and compliance. She is currently pursuing her CPA.

EXPERTISE: International Tax, Individual and Business Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: How nice everyone is and the flexibility for scheduling work around family life. Deadlines will always be stressful but the team we have here is great in terms of providing the necessary support and everyone does their best to make work more enjoyable.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Taking a solo trip to Italy.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Brazilian jiu jitsu, goal to become a world champion
  • I have an irrational fear of: All bugs
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Wong, because he’s low key the best character and hilarious.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Volleyball

name: David Dimitri
body_html:
David Dimitri graduated from William & Mary College with a Major in Finance and Minor in Accounting before completing an additional year to earn his Master’s in Accounting. David interned at Pipaya after completing his undergraduate studies and then continued to work for what is now Prosperity Partners upon completing the master’s program. David has passed all CPA exams and is looking forward to becoming an official CPA upon completion of one year of fieldwork. In his free time, David enjoys working out, reading, and spending time with friends and family.

EXPERTISE: ASC Related Topics and Excel Shortcuts

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The ability to work with different people, especially the owners/operators of small businesses. The uniqueness of each and every project never fails to stimulate learning!
  • Desert Island Book: Lord of the Rings
  • Best disk I can cook: Egg Bake
  • Favorite board game: Catan
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Basketball

name: David Larson
body_html:
dlarson@prosperityllc.com
805-879-9929

David began his career with Arthur Young’s tax department in Beverly Hills. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, he was the managing partner of McGowan Guntermann in Santa Barbara. MG is one of the oldest firms on California’s central coast. David’s vast tax experience includes estate and trust planning and administration. Outside of the office, although his competitive days are behind him, you will still find David cycling the roads and running the trails of Santa Barbara’s backcountry.

Education
University of California, Santa Barbara, BA
Golden Gate University, MST

EXPERTISE: Privately Held Businesses, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Partnership Taxation, Estate Planning and Family Office

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people, of course. I am fortunate to work with interesting clients and Prosperity Partner employees.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I’ve spent Thanksgiving in Troncones, Mexico with family and friends for the last 25 years. Warm water, great surf, and it is Mexico!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: An out of the ordinary endurance activity, e.g.s., Grand Canyon or Mt Whitney hike, paddling from Catalina to the mainland, triathlon, Carmel to Hearst Castle bike ride.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended:Recently, Tedeschi Trucks Band at the Santa Barbara Bowl with the Dave Matthews Band not far behind.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play?: I spent my high school and college years playing volleyball. I now spend the time I can cycling or running with my dogs in the Santa Barbara backcountry

name: David Maenner
body_html:
David Maenner is an executive leader with a proven track record of driving profitable growth in PE-backed companies. He specializes in transforming organizations for peak performance and profitability, using metrics and data-driven decision-making to identify and optimize potential. His experience across Operations, Finance, and Commercial functions has been instrumental in leading high-growth organizations.

For the last 15 years, David has worked within PE-backed portfolio companies, successfully leading and participating in strategic M&A transactions from diligence through post-merger integration. He is passionate about building and developing high-performing teams, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and driving continuous improvements to maximize organizational value. David has a B.S. from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and an MBA from DePaul University.

EXPERTISE: Leadership, Business Optimization, M&A, Operations

  • Favorite thing about my job: Growth! I have always lived with a growth mindset, and we embrace those values at Prosperity Partners. We are growing as a company and as a team to deliver for our clients.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I enjoy making Texas style BBQ during the summer months for friends & family.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “People…operate with beliefs and biases. To the extent you can eliminate both and replace them with data, you gain a clear advantage.” – Michael Lewis, Moneyball
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I have enjoyed being on many different teams while playing different sports, but I usually get the most questions about doing pole vault while in high school.

name: David Ramirez
body_html:
David Ramirez graduated from Northern Illinois University with both a Bachelor’s in Accounting and a Master of Accounting Science. His career has been focused in tax since his first internship preparing 1040s while still attending classes at NIU. David began his full-time career as a Tax Associate at PwC in 2023 before joining Prosperity Partners in 2026 as a Tax Technologist. When he has free time, David likes to spend time with friends, family, and feel the wind in his face as he takes a nice, relaxing walk along the lake!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance, State and Local Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: Being able to work with a nice group of people who are willing to help and make me feel like I fit right in.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: An all-day event: brunch with family, then a separate dinner with friends and an afterparty!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? A bacon, egg, and cheese bagel with a hash brown on the side. I love making breakfast food on a griddle.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Chess. I like to think before acting.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A trip to Playa Del Carmen in Mexico. I had the best time relaxing, seeing the animals, the ocean, the locals, and eating the best food!

name: Deepti Sherigar
body_html:
Deepti Sherigar graduated from the University of Mumbai with her Master’s Degree in Commerce. After completing her program at the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, Deepti joined the US Taxation team at Thomson Reuters as an Associate working for CBIZ Advisor LLP. Currently she works for Prosperity’s VGSL team on 1040 and Business Tax returns. Deepti is enthusiastic, self-motivated, and adaptable to all challenging situations. When she’s not at work, Deepti enjoys doing nature trails, drawing, playing outdoor games, and spending time with friends and family.

  • What is the best dish you can cook? I have a deep appreciation for continental cuisine and take great pleasure in preparing seafood dishes.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Writing short stories allows me to explore different narratives and characters, providing an outlet for my imagination and improving my storytelling abilities.
  • Favorite Move Quote: “Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re going to get.” – Forrest Gump
  • What is your go to karaoke song? “Wonderwall” by Oasis
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I enjoy throwing a small get-together with music, games, and good food. I believe it’s a great excuse to bring everyone together and just have fun.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Arijit Singh’s concerts are unparalleled in their emotional depth and musical brilliance.
  • If you could have dinner with one of the marvel characters, who would it be and why? If I had the chance, I’d choose to dine with Deadpool.
  • What would your last meal be? My last favorite Indian meal would be a comforting bowl of khichdi, elevated with a dollop of ghee and a side of spicy mango pickle.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Badminton!

name: Deyan Denev
body_html:
Deyan joined Prosperity and began practicing tax as an associate in 2014. He holds a bachelor’s degree in accounting and a master’s in taxation from DePaul University. Currently a senior tax manager, Deyan is a tax generalist with a robust knowledge base who specializes in tax compliance and consulting. He provides his clients with high-level comprehensive advice, guides them through complex tax issues and presents them with efficient tax-planning opportunities and strategies.

His business clients span across a variety of different industries from IT and general business-consulting companies to electronics manufacturers, to large family investment partnerships. Deyan closely works his with high-net worth and ultra-high-net worth individual clients, guiding them in making smart tax decisions and ensuring they’re employing robust tax-saving strategies that minimize their tax burden, and help grow their wealth. Additionally, as member of the Illinois CPA Society’s International Committee, Deyan has a special interest in international taxation with notable experience in taxation of U.S. expatriates and foreign nationals.

When not in the office, Deyan enjoys spending time with his family, traveling as much as time allows and reading a good fiction book.

EXPERTISE: Individual & Business Tax, Compliance, Planning and Tax Saving Strategies

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The people! There is no toxicity or tension, everyone loves to help and no one thinks exceptionally high of themselves. This allows for an enjoyable working environment that fosters friendships and collaboration at all levels.
  • Desert island book: “Small Gods” by Terry Pratchett
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Blueberry Crumble Cake
