  • Favorite movie quote: “You shall not pass!” – Gandalf in JRR Tolkien’s “The Fellowship of the Ring”
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Sequence. I can work well with other people, I can pick up and try a different strategy if the one I currently have doesn’t work out, I’m persistent and can work well under pressure.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Butterflies, though it’s totally rational.

name: Diana Gallo
body_html:
Diana Gallo graduated from Pace University’s Lubin School of Business with both a Bachelor of Business Administration and a Master of Business Administration in Public Accounting. She brings 20 years of experience in attest and tax services, specializing in attest services for companies in diverse industries, including healthcare, real estate, and retail. Her taxation portfolio includes partnership and corporation tax returns, including complex returns with multiple state filing requirements. In her spare time, Diana enjoys being a new mom, cooking and baking, and exploring her new home state of South Carolina.

EXPERTISE: Attest Services, Partnership Taxation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: My co-workers! Our team always supports one another and works together to meet deadlines.
  • Favorite Sport to Play: I enjoy bowling and volleyball. I played both competitively in high school.
  • What is the best dish you can make? Pasta with homemade sauce, meatballs, and chicken cutlets for dinner. Blackout cake for dessert.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A trip with my cousins to Filicudi, a small island off the coast of Sicily where my grandmother and her siblings were raised. Was truly a magical experience to walk in our ancestors’ footsteps and experience what life was like before they immigrated to the United States.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Risk – love the strategy and game play! I played for years with my friends, with games sometimes lasting into the next day. Then, when I met my husband, I found out it was a family favorite game.

name: Doug Dellinger
body_html:
Doug graduated from Duke University with a degree in economics. He began his career as a management consultant, first with PwC and then with Treacy & Company (now part of Cherry Bekaert). Doug then transitioned into private equity, joining Audax Group and then Investindustrial. Since then, Doug has focused on acquisitions of small and mid-sized businesses in people-driven industries including insurance brokerage, healthcare services and now tax and accounting services at Prosperity Partners where Doug leads our inorganic growth efforts and strategic partnerships.

EXPERTISE: Mergers & Acquisitions

  • Favorite thing about my job: Listening to the stories of business owners and leaders. The entrepreneurial journey is always unique and learning how businesses have grown, evolved and overcome challenges along the way is fascinating.
  • What is the best dish you can cook: I make steak au poivre on occasion. More often than not that occasion is when I’m home alone for the evening, so feedback on the meal is rare.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My delayed honeymoon to Australia and New Zealand. It’s a long way to go but worth it if you have the time.
  • What would your last meal be: A Thanksgiving style meal – turkey, cranberry sauce, stuffing, mashed potatoes, etc. Perhaps it’s nostalgia but I look forward to it every year.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I love to ski. I try to get to Colorado twice a year, once in the winter and once in the spring. Life can get in the way of those plans but I’m always optimistic about next year.

name: Dustin Holsinger
body_html:
Dustin graduated from DePaul University in June of 2018 with bachelor’s degrees in accounting and finance. Dustin joined Prosperity Partners in January of 2023 as a Senior Tax Associate and focuses primarily on individual and business tax compliance. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, Dustin spent 4 years at a mid-size accounting firm in Chicago and became a Certified Public Accountant. In his spare time, Dustin likes to play bocce ball and brews various fermented drinks.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax, Compliance, and Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The mentor/mentee system
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby?: Making and selling fermented foods/drinks (CultureBox)
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Brussels/Paris/London/Amsterdam
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Alex G at Thalia Hall
  • What would your last meal be: Veggie burrito with avocado from Taqueria Moran in Logan Square

name: Ella Midenjak
body_html:
Ella Midenjak graduated from University of Vermont in 2010 with a Bachelors in Business Administration. Post graduation, Ella went into retail management, becoming a Store Manager of a supermarket store before transitioning to Human Resources. After nearly 6 years in HR, she joined Danaher Attig & Plante in 2023, now Prosperity Partners. As a member of the Burlington Prosperity team, Ella loves helping clients and especially celebrating office birthdays!

EXPERTISE: Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: My coworkers. We are a close-knit team that cares about one other, lifts each other up, and is always there for help or encouragement!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I love going on cruises and exploring different areas of the world. Two of my favorite cruises include a trip I took in 2023 to England, Ireland and Scotland, and a more recent cruise in May 2025 where I went to Spain, France, and Italy. I also fell in love with Rhode Island when we visited Newport to see all the Gilded Age mansions. I was awestruck by the history and the stunning landscapes.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? My hobby is running but more so, I just love being active – hiking, walking, pilates, playing sports, weightlifting, etc. I love being in nature and watching sunrises. I am currently training for my first ever marathon, which I hope will be successful! I am also a very big personal finance nerd, and I particularly love playing around with financial independence calculators.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Seeing the Eagles at the Sphere in Las Vegas on their farewell tour. It was incredible and made even better by the venue!

name: Eric Swerdlow
body_html:
Eric Swerdlow earned his Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Penn State University in 2006 and his Master of Science in Taxation from Pace University in 2013. Since beginning his career in 2006, he has specialized in Corporate and Partnership Taxation, International Tax matters, and advising High Net Worth Individuals. Raised in the greater Philadelphia area, Eric currently lives in New Jersey. Outside of work, Eric enjoys photography, hiking, sports, working out, and travel.

EXPERTISE: Consolidated Corporations, Partnership Allocations, State and Local Taxation, M&A, Net Operating Losses, Inbound and Outbound International Taxation, Provisions for Income Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: Helping clients navigate complex tax matters and finding practical solutions.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The firm picnic in Central Park.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Any time I get to explore a new city or spend time in nature.
  • What would your last meal be? Steak
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Weightlifting

Professional Associations:

  • American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
  • New York State Society of CPAs (NYSSCPA)
  • Penn State Alumni Association

name: Ethan Marciano
body_html:
Ethan Marciano graduated from the University of Virginia in 2021 with a double major in Financial Economics and Statistics. After interning at Pipaya the summer of his junior year, he came back on full-time as an M&A Analyst post grad. Ethan now serves as an M&A Manager at Prosperity Partners. Outside of work, Ethan enjoys reading and traveling with friends.

EXPERTISE: Transaction Advisory Services, Purchase Accounting, Strategic Financial Advisory

  • Desert Island Book: The Three-Body Problem series by Liu Cixin
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: In the summer of 2025 when I went to Nice and some surrounding small towns in the south of France.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Cubed, air-fried chicken (tragically unseasoned) with instant rice.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: That would have to be a multiple-way tie between all the February skiing retreats I have taken to Breckenridge with the rest of the DC office!

name: Evan DeFonce
body_html:
Evan DeFonce graduated from the University of Maryland with a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance. After graduation, he joined Prosperity Partners in 2025 as an Analyst, where he specializes in Transaction Advisory QoE in the Aerospace, Defense, and Government Services industries. In his free time, Evan enjoys playing basketball and golf, and spending time with friends.

EXPERTISE: Quality of Earnings

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Being given real responsibilities right away and having the opportunity to learn. Since our team is small, I’ve been given meaningful work from day one, which allows me to grow professionally while being able to utilize the resources around me to help guide me through it. If I get stuck, I feel comfortable asking anyone on our team for help, and I appreciate everyone’s willingness to teach me new concepts or walk me through processes I haven’t seen before.
  • Favorite Vacation You’ve Taken: Studying abroad in Barcelona and taking trips across Europe.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel Character, who would it be and why? Thor – I’d want to try to lift his hammer!
  • What would your last meal be? Sally’s Pizza in New Haven, CT
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Basketball and golf

name: Evan Landmann
body_html:
Evan graduated from Loyola University Chicago in 2016 with a Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting and a Minor in Spanish. Before transitioning into public accounting in 2018, he spent two years as a tax compliance and debt resolution specialist. He specializes in tailored tax advisory and financial consulting for individuals, families, businesses, and trusts, with a particular focus on high-net-worth families. Evan joined the Prosperity team as a Manager in July 2025 and holds licensure as both a Certified Public Accountant through the AICPA and an Enrolled Agent with the IRS.

EXPERTISE: Pass‐Through, Individual, Fiduciary & Estate Taxation; Gift Tax Compliance & Planning; General Tax Consulting & Planning; Private Foundations

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy the human side of tax and tax planning. Behind every set of returns is an individual—or a family—with unique goals and circumstances. Designing customized strategies that help clients reach those goals is both an engaging challenge and incredibly rewarding.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Traveling somewhere I’ve never been!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? My great grandmother’s lasagna recipe (converted to be vegetarian)
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: A weightlifting session first thing in the morning with a 5-10K jog in the evening

name: Fern Nunes-Cubelo
body_html:
Fern earned her Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Rutgers University and started her career in public accounting at a mid-size New Jersey firm where she gained valuable experience in Accounting, Taxation, and Audit. Before joining Dorfman, Mizrach and Thaler in 2019, she worked as a Controller for 25 years at a family-owned NJ business which had her wearing many hats, including cash flow management, general ledger maintenance, financial reporting, payroll & HR management, and local, state, and federal tax compliance. In her current role with Prosperity, she provides CAS services to her clients of varying industries, as well as tax compliance. In her spare time, she enjoys traveling, photography, and boating at the Jersey Shore!

EXPERTISE: Financial Reporting, Small Business Accounting, QuickBooks, Payroll, Fluent in Portuguese and Spanish

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: I love the diversity of my work and clients, as well as my amazingly smart, compassionate, and dedicated coworkers.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “If you focus on what you left behind, you will never be able to see what lies ahead.” — Chef Gusteau, Ratatouille
  • What would your last meal be? The perfect Cacio e Pepe & a glass of my favorite super Tuscan, Sassicaia.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Norway was on my bucket list since 5th grade when I learned about the Fjords and I finally got there for my 50th birthday! We took a small ship from Bergen to Kirkenes in the North and stopped at an array of ports along the way. Fjords, rib boat rides exploring tidal currents, king crab fishing, photographing puffins, crossing the Arctic circle – The Land of the Midnight Sun did not disappoint!
  • What is your go-to Karaoke song? “Heart of Glass” by Blondie
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My birthday falls on or around Memorial Day weekend so if New Jersey weather cooperates, boating, BBQs, and ice cream cake are generally involved!

name: Fred Farkouh
body_html:
Fred Farkouh has over 40 years of experience representing large corporations and mid-market entities in tax planning and compliance, including both domestic and international tax issues. His expertise is further enhanced by a strong background in mergers and acquisitions, business planning, and all aspects of real estate transactions. Fred’s extensive expertise includes strategic advisement for high-net-worth individuals and families on matters such as income and transfer tax planning, wealth accumulation and preservation strategies, intergenerational transfers, and gift and estate tax planning. His deep understanding of legal implications and the ability to provide creative problem solving in many scenarios are additional benefits most appreciated by his clients. From vetting investment opportunities and analyzing complex transactions, to structuring, financing, and planning for new business start-ups, clients count on Fred to take a proactive approach to tax services.

Fred chose to pursue a career in accounting because he enjoyed the challenges and nuances of taxation. He credits his success in the field to his commitment to client service and honesty, as his personal philosophy when it comes to his work is that clients come first.

Raised in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, Fred now resides in New Jersey with his wife, Martha. In his free time, he enjoys spending time with his daughter, Alexandra, son, Ray, daughter-in-law, Missy, and his two grandchildren, Charlie and Chloe. Other hobbies of Fred’s include traveling, boating, and reading.

Memberships:

  • American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
  • New York State Society of CPAs (NYSSCPA)

name: Gary Parikh
body_html:
Gary graduated with a bachelor’s degree in accounting and chartered accountancy in Inda and received his master’s degree in finance from Goldey-Beacom College in Delaware in 2011. In 2014, Gary earned his CPA license as well. Gary started his career with a local CPA firm as a senior accountant where he provided accounting and tax services to small and medium size companies. In 2021, he joined Jain & Jain before the firm became part of Prosperity Partners in 2024. In his spare time, Gary enjoys playing volleyball, tennis, swimming, and running.

EXPERTISE:  Small business accounting

  • Favorite thing about my job: – Variety of work, people, and tasks. It keeps me busy all the time and learning a lot.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? – Noodles
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Maldives Island. (Clean beach, enjoying sunrise, sunset and clean blue sea water)
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? – Travel to quiet natural places and enjoying a sunrise moment.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? – Volleyball, Tennis, and Swimming.

name: Govind Domal
body_html:
Govind Domal is an accomplished Finance Executive with 10 years of experience in US accounting, general ledger management, reconciliations, and end-to-end financial operations. He brings a strong background across P2P, O2C, and R2R processes, with expertise in month-end close activities and detailed financial reporting. Govind has hands-on experience working with leading accounting platforms including QuickBooks, Workday, Tally ERP 9, NetSuite, Intacct, and several client-specific systems. His responsibilities have spanned bank reconciliations, AR/AP management, revenue postings, reconciliations, financial projections, payroll processing, and audit support.

Throughout his career, Govind has collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, enhance data accuracy, and support both daily workflows and month-end close requirements. His detail-oriented approach and commitment to operational excellence consistently contribute to high-quality outcomes for clients and internal stakeholders. Known for his soft-spoken nature, reliability, and punctuality, Govind is a quick learner with strong problem-solving skills. He values teamwork, continuous improvement, and building positive professional relationships, always eager to adopt new tools and knowledge to better support organizational goals.

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy learning something new every day and solving problems that make life easier for clients and my team. The collaboration and continuous improvement keep me motivated.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: A team lunch followed by bowling – nothing beats friendly competition combined with good food!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A trip to Goa with family. The beaches, sunsets, and endless seafood made it unforgettable.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Badminton – it’s quick, energetic, and perfect for staying active!
  • What would the title of your autobiography be: “Becoming Better Every Day”
  • What would your last meal be? A full Indian Thali! There is no better way to enjoy all the flavors at once.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Spending time with family, going out for dinner, and ending the day with cake.

name: Harry Cendrowski
body_html:
Harry Cendrowski graduated from the University of Detroit with a degree in Accounting. He worked at Touche Ross (now Deloitte) for several years prior to forming Cendrowski Corporate Advisors, a predecessor firm of Prosperity. He has written and co-authored several renowned books on fraud, private equity, and risk management.

EXPERTISE

Family office structuring and tax services, tax structuring & planning for UHNW and high net worth individuals, business succession planning, formation of REITs/UPREITs, QSBS and estate planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: Making a difference with our clients and team members
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Veal scallopini
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Machu Picchu
  • Favorite movie quote: “A man who doesn’t spend time with his family can never be a real man”.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Friends and family on Walloon Lake
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Boxing

CERTIFICATIONS

  • CPA – Certified Public Accountant
  • ABV – Accredited in Business Valuation
  • CGMA – Chartered Global Management Accountant
  • CFF – Certified in Financial Forensics
  • CVA – Certified Valuation Analyst
  • CFD – Certified in Fraud Deterrence
  • MAFF – Master Analyst in Financial Forensics

name: Heather MacGarvey
body_html:
Heather MacGarvey earned her Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with an emphasis in Accounting from the University of Colorado at Boulder. Go Buffs! After graduating, she gained valuable experience as a Senior Staff Accountant at a small software company. Heather joined Pipaya (now Prosperity) in 2020 and currently serves as the Office Manager, Event Planner, and Bookkeeper, playing a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations. Outside of work, Heather enjoys cheering on her sons at their football and soccer games, staying active with her neighborhood bootcamp, and unwinding with movie nights alongside her husband.

EXPERTISE: Bookkeeping, Billing, Administration & Event Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love the variety in my day-to-day that comes with wearing many hats, it keeps things interesting! I also really enjoy finding ways to make things easier for our employees.
  • I have an irrational fear of… heights
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I prefer a lowkey, simple celebration – dinner at home with my family on our porch is perfect!
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Our annual offsite trip to Breckenridge is always a highlight. It is such a fun and refreshing way to connect with the team.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Lasagna – all credit goes to my grandma for the recipe, though!

name: Hitesh Jaiswal
body_html:
Hitesh Jaiswal is a Chartered Accountant Finalist Student with a Bachelor’s Degree from the University of Mumbai. Since 2015, he has specialized in tax planning, specifically preparing individual and business returns based on Indian Taxation laws. Hitesh joined SurePrep in October 2022, where he was a Tax Preparer focused on business and individual returns. In 2024, Hitesh joined Prosperity Partners, where he is dedicated to individual returns as a Tax Preparer. Outside of the office, Hitesh enjoys perfecting his Cricket game and spending time playing the PlayStation 4.

Expertise: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: My coworkers. We are a close-knit team that cares about one other, lifts each other up, and are always there for help or encouragement!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? If making an omelette counts as a dish, then yes—I can cook! But where I really shine is with hot chocolate and all kinds of milkshakes. I enjoy experimenting with different flavors and making each one special.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Playing Cricket
  • Favorite Move Quote: “Apne sapno ke peeche bhaagna chhod do, unhe apni zindagi mein aane do.” Stop chasing your dreams, let them come into your life.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Managers. And heights.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? As CA (Chartered Accountant) students, we don’t take vacations—we study through them. I haven’t been on a vacation since I started my CA journey!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Cricket and Badminton

name: Howard Rosenberg
body_html:
Howard Rosenberg graduated from Herbert Lehman College with a BS in Accounting. He has been a member of the Farkouh, Furman, and Faccio family for over 41 years and is delighted to join Prosperity Partners part-time. Howard is an Enrolled Agent and a Notary, and he primarily works with high-net-worth individuals. He has been a leader in nurturing and training the younger staff over the years, and enjoys cultivating excellent working relationships with his clients as well.

EXPERTISE: High-Net-Worth Individuals, Small Partnerships, Trusts

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people! I have worked with many wonderful people over the past 40 years. Both those who have worked alongside me who have always been able to come to me for support and guidance, and those that I have worked for – the clients. I take great pride that my clients have trusted in my advice in producing the best outcome for their personal finance and tax-related needs.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Every trip I have ever taken has been my favorite at the time. Whether with my wife or the family, just getting away has always excited me. Relaxing on a beach or seeing the sights of a particular region has always made me happy, and I hope to do more traveling in the future. My most recent trip to Greece was a dream trip. Athens, Naxos, and Santorini – all absolutely breathtaking!
  • Favorite activities: I enjoy sunny days, swimming, and summer reading by a pool. Doing 40 minutes of laps in an outside pool is my favorite. When that is not available, I work out at home on my recumbent bike and basement gym.
  • Reading and Entertainment Recs: Some writers I enjoys are TJ Klune, Carl Hiaaen, and many mystery and fantasy writers including James Patterson and Patricia Cornwall’s earlier work. A few of my current TV series favorites are The Pitt, Palm Royale, Stranger Things, The Lincoln Lawyer, Bridgerton, and Harlan Coben’s many series. I also enjoy Broadway musicals and try to see at least several performances every year, unlike my eldest daughter who sees many more than that!

name: Hubert Tian
body_html:
Hubert Tian graduated Cum Laude from Boston College with a double concentration in Finance and Accounting. Since graduation, he has gained experience across areas such as mergers and acquisitions and financial accounting, allowing him to provide better service to clients. Hubert joined Prosperity Partners in 2025 as an Analyst, specializing in transaction advisory within the Aerospace, Defense, and Government industries. In his spare time, Hubert enjoys spending time with family & friends, playing basketball, and watching Liverpool F.C.

EXPERTISE: Financial Analysis, Client Service

  • Favorite thing about my job: Working alongside a team of driven individuals and getting exposure to different businesses and clients through the work that we do.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: After graduating college, I visited China for two months. I explored prominent cities like Shanghai and Beijing, as well as smaller cities like Taiyuan and Nanjing, with family and friends. The experience was truly unforgettable!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Surrounded by family and friends with a nice strawberry shortcake or New York cheesecake to end the night off.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Thor – to get a chance to see if I’m worthy of wielding Mjolnir.
  • What would your last meal be? Sushi, Korean BBQ, and my mom’s homemade pork belly. No vegetables of course!

name: Isabelle Bissonnette
body_html:
Isabelle Bissonnette graduated from American University earning a Bachelor’s in Business Administration with a specialization in Finance and a minor in French. Driven by a strong interest in financial analysis, she went on to complete her Masters in Finance from American University as well. Following graduate school and an internship at an investment research firm, Isabelle joined Pipaya (now Prosperity) as an Analyst in September 2022. In her spare time, Isabelle enjoys running, weightlifting, playing the piano, and trying new restaurants in DC.

EXPERTISE: Quality of Earnings

  • Favorite thing about my job: Solving complex problems and being an advisor to our clients!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Pasta Bolognese
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: CorePower Yoga Sculpt classes
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Fitness challenges! I’m currently training for a Hyrox AND half marathon this spring.
  • I have an irrational fear of: sports mascots
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: FKJ at Echostage in DC
  • What would your last meal be? Sushi or my Mom’s Sunday Sauce with pasta.

name: Jacob Eminger
body_html:
Jacob graduated from the University of Iowa in December of 2019 with a bachelor’s degree in Accounting and Finance. Prior to Prosperity Partners, Jacob analyzed financial statements of group captive insurance companies and worked as a staff accountant. He joined Prosperity Partners in January of 2020 as an Accounting and Tax Associate and is currently pursuing his CPA.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance and Financial Reporting

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The team and culture. While we are always working through deadlines and complex tax and accounting issues, everyone firm is extremely helpful and easy to work with. While we are successful at work, we also like to have fun together outside of work and at company outings.
  • Favorite Sport to play: Golf and Basketball
  • Favorite Vacation: Lake house trips to Minocqua, WI.
  • What would your last meal be: Italian
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners Outing: The company retreat at Camp Aramoni

name: Jacob Petit
body_html:
Jacob Petit graduated from Lewis University with a Major in Accounting and a Double Minor in Finance and Computer Science. After completing two tax internships during his undergrad, the second internship being a year-long internship with Prosperity, he joined the firm full time in December 2025. As a Tax Associate, he is involved in the preparation of both individual and business returns. In his spare time, Jacob enjoys playing frisbee golf and watching a variety of sports including basketball, football, and Formula 1.

EXPERTISE: Tax Generalist

  • Favorite thing about my job: Being new to the accounting field, Prosperity Partners has given me a place to grow and build upon my technical skills. Having a communicative and responsive group of team members will allow me to continue to grow into the tax professional I hope to be one day!
  • Favorite workout: My favorite workout is the back squat because I do not want to have a big upper body and small legs….
  • Favorite sport to play: My favorite sport to play is basketball. I played all throughout middle school and high school and still enjoy playing pick up when the weather allows.

name: Jacqueline Lamas
body_html:
Jacqueline joined Prosperity Partners in December 2021 as an Office Manager and Tax Liaison. She assists with the administrative components of the office along with tax services. Jacqueline holds a bachelor’s in business administration from DePaul University. Prior to Prosperity Partners, Jacqueline was a manager at the East Bank Club. Jacqueline is passionate about animals and in her spare time is establishing a dog daycare business.

EXPERTISE: Administration & Customer Service

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Work – Life Balance. I have control and freedom within my position where I never feel micromanaged. Prosperity Partners sets you up with an environment to produce high quality work and always encourages you to pursue your outside interests and passions.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? – A cheesy egg sandwich for breakfast. With a runny yolk of course.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? -Dog sitting & floral design
  • Favorite movie quote: “Ursula, I found your scrunchy.” – George of the Jungle
  • I have an irrational fear of: Tornadoes… Very midwestern of me.

name: James Martin
body_html:
James Martin graduated from Eastern Michigan University with a BA in Accounting and an MS in Accounting Information Systems. He worked for Chrysler Financial Corporation prior to joining Deloitte as a Senior Manager. In 2002, he began at Cendrowski Corporate Advisors, and now serves as a Senior Manager with Prosperity Partners.

EXPERTISE: Financial Accounting, Internal controls and business processes, Forensic Accounting, Litigation support

  • Favorite thing about my job: What I enjoy most about my job is the variety of cases and matters with which I am involved. Every day is different in some way.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? The best dish I can cook is New England Clam Chowder. I learned the recipe from the restaurant I worked at in high school.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: When I was in high school, I traveled with our Spanish class to the Yucatan Peninsula. This was before Cancun turned into the destination resort it is today, and was still a small, quiet beach town. We toured the Mayan sites, and it was beautiful.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Since 2001 I have coached the ACHA Men’s Division 2 Hockey team at Michigan State University! We compete against other collegiate teams across the United States.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My favorite concert I attended was Metallica with Ted Nugent and Kid Rock on 12/31/1999, the Millenium New Year, at the Pontiac Silverdome. Great show, but the angst of the Y2K event added an element of suspense to the evening!
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? If I could have dinner with one Marvel character it would be Blackagar Boltagon because he wouldn’t say anything (hopefully).

CERTIFICATIONS

  • CFE – Certified Fraud Examiner
  • CIA – Certified Internal Auditor
  • CMA – Certified Management Accountant

name: Jared Frankel
body_html:
Jared graduated Summa Cum Laude from the State University of New York at Old Westbury with a Bachelor’s in Accounting. Before embarking on his public accounting career in 2013, he gained diverse experience in the music industry, theatrical exhibition management, and the non-profit sector, emphasizing hunger abatement.  With a unique blend of professional experiences, Jared has brought a fresh perspective to his work in accounting. When he’s not crunching numbers, you can find this native New Yorker passionately advocating for the superiority of bagels from New York City and Long Island – a topic he’s always eager to discuss.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance and Planning, Planning for Stock Options and Equity, High Net Worth & Ultra-High Net Worth Individual Tax needs

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: I love the collaborative nature of the work that we do for our clients, and the incredible familial dynamic that the entire team embodies.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? At great risk of consternation from my mother (who taught me how to cook, and to cook well), I’d have to say Buttered Noodles
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Hands down, three weeks trekking through Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, and Thailand
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? “How Do I Account for This?”

name: Jason Sachs
body_html:
Jason Sachs graduated from Indiana University with a bachelor’s degree in Kinesiology and a focus in Sports Broadcast.  His career path changed when the Chicago Shamrox went under and he found his way into IT from a Craigslist posting.  Jason joined Prosperity Partners in 2023 as the Director of IT to help drive the strategic side of technology.

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: As cliché as it sounds – it’s the team.  Since day one my opinions and work have been valued like I have never seen before.  Everyone works hard for the same common goal and we all have fun doing it.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Honey Sriracha Chicken
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Aquarist and Stand Up Comedy
  • Favorite movie quote: “And I’m back in the game …..”
  • What would your last meal be? Hot dogs with ketchup.  Yes, I am from Chicago
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Soccer lifer

name: Jayna Sheth
body_html:
Jayna Sheth serves as a Verification Associate at Prosperity where she applies a rigorous, analytical approach to complex data verification. She earned her Bachelor of Commerce in Banking and Insurance from Thakur College of Science and Commerce following her foundational studies at K.E.S. Shroff College and Seth Juggilal Poddar Academy. With a career highlighted by a significant tenure at SurePrep (Thomson Reuters), Jayna specializes in U.S. tax data verification and software quality assurance. Her experience includes conducting critical testing for Review Wizard 2.0 and managing large-scale operations during peak seasons, where she led teams of up to 20 contractors. Jayna is recognized for her commitment to precision, her proactive approach to problem-solving, and her ability to mentor junior professionals to achieve high-standard results.

Expertise: US Tax Data Verification, Technical Software Proficiency, Team Leadership & Mentorship, Team Building & Engagement

  • Favorite thing about my job: I genuinely enjoy the “detective work” involved in my role, getting to dive deep into the nuances of both new and existing US tax-related documents. Every document is a chance to learn something new!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? If we’re having a potluck, I’m your go-to! I whip up a mean Lasagna and creamy pasta, but I also love putting together a fresh, vibrant burrito bowl.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? I have a major case of wanderlust. My highlights include the rugged serenity of a solo trip to Spiti Valley, the vibes of Bangalore, Hyderabad, and the dazzling skyline of Dubai & Vietnam!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I’m a big believer in spreading love. I bake my own birthday cake to share with family and friends.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? When I’m not verifying data, you’ll find me reading, cooking, or out riding bikes. I’m also a bit of a numismatist – I love collecting global currencies from my travels!
  • I have an irrational fear of… swimming in the ocean! Even though I know how to swim perfectly well, the vastness of the open sea is a “no no” from me.

name: Jeff Thomas
body_html:
jeff@prosperityllc.com

Jeff Thomas, a Prosperity Partners Tax Partner, prides himself on two primary principles: his accessibility and providing honest and insightful feedback. As a tax generalist, Jeff’s client list is quite expansive, ranging from twenty-something-year-old tech entrepreneurs to ninety-something-year-old retirees. Jeff has proven to have the breadth of knowledge his clients demand at a value they deserve.

While describing himself as a tax generalist, Jeff has established a deep understanding in several areas to better service his clients. Specifically, Jeff has extensive experience consulting for clients with various stock options and equity awards. This level of expertise allows him to partner with his clients and their respective wealth advisors to navigate the complex rules proactively and confidently. His goal is to help educate his clients so they can make informed decisions consistent with their investment strategies.

Jeff also has a long history of working with expatriates and foreign nationals. With the help of his talented colleagues, Jeff has worked with countless clients navigating the technical laws on foreign taxation while maintaining the global perspective they truly value. When coupled with increasing IRS scrutiny, Jeff’s ability to simplify these nuanced rules provides his clients the comfort of knowing that they are fully compliant.

Practicing since 2005, Jeff has a bachelor’s degree from the University of Wisconsin – Eau Claire and a master’s of science in taxation from DePaul University.

When not in the office, Jeff is either chasing after, or being chased by, his three crazy kids. As his wife will quickly tell you, he also spends far too many hours riding his bike, frequently trying to squeeze in another century ride before the kid’s basketball, soccer, swimming, baseball, gymnastics…

EXPERTISE: Strategic tax planning for stock options and equity awards, expats and foreign nationals, business startups, and early retirement

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Seeing my colleagues grow personally and professionally
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners outing: Our 15-year anniversary retreat; epic game of Cards Against Humanity!
  • Desert island book: “Catcher in the Rye”
  • Last Meal: Thanksgiving sides; hold the turkey
  • Favorite movie quote: “You’ll have bad times, but it’ll always wake you up to the good stuff you weren’t paying attention to.” Sean Maguire in Goodwill Hunting
  • Favorite trip: Mountain biking from Durango, CO to Moab, UT; so many stories
  • Favorite way to celebrate by birthday: A nice long bike ride followed by a day with the family
  • Favorite concert: Crosby, Stills, Nash and Young with my dad; it was my first ever concert
  • Favorite workout: An all-out paceline cycling with the local groups, with me winning all of the sprints!

name: Jen Daudelin
body_html:
Jen Daudelin is a Tax Associate with over four years of experience primarily preparing personal and partnership tax returns. She began her career in bookkeeping for small businesses, then gained public service experience as an Assistant Town Clerk. She advanced at a regional housing authority from Accounts Payable Clerk to Senior Staff Accountant, where she managed payroll, HR benefits, and contributed to the Section 8 housing program. Jen holds an Associate’s Degree in Accounting from Champlain College. In her free time, she enjoys reading, baking, making strawberry jam (just like her Grandma used to make!), walking her dog, and spending time with her family.

EXPERTISE: Individual & Partnership Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people that I work with and the support they provide.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: It’s a tie between my honeymoon in Maui, HI and our most recent family trip to Disney World (I’ve wanted to go there my whole life)!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Niall Horan, The Show: Live on Tour
  • Desert Island Book: 28 Summers by Elin Hilderbrand (actually almost any of her books)!
  • Irrational Fear: Snakes!
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “My mama always said, ‘Life was like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re gonna get’” – Forrest Gump

name: Jennifer Robin
body_html:
Jennifer is a Certified Public Accountant specializing in tax compliance and consulting for high-net- worth individuals and small businesses. She holds a degree in business economics with an accounting emphasis from the University of California, Santa Barbara. Jennifer is a member of the California Society of Certified Public Accountants (CalCPA) and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA). She actively participates in CalCPA’s affinity program, enhancing her professional network and skills. Utilizing her extensive experience, Jennifer assists clients with diverse tax and accounting needs, offering strategic guidance tailored to their specific situations. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family and friends, reading, and traveling.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance and Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: The team is positive and collaborative, working together to meet deadlines. No task is too big or too small – everyone is always willing to support each other.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The Magic Castle in Hollywood, CA. It was so fun to get all dressed up and be dazzled with awesome illusions. Fun fact: my husband hired a magician and proposed to me at The Magic Castle years before.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Cuba! It felt like time had stopped in the 1950’s – beautifully restored classic cars on the roads and no one was buried in their phones. All the locals were vibrant and enjoying life while being very welcoming to tourists.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be?: Ticket to Ride: Europe – My husband and I have been all over Europe by train, even missing our first long train ride between Paris and Amsterdam. Since then we are always very early to train stations and have never missed a train.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour. I’ve been a fan of Taylor Swift since her country albums and it was incredible to watch a concert that takes you through her entire discography.

name: Jennings Fussell
body_html:
Jennings Fussell graduated from the University of Alabama in 2016 with a Bachelor’s in Accounting. He then went on to the University of Alabama at Birmingham where he earned a Master’s of Accountancy in 2017. Jennings joined Prosperity Partners in 2025 after beginning his career in public accounting as an auditor, as well as time spent in private industry. Jennings believes that providing clients with excellent quality service and insight is key in assisting them in their success. Outside of work, he enjoys checking out new restaurants around Chicago and spending time on Lake Michigan!

EXPERTISE: Small Business Accounting, Financial Reporting & Analysis, Financial Statement Preparation

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite thing about my job is the variety of work and industry I am exposed to. Each day there is a new challenge. Also, everyone at Prosperity has been very welcoming!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation I have taken was when a few friends and I sailed around the Virgin Islands for New Years!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? A recent hobby I have gotten into is hot yoga. It is great to clear the mind, but also feel that I have done a very intense workout.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way of celebrating my birthday is with dinner at Topo Gigio and then flying out somewhere warm since my birthday is in February.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My favorite concert I attended was Jimmy Buffet back in 2012.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: My favorite workout is a Barry’s class. The music and high energy get me ready to take on the day!

name: Jenny Lewis
body_html:
Jenny Lewis graduated from the University of Utah with a Bachelors in Accounting and is a licensed CPA in the state of Virginia. She started her career at Ernst & Young, working in both Audit and Transaction Advisory Services before leaving public accounting to support small businesses in the government contracting space. She was a Controller for 10 years and then joined Pipaya (now Prosperity) in 2022. She recently moved from Virginia to Buffalo, NY, where she enjoys shoveling snow with her teenager.

EXPERTISE: Financial Due Diligence, Small Business Controllership, Financial Modeling and Forecasting

  • Favorite thing about my job: The fantastic teams I get to work with, as well as helping clients navigate the M&A process as an advisor, sounding board, accountant – whatever they need!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? According to my kid – mac and cheese.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Tug-of-war with my dog.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Inconceivable!” – The Princess Bride
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Vieques, Puerto Rico to see the bioluminescent bay with my son when he was 9. Pure magic.

name: Jeremy Dubow
body_html:
Jeremy Dubow is Prosperity Partners’ Chief Executive Officer. He manages the company and is responsible for its strategic direction, growth initiatives and talent development. He began his career at Arthur Andersen before co-founding Prosperity in 2003.

As a tax expert, he provides sophisticated tax planning and consulting services to technology entrepreneurs and their enterprises, high net worth individuals and family offices. Jeremy also co-leads Prosperity’s mergers and acquisitions practice, advising business owners throughout the sales process.

Jeremy routinely speaks on behalf of the IL CPA Society and AICPA on a variety of tax technical topics and is actively involved in the ILCPAS tax committees. During his spare time, he enjoys spending time with his family, cycling and playing pickleball; he is also Prosperity’s premier table tennis player.

EXPERTISE: Mergers & Acquisitions, Ultra-high Net Worth Tax Planning, Equity Compensation, Partnership Taxation, Estate Planning, State & Local Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people. I love watching our diverse, talented team ascend through the profession and turn a job into a life-long career.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Ping pong at Spin. I’d play daily if I had the opportunity and the time. Runner-up, and only because I lost, is the one-mile race with Alyvia on my 40th birthday. The video documenting my crushing defeat is preserved for posterity.
  • Desert island book: “Once a Runner.” True story – at 25 years old, I took a sabbatical from working at Arthur Andersen to climb Mt. Aconcagua, the tallest mountain in the Western hemisphere, and brought for the three-week trek “Once a Runner,” three juggling balls and an iPod.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I love all active vacations. Relaxation for me is hours on a bike or hiking in nature.
  • What is your current hobby? Pickleball. I’m really into it and enjoy seeing the benefit of all my youth tennis lessons.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? “Driven”
  • Favorite quote: “Training over time beats talent.” Thank you, Coach Hanson.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Taylor Swift’s Era’s Tour with my daughter. Cannot beat a daddy-daughter date night to see an artist at the top of her game.

Honors & Awards

  • Illinois CPA Society Distinguished Service Award Winner
  • Arthur M Seltzer Accounting Award, Washington University in St. Louis, awarded to the outstanding senior in accounting
  • Forbes Best-In-State CPA 2025, 2026

Civic

  • Former Chair, Illinois CPA Society Taxation Flow-Through Entities Committee
  • Former Chair, Illinois CPA Society Tax Executive Committee
  • Former Chair, Washington University W Club Executive Committee of Chicago
  • Former Treasurer, Chicago Area Runner’s Association

Education

  • The John Marshall Law School, Master of Science in Tax Law, with honors (2010)
  • Washington University in St. Louis BSBA, summa cum laude (1998)
  • Class Valedictorian, John M Olin School of Business
  • 5-Time GTE Academic All-American, Cross Country and Track & Field

name: Jessica Attig
body_html:
Jessica Attig graduated from the University of Vermont with a double concentration in Accounting and Finance. During her undergrad, she also spent time studying Finance at the University of Adelaide in Adelaide, Australia. She began an internship at Danaher Attig and Plante PLC during her senior year of high school and continued through college before joining the firm full-time! Jessica currently serves as a Supervising Senior Tax Associate with Prosperity Partners. Outside of work, Jessica enjoys spending time outdoors with her family and their golden retriever – whether it’s walking for ice cream or coffee, attending local concerts, or exploring farmers markets!

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Preparation & Review

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love the team I work with and the overall environment! The continuous support, positivity, and fun-filled atmosphere makes even the busiest days enjoyable.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: We went on a lunch cruise on Lake Champlain aboard the Spirit of Ethan Allen. It was a gorgeous summer day, and the views of the Adirondacks and Green Mountains were spectacular!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: It is hard to choose just one! Some of my favorites include my honeymoon in Hawaii, backpacking in New Zealand, or car-camping in the Outback to see Uluru (Ayers Rock). Each vacation was unique – Hawaii was all about relaxing on the beach and trying different restaurants and food trucks, while New Zealand and the Outback were full of adventures, including skydiving, hiking to see jaw-dropping views, and spotting incredible wildlife.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Going on a long weekend getaway. My husband and I have birthdays just a few weeks apart, so we try to plan a trip within driving distance to celebrate. So far, we have visited Ogunquit, Maine, Niagara Falls, and Pittsburgh to catch a Steelers game!
  • I have an irrational fear of: Wasps. When I was younger, my friends and I were on a small island and one of them stepped on an underground nest. Being trapped on an island with an angry swarm definitely intensified my fear!
  • What would your last meal be? Artichoke eggs benedict with a perfectly made flat white.

name: Jessica Tuquero
body_html:
Jessica Tuquero graduated from Loyola University Chicago with a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance and Information Systems. In addition to her education in Chicago, she studied internationally for a year in Rome and Sydney! While in college, Jessica was on Loyola’s competitive dance team, a resident assistant, and an intern at Prosperity Partners in the fall of her senior year. Since joining the firm full-time, she now focuses on family office services and deals with high-net-worth individual’s finance and accounting matters. When not in the office, Jessica is either training for a marathon, building a podcast, or cheering on the Baltimore Ravens to win another Super Bowl!

EXPERTISE: Financial Reporting, Financial Analysis, Personal Accounting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Interacting with clients to understand their needs and figuring out ways that I can support them. It’s exciting to get exposure to new industries, businesses systems, and processes!
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why: A no brainer – Doctor Strange. I’d end up becoming best buds with the sorcerer and have him time travel me into the future.
  • Favorite movie quote: “You got a dream, you gotta protect it.” – The Pursuit of Happyness
  • What is the best dish you can cook: Salmon rice bowl!
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be: Monopoly. It’s always funny to see how intense the game turns into at the end.

name: Joey Cuda
body_html:
Joey Cuda graduated from the University of Baylor with a B.S in Biology, later receiving his Certificate in Accounting from the University of Virginia. He started his accounting career in assurance services at BDO, serving Private Equity and Government Contracting clients before joining Pipaya in 2017. At Pipaya (now Prosperity) he leads Sell-Side, Buy-Side, and M&A consulting projects. He is a licensed CPA in the state of Virginia. Outside of work, Joey enjoys traveling to national parks, watching baseball and college football, and visiting theme parks with his wife.

EXPERTISE: Mergers and Acquisitions, Government Contracting

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people – I enjoy leading and developing our internal teams and helping our clients succeed at M&A.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I created a map of bucket list items to help me plan trips. I want to visit every national park, every minor and major league baseball stadium, and ride the top 300 roller coasters in the US!
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Our honeymoon in the Maldives. A great romantic getaway with beautiful weather and relaxation.
  • What would your last meal be? Chicken Nanban made by my wife.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Our annual retreat in Breckenridge! It is a wonderful time to enjoy some great skiing and build relationships with our team.

name: Joey Mainello
body_html:
Joey Mainello graduated from Pennsylvania State University (Capital College) in 2020 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance. He joined the firm in 2021 after beginning his career in finance as an Analyst for a Foodservice company. Outside of work, Joey enjoys spending time with his wife, Maggie, and their golden retriever, Willa. He also enjoys outdoor activities like kayaking, biking, and going to sporting events.

EXPERTISE: Merger and Acquisitions (ADG), Quality of Earnings Analysis, Financial Accounting

  • Favorite thing about my job: The team and our clients. The variety in our daily workflows allows for no day or deal to be the same! I enjoy building relationships with our clients, understanding their businesses, and providing support and advising them throughout the transaction process.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Our honeymoon to Saint Lucia, where we enjoyed the beautiful beaches, went on catamaran excursions around the island, and visited the iconic Pitons.
  • What would your last meal be? My family’s recipe for homemade gnocchi
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Golf
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Our team’s Breckenridge, Colorado offsite. It’s a great time of year for the team to connect, team build, and play some card games!

name: John Alfonsi
body_html:
John Alfonsi graduated from the University of Michigan-Dearborn with a concentration in Accounting. He also has a Master’s of Science in Taxation from Walsh College, where he was the Research Institute of America Graduate Tax Award recipient. He brings over 40 years of experience in tax and advisory services, focusing his practice on business valuation, economic damages, and tax planning and consulting for pass-through entities. John is a recognized financial expert in federal and various state circuit courts across the country. In his spare time, he is an adjunct professor at his Alma Mater, teaching master’s degree courses in taxation and valuation.

EXPERTISE

  • Business valuation for business and marital divorce purposes, estate/gift/income tax planning and compliance, buy-sell agreements, business mergers and acquisitions
  • Economic damages calculations including lost profits and lost value in matters involving breach of contract, IP infringement, and other contractual claims
  • Tax planning and compliance for investment entities including venture capital funds, hedge funds, real estate ownership and operation, and private equity funds
  • Succession planning consulting

FUN FACTS

  • Favorite thing about my job? When performing valuations, I get to learn about different businesses and the industries they operate in. I’ve learned about industries ranging from genome sequencing to steel processing – and everything in between!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? My own concoction I refer to as “Pasta Giovanni”. Ground Italian sausage with green, red, and yellow peppers and onions sauteed in olive oil and garlic, served over linguine aglio e olio. Perfect with a good red wine.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation is the one I have not taken yet – visiting Italy. My bucket list item is to visit the town my father came from (Frosinone, Italy) as well as Terrasini, Sicily where my mother’s family is from.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Anything music related! I played guitar in garage bands in high school and college. I still play but not nearly as often as I would like. My taste runs to blues/classic rock/punk/garage rock, but I will listen to most anything.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Leave the gun. Take the cannoli.” – The Godfather.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Iron Man/Tony Stark – genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist.

CERTIFICATIONS

  • CVA – Certified Valuation Analyst
  • ABV – Accredited in Business Valuation
  • CFF – Certified in Financial Forensics
  • CFE – Certified Fraud Examiner

name: John Rovegno
body_html:
John Rovegno graduated from St. John’s University with a Bachelors and Master’s Degree in Accounting. He brings over 15 years of experience in Tax and Advisory services, focusing on Income Tax provisions, Domestic and Foreign Corporate Tax compliance, and Partnerships. In his spare time, he enjoys chasing around his 3 young daughters to their respective sporting events and dance recitals.

EXPERTISE: Income Tax Provisions, Domestic and Foreign Corporate Reporting and Tax Compliance, Partnership Taxation, Corporate State and Local Tax

Favorite thing about my job: Getting a front row seat to how successful businesses are run. I get to solve complicated puzzles that somehow involve spreadsheets, footnotes, and laws written by people who clearly hate clarity. There’s also a quiet thrill in knowing you’ve saved a company real money while everyone else just sees “magic numbers.” Plus, nothing builds character like explaining why the tax answer is “it depends” and meaning it with your whole soul.

What is the best dish you can cook? My daughters will tell you it’s my famous grilled cheese ‘sandys’.

Favorite workout or sport to play: I played baseball starting from the age of 3 all the way through college. Although my MLB dreams fell a bit short, I was successful in getting a firm sponsored softball team up and running for a couple of seasons!

Favorite movie quote: “Leave the gun, take the cannoli.” – Peter Clemenza, The Godfather
Desert Island Book: The Alchemist by Paulo Coelho – “To realize one’s destiny is a person’s only real obligation.”

What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I own and operate a small wood working business with my wife. I design and build all different types of signs and logos, but primarily build different backdrops and party props for event planners.

Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: A backyard BBQ with friends and family, sitting poolside with my wife and three daughters.

name: John Walton
body_html:
John joined Prosperity Partners through its merger with Farkouh, Furman & Faccio, LLP (FF&F), but initially joined the FF&F team in 2018 after two years with CPI Associates, Inc. As a Tax Manager, he provides tax compliance and advisory services for primarily small businesses, high-net–worth individuals, trusts, estates, and foundations. John’s fiduciary tax expertise includes accounting for trusts and estates, an area in which he provides added value particularly for nonprofessional trustees of such fiduciary entities.

Inquisitive and detail–oriented, John attributes his professional success to mentors who emphasized attention to detail. His approach to client service is simple: listen intently and be proactive. Something John enjoys about his work with high–net–worth individuals, trusts, and estates is that he can help clients support their loved ones and favorite charitable causes through gift tax and other generational wealth planning strategies.

Currently, John lives with his wife in New Jersey, where he enjoys the abundance of local farms and fresh produce. In his downtime, he enjoys cooking, movies, and bowling.

Designations:

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) – New Jersey
  • Notary Public – New York County, NY
  • Member of The New Jersey Society of Certified Public Accountants (NJSCPA)

name: Jonathan Yuen
body_html:
Jonathan graduated from CUNY Brooklyn College with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and later obtained his Master’s in Accounting from the same college. His career began in February 2014 at Farkouh, Furman & Faccio LLP (now Prosperity Partners) as a Tax Intern. He’s been with the firm ever since, and currently serves as a Tax Supervisor. Jonathan provides Tax Compliance and Advisory services for high-net-worth individuals, pass-through entities, and corporations.

EXPERTISE: High-Net-Worth Individuals, Pass-through Entities, Corporations, International Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: I value my interactions with my colleagues. Even the most mundane of days are made interesting with this group. And during the busier seasons, that’s when they really matter.
  • What would your last meal be? An all-you-can-eat Seafood Buffet!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I spent most of my middle school and high school days playing handball (not the Olympic sport). I’m slower now, but it’s still a good workout.
  • Favorite movie quote: “It’s not who you are underneath, but what you do that defines you.” – Batman, Batman Begins (2005)
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Back in 2023, when the firm attended the JPM Corporate Challenge 5k held in Central Park!

name: Jose Ruth
body_html:
Jose graduated from Grand View University with a degree in Applied Mathematics. While at Grand View University, Jose also competed on the baseball team. He then went on to graduate from Drake University with a master’s degree in Accounting and then obtained his CPA. After beginning his career holding a variety of industry accounting positions, he joined the firm as a senior associate in 2023 focusing on client accounting services. In his spare time he enjoys family time, being active and playing golf.

EXPERTISE: Small business accounting, financial reporting and analysis, financial statement preparation

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The team – everyone is compassionate, smart and willing to go the extra mile
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My honeymoon in Jamaica which was delayed by two years thanks to Covid
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? The list is embarrassingly extensive I’ll go with, “Party in the USA” – Miley Cyrus
  • I have an irrational fear of: Giant icicles falling from skyscrapers
  • What would your last meal be? Tough question. At the end of the day I would go with a brunch buffet – I’m a sucker for cinnamon rolls and pancakes.

name: Joseph Belcher
body_html:
Joe Belcher earned his Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting from Mount St. Mary’s University, followed a few years later by completing his MBA from “The Mount” as well. Starting his career just before the Great Recession, Joe witnessed firsthand the vital role a trusted CPA plays in guiding clients through uncertain times. This experience shaped his commitment to building strong, collaborative relationships with each of his clients, providing tailored financial solutions, and delivering peace of mind in an ever-changing economic landscape. When he’s not serving his clients, Joe enjoys spending quality time with his wife and two boys, embracing the great outdoors, and creating lasting memories with his family. His personal and professional lives are grounded in values of trust, honesty, and a commitment to helping others succeed.

  • EXPERTISE: Individual & Business Tax, Tax Planning Strategies, Small Business Accounting
  • Favorite thing about my job: Helping clients understand taxes and how proactive planning can reduce a client’s tax liability.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I’m extremely proud of my Sunday sauce pasta which I make from scratch.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Jimmy Eat World 10-year Anniversary Tour of the Futures album. This is a top ten favorite album for me. I had no idea it was an anniversary tour, as my brother bought the tickets and surprised me. Jimmy played the entire Futures album plus their other hits for the encore – once in a lifetime experience!
  • I have an irrational fear of: Spiders! I watched Arachnophobia way too young as a child and still to this day hate spiders.

name: Joseph Gottlieb
body_html:
Joseph joined Prosperity Partners in February 2021 as a Tax Manager. He is a tax generalist focusing primarily on individual and flow-through entity tax compliance. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, Joseph spent over 5 years at a mid-market public accounting firm. In 2012, he received his master’s degree from DePaul University with a focus in accounting. His industry focus is family office, high net worth individuals, private equity, and real estate. Prior to getting into public accounting, Joseph was in marketing in New York City. In his spare time, Joseph enjoys spending time with his two beautiful daughters.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance, Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The people and the freedom. You will not be micromanaged and have complete control of your workload.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Tough call, but African safari in Kenya/Tanzania just beats out backpacking through Southeast Asia
  • I have an irrational fear of: Free falling. Bungee jumping was maybe the worst thing I’ve ever done in my life.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play?  Now it’s Pickleball. I’m one of those people.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Used to be travelling as I’ve been to over 30 countries, but now my free time is with my kids or the Chicago Bears.
  • What would your last meal be?  The biggest seafood tower I could find.

name: Josh Harris
body_html:
Josh Harris is a co-founder of Prosperity Partners, where he leads the Client Accounting Services practice. He advises companies on various accounting matters, including financial analytics, reporting, and the development of Key Performance Indicators. Josh’s straightforward and high-value approach allows business owners to focus on their core operations while his team manages the accounting, monthly close, and financial analysis. With a background successfully running a professional services firm and an entrepreneurial spirit, Josh brings a fresh and innovative perspective to his work. His clients appreciate his accessibility and clear communication throughout their engagements. Besides client service, Josh spearheads the strategic recruitment initiative at Prosperity Partners and maintains responsibility for all aspects of the hiring process.

Before co-founding Prosperity Partners in 2003, Josh worked in the middle market tax groups at Arthur Andersen and Deloitte. Outside of work, Josh enjoys various water sports, spending quality time with his family, and volunteering in his community.

Professional & Civic Affiliations

  • Illinois Certified Public Accountant
  • Beta Gamma Sigma, International Honor Society, University of Iowa Chapter

Education: University of Iowa, B.B.A.

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: It has been said that a firm that plays together stays together. At Prosperity Partners, I enjoy the inclusivity of the culture and participating in the numerous firm-wide events. Managing deadlines, multiple client requests, and delivering complex projects are much easier when you know, respect and genuinely like your teammates on the engagement with you. Having an opportunity to interact outside of the office enables the trust and care needed to consistently deliver high value outcomes to our clients.
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners outing you’ve been on: For the 15-year firm anniversary, we rented a “mansion” in southwest Michigan and had an opportunity to cook a meal together, share stories of the past, present, and what we hoped for the future. Those stories celebrated both the triumphs and a few comical failures along the Prosperity Partners pathway. The evening progressed with games designed to get to know each one of us better and celebrate what each of us uniquely offers the company. My personal highlight was that none of this was organized by management, the format and agenda were driven entirely by the associates.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Paddleboarding on the blue waters of West Lake Okoboji, IA in the early morning hours when it is just you, your board, a few seagulls, and an opportunity to glide on the water for as long as your arms and core will take you.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Listening to Jimmy Buffet strum his guitar in the right field bleachers for the first-ever concert at Wrigley Field. His tribute to Steve Goodman through the rendition of his song City of New Orleans still echoes in my ears every time I sit in those bleachers.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Backgammon. Your play relies on elements of luck, skill and the other player’s moves, which parallels much of the world we encounter each day.

name: Josh Prince
body_html:
jprince@prosperityllc.com

Joshua Prince is a Tax Partner at Prosperity Partners. He is an experienced advisor providing sophisticated tax consulting and compliance services to mid-sized businesses, their owners, and high-net-worth individuals. Josh joined Prosperity Partners in January 2024 after spending six years at a large local firm, where he was promoted to Partner in 2023. He previously worked at RSM and PwC, working in their respective Private Client Service groups.

With more than 13 years of experience, Josh helps clients formulate tax planning strategies for their personal and business needs. He helps clients stay current on tax developments and trends, optimizes tax strategies, and minimizes tax liabilities. Josh is a well-rounded tax professional who advises on a variety of tax issues, including entity selection, partnership and S-corporation taxation, tax planning and projections, foreign reporting, state and local considerations, government tax audits, and federal tax credits. He also has wide industry experience having advised clients in real estate, professional and consulting services, and family offices.

Josh focuses on understanding his clients’ unique needs and challenges. Rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach, he tailors a solution to fit the client’s specific circumstances.

Josh is actively involved in the Illinois CPA Society and is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants.

Outside of work, Josh enjoys spending time with his family, and actively participating in his community.

EXPERTISE: Partnership and S-corporation taxation, closely held businesses and owners, high-net-worth individuals

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: As cliche as it sounds, the culture and its people. It’s a young and motivated group aiming to build a leading accounting firm.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? This has definitely evolved over the years – traveling, participating in various sports (biking, tennis, basketball, golf), fantasy sports, and maintaining a coral reef aquarium. I’ve also had a passion in entrepreneurial businesses and investment opportunities. Currently, it’s about getting our kids to their weekly lessons and activities.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? My favorite board game is Risk, an all-time classic that requires planning, weighing risks, and anticipating opponents’ moves. I enjoy the strategic thinking and measured approach to risk and reward, and constantly adapting to the changing landscape.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: With friends and family, enjoying good food and drinks
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: House/electronic music concerts in the early 2010’s!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Either golf or basketball. Pickleball is fun too.

name: Judy Deng
body_html:
Judy graduated from Purdue University with a Bachelor’s Degree (2020) and Master’s Degree (2021) in Accounting. Judy began her career as a Tax Accountant at a mid-sized public accounting firm in Chicago focusing on Partnerships, Individuals, and Not-for-Profit Tax Compliance. After 4 years with the firm, she joined Prosperity Partners in 2025 as a Senior Tax Associate. Originally from San Jose, California, Judy has been living in Chicago since graduation. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with friends and family, cooking, and playing with her cat, Toast!

EXPERTISE: Individual and Business Tax Compliance, Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people and culture – working with other empathetic and supportive teammates makes work much more enjoyable and rewarding. Free snacks is a close second!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Getting hot pot for dinner and spending the night in playing party games or board games with friends.
  • What would your last meal be? AYCE Korean BBQ
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Hmm.. Probably birria tacos. I’ve been told I also make a delicious kimchi fried rice.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I enjoy anything arts & crafts! Lately I have been into gel nail art, crochet kits, and painting.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I enjoy snowboarding (casually) and have been going every winter for the last 10 years or so.

name: Julia Walther
body_html:
Julia is an accomplished tax manager specializing in trust and estates, tax compliance, and business planning. She graduated from UCSB with a bachelor’s degree in Global Studies and in 2015 earned her master’s in business taxation from USC. Beyond the office, she serves as Managing Director at the Santa Barbara Beekeepers Association and serves on the local and state-wide committees at the California Society of CPA’s (CalCPA). Julia is passionate about mentoring young professionals and promoting sustainability through beekeeping.

EXPERTISE:  Tax Compliance and Planning for Businesses, Estates, Trusts and High-Net-Worth Individuals

  • Favorite thing about my job: Helping people face their rational fear of taxes.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Pottery and bees.
  • Favorite movie quote: “The dude abides”
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why?  Well, I prefer brunch, and I would like to marvel at Fyodor Dostoevsky.

name: Justin Shelman
body_html:
jshelman@prosperityllc.com

Justin Shelman is a Tax Partner and leads Prosperity Partners’ High Net Worth & Family Office tax group. As a firm leader and team mentor, he implements the company’s strategic goals and develops the next generation of leaders. Justin began his career in St. Louis after graduating from Kentucky Wesleyan College and currently practices in Prosperity’s Chicago headquarters. He has a Masters of Science in Taxation from DePaul University.

Justin advises his clients on a range of tax planning and structuring opportunities. Focused on high earners and affluent families, Justin uses his deep knowledge of federal and state tax law to provide multi-generational income and estate planning, state residency analysis and tax preparation services for families and their sophisticated entity structures. Notably, Justin is proactive, connects with his clients and their teams and is accessible.

Justin actively participates in the IL CPA Society’s State and Local Taxation committee, speaking regularly on emerging technical issues. He enjoys spending time with his wife and dog, golfing and indulging in a nice bottle of red wine with friends and family.

EXPERTISE: Ultra-high Net Worth Tax Planning, Family Office Structuring and Tax Compliance, Estate Planning, State & Local Taxation, Flow-through Taxation, Aircraft Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Simple – our people. While I enjoy the sophisticated work and unique opportunities, I’ve never been more connected to or motivated by a stronger group of colleagues.
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners outing you’ve been on: With many great memories, it’s hard to select just one; however, our 15-year anniversary event stands out. The firm rented-out a Michigan-located Bed & Breakfast and organized fun and activities such as paintball, hiking and dining out. The weekend culminated with an amazing feast, prepared by our entire team, and included a competitive game of Cards Against Humanity.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I’ve traveled extensively, but last year with my wife I embarked on a “Tour of Northern California,” including hiking in Yosemite National Park, wine tasting in Napa, and golfing at three bucket list courses – Pasatiempo, Pebble Beach and Olympic Club. Capping an incredible week, we celebrated our friends’ wedding in Monterrey.
  • What are your passions and hobbies? Wine and golf! I have long-term goals of obtaining my Sommelier certificate and qualifying for a USGA event.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Baxter, you know I don’t speak Spanish!” – Ron Burgundy, Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy. Don’t judge me – there’s a lot of downtime with college golf and this movie always brings back great memories with my teammates!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Great red wine and a home-cooked meal with my wife and dog.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My wife and I are huge Old Dominion fans and have seen them live several times. In Chicago on a cross-country tour, the band sidelined their hits to spend a few minutes sharing the story of their journey from humble songwriters to national headliners. It was an amazing evening with incredible music. Honorable mention would be two of my favorite concerts at Soldier Field – Coldplay and Taylor Swift.

Civic

  • Member, Illinois CPA Society State and Local Taxation Committee
  • Member, Illinois CPA Society State and Local Taxation Conference Content Advisory Board

Education

  • DePaul University, Master of Science in Taxation (2010)
  • Kentucky Wesleyan College, Bachelor of Science – Accounting (2010)

name: Karen Maddaloni
body_html:
Karen Maddaloni graduated Cum Laude from Bernard Baruch College in 2007, earning a Bachelor of Arts in Spanish with a Minor in Psychology.
