Karen brings over 20 years of experience in the administrative field, joining the New York team in December of 2011 as an Administrative Assistant before being promoted to the role of Firm Administrator in 2015. In 2023, she was promoted to the role of Director of Staff Administration, where she oversees the New York Administrative team with a concentration in resource management. Karen has over 10 years’ experience in staffing and scheduling client engagements based on complexity and staff expertise. In her free time, her favorite thing to do is to travel to new places and take road trips with her family.

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: My favorite thing about my job is having the opportunity to collaborate with all members of the team, from the interns to members within leadership. I personally enjoy that every day is different from the one prior regardless of any challenges that may come along the way, as it’s an opportunity to grow both personally and professionally.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The 2025 Summer picnic, as it gave us all an opportunity to spend the day away from our desks to engage in fun outdoor activities surrounded by the beauty of Central Park.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Marc Anthony’s concert at Barclays Center in November of 2019. My husband surprised me for my birthday with concert tickets. Singing his music along with the other fans and sharing the moment with my husband was just one of the most memorable experiences! I do have to mention that attending the Metallica concert with my husband and son was my second favorite concert. It was an unexpected and fun experience which I will always remember.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Our 2008 trip to Los Cabos, Mexico! Spending the week enjoying the amazing ocean views, snorkeling in the Sea of Cortez, and taking in the sunsets along with my husband was an unforgettable experience and one of our fondest memories together.

name: Kasie Dlubala
body_html:
Kasie joined the firm in 2024 as a Senior Tax Associate. She is a tax generalist who supports the team with a diverse tax background. Prior to joining Prosperity Partners, she spent the first 13 years of her career with mid-sized firms specializing in the real estate, hospitality, and professional services spaces. Kasie holds a bachelor’s and master’s of accounting from Southern Illinois University. In her spare time, Kasie loves spending time with her three daughters.

EXPERTISE: Individual & Business Tax, Compliance and Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The culture. I love that Prosperity Partners promotes a culture of learning where professionals are given the space and time to develop their skills.
  • Desert island book: “And the Mountains Echoed” by Khaled Hosseini
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Shrimp scampi with asparagus and cherry tomatoes
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Climbing the Dunn’s River Falls in Jamaica
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I volunteer as a stroke judge and referee at my daughters’ swim meets.
  • Favorite movie quote: “I’m not a regular mom. I’m a cool mom.” – Mrs. George in “Mean Girls.” Honestly, I use it WAY too much.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Being alone in the woods. I blame this on “The Blair Witch Project.”
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Tom Petty! Taylor Swift was also AMAZING!
  • What would your last meal be? Garden tomatoes, my grandma’s potato salad, and fried chicken
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? My husband runs a gym and we do functional strength workouts together. I also love hiking, yoga, and swimming.

name: Kathleen Kustra
body_html:
Kathleen holds a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism from Indiana University and an Enrolled Agent designation. She joined Prosperity Partners in December 2007 as the Office Administrator and is now an Individual Tax Manager. Kathleen specializes in personal and business treasury services. In addition, she provides income tax preparation services for both individual and business clients.

EXPERTISE: Personal & Business Treasury Services, Personal & Business Tax, Financial Reporting & Analysis

name: Kavita Kharat
body_html:
Kavita Kharat completed her Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) from Mumbai University. During her studies, she developed a strong foundation in subjects like accounting, finance, and economics. She started her professional journey in US Tax at SurePrep working on individual and trust tax filings. This experience gave her a strong base in taxation and helped her better understand IRS guidelines. Her hard work earned her a promotion to Tax Reviewer, where she was responsible for reviewing tax returns, ensuring accuracy and compliance. In addition to her core responsibilities, she also led a team on the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) project. In 2018, Kavita received the opportunity to work in the US, which further enriched her professional experience and broadened her global exposure. After 23 years with SurePrep, she took the next step in her career by joining Prosperity’s VGS Team as an Assistant Tax Manager, where she continues to apply her knowledge and leadership skills in a dynamic environment.

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite part about my job in US taxation is navigating the complexities of tax laws and regulations. I enjoy analyzing client situations and finding the best solutions to ensure compliance while optimizing tax outcomes. Another thing I love is the constant learning. Tax laws are always evolving, so staying up-to-date keeps me challenged and engaged. Lastly, I love collaborating with my team to review complex tax returns and lead projects. It’s great to combine our expertise to deliver accurate and efficient results!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Paneer/Chicken Biryani
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? My favorite vacation I’ve ever taken was in Bhutan. This was a truly unforgettable experience. I loved exploring the beautiful landscapes—from the serene monasteries perched on cliffs like Tiger’s Nest to the peaceful valleys and vibrant local markets.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is with close family and friends over a relaxed dinner. I love the simple moments and good conversations.
  • Favorite Concert you’ve attended: My favorite Marathi concert I’ve attended was the live performance of Janata Raja. The energy and passion in their music was electrifying, and the entire audience was fully engaged, singing along to every song. It was an unforgettable experience that beautifully showcased Marathi culture and musical talent!
  • Title of my Autobiography: “From small steps to big dreams”

name: Kayla Bushong
body_html:
Kayla Bushong graduated from the University of Central Florida with a bachelor’s of science in Psychology after completing an undergraduate thesis. Prior to Prosperity Partners, Kayla has worked in various professions such as education, sales, and sports refereeing. Kayla joined Prosperity Partners as an Office Manager in March 2024 and provides administrative support to all the teams. In her spare time, Kayla loves to read fantasy and science fiction books and watch TV with her husband. Additionally, Kayla serves as a volunteer at her church playing piano several times a month.

EXPERTISE: Administration

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The admin team! Everyone is so welcoming and fun.
  • Desert island book: The Bible
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My honeymoon to Paris and Milan! Europe is beautiful and it was so fun to see my husband experience it for the first time.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? So much reading! I read over 100 books last year and hope to do the same this year.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Courage, dear heart” – “The Lion, The Witch, and The Wardrobe”
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Taking a trip! I love to travel, so seeing new places is my favorite gift.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Being in water where I can’t see the bottom. You will not catch me on a boat or kayak. Ever.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: J-Hope at Lollapalooza 2022
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? My favorite form of exercise is running!

name: Kelly McGuiness
body_html:
Kelly McGuiness is an accounting and systems professional specializing in controllership, automation, and scalable finance operations for high-growth companies. She holds both a BS with a double concentration in Accounting and Information Systems, and an MS in Accounting from Boston College. Kelly has led systems integrations, intercompany accounting initiatives, and audit readiness projects that improved accuracy, transparency, and efficiency across global entities. Outside the office, Kelly bakes sourdough and runs a book & crafts club with her friends in Miami!

EXPERTISE: Controllership & Technical Accounting, Accounting Systems & Integrations, Financial Process Automation, Audit Readiness & Reporting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Turning messy financials into clean, understandable systems that give people clarity and confidence instead of stress. It’s rewarding to help our team save time on processes and get reliable financials to clients as soon as possible!
  • Favorite Vacation You’ve Taken: A backpack motorcycle trip along Northern Ireland’s Causeway Coastal Route. Coastal cliffs, tiny fishing towns, Guinness at random pubs, and insane views the whole way.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Anything country! I grew up in a small farm town in New Jersey (yes, that’s a thing), so I always end up going back to my roots.
  • Favorite Way to Celebrate Your Birthday: Experiences all day. Ideally, I’m traveling somewhere new with people I love, doing something active or interesting, and ending it with a great meal. No giant parties, no random gifts — just memories.
  • Favorite Concert You’ve Attended: On the Run Tour with Beyoncé and Jay-Z. I waitressed so many doubles in high school to afford floor tickets and it was 100% worth it.
  • Favorite Workout or Sport to Play: Hot Pilates followed by iced coffee and a long walk.

name: Keyshawn Andress
body_html:
Keyshawn Andress graduated from Robert Morris University with a bachelor’s degree in accounting and a master’s in taxation in 2021. Before joining Prosperity Partners in 2024, he worked for a Big Four accounting firm, specializing in partnerships, private equity, and state and local tax compliance. Outside of work, Keyshawn enjoys working out, volunteering at local high schools, and reading.

EXPERTISE: Tax Compliance and State and Local Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people, who have been nothing but kind from the start, making it a very comfortable place to work.
  • Desert island book: “Invisible Man” by Ralph Ellison, this book transformed life after the first time reading it in high school. Ellison’s ability to embed such thought-provoking concepts within each line has amazed me until this day.
    Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Costa Rica, it was my first time out of the country and with no itinerary other than a place to stay my friends and I made an unforgettable experience.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? My side passion outside of accounting is creative writing. I have always been drawn to writing since a youth. It wasn’t until my time in university where my interest peaked and I dove into the pen. I find expressing my emotions on paper is not only relieving but beneficial for those going through the same things as me.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? The title of my autobiography would be “A Man and His Word.” Since I was a child my father instilled in me there’s nothing greater to a man than his word. This concept has carried me through my lowest and highest parts of my life reminding me the importance of commitment. An individual’s word is more than just expression it is a binding vow that makes them who they are.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Kendrick Lamar Mr. Morale and the Big Steppers Tour was the best performance I have ever seen. I was practically raised by Kendrick’s music and seeing him performing live was surreal.
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Doctor Doom. Despite being one of Marvel’s greatest villains Doom has endless knowledge of the world and its whereabouts. I’d love to pick his mind on this and maybe pick up some magic along the way.
  • What would your last meal be? Jerk Chicken, Oxtail, and Beans and Rice. Not much to be said here, Jamaican food is just mouth watering it would be a fine last meal.

name: Kiran Gupta
body_html:
Kiran Gupta holds a Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance, as well as a Bachelor’s degree, from Mumbai University. Since 2023, Kiran has been preparing Individual and Business tax returns with a strong focus on compliance and planning. Before joining Prosperity Partners in March 2025, Kiran held Associate roles at SurePrep for two years, gaining valuable experience in tax preparation and technology-driven solutions. Currently she works on the VGS team for both Individual and Business tax services.

Expertise: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance and Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: I like the team I work with and the overall environment. The continued support and positivity make each day enjoyable.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Indo-Chinese food and Pav Bhaji.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? A trip to Matheran with my friends.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Visiting the temple to receive blessings.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Badminton
  • Favorite movie quote: “Babumoshai, zindagi badi honi chahiye, lambi nahin.” – Anand. Translates to “Life should be big, not long”

name: Kitti Varga
body_html:
Kitti Varga earned her Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration from Florida International University with concentrations in Marketing and International Business. With more than 20 years of experience in the legal industry, she brings strong administrative and financial experience to her role at Prosperity Partners. Kitti provides administrative and billing support for the Detroit office and works closely with team members to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and seamless service. A lifelong athlete, Kitti brings the same discipline, focus, and commitment to excellence she developed through athletics into her professional life.

EXPERTISE: Administration, Billing, and Bookkeeping

  • Favorite thing about my job: It’s great to be part of a collaborative, high-performing team who genuinely support one another.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I’m a fitness enthusiast who incorporates yoga, weightlifting, and running into my routine. Staying active has been such a constant in my life that I can’t remember the last time I missed more than a few days!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I enjoy cooking traditional Hungarian Stuffed Cabbage for my family on special occasions.
  • I have an irrational fear of: driving over bridges and through tunnels. I blame years of watching dramatic Hollywood movies!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My children and I enjoy visiting family and friends in Hungary. It is so special getting to spend time together experiencing the culture and everyday life there.

name: Kristen Schrader
body_html:
Kristen Schrader graduated from Loyola University Chicago with an unlikely double major in theatre and sociology. She began her career in theatre management first at the Goodman Theater as the Box Office Manager, and then at the Apollo as the Assistant General Manager.

When Kristen joined Prosperity Partners in 2019, the idea of working with an office of accountants scared her more than any amount of stage fright ever has – and her last office had a dragon in it. While her prior employment at the Apollo may have given her a more direct way to use her skills of theater trivia, set painting, costume design and theater history, at Prosperity Partners she has the power to confound and confuse her colleagues by launching into an extemporaneous TED Talk on the unique structure of the musical Cats or breaking into song at the mere mention of the name “Seymour”.

As our Human Resources Director, she strives to support our team and nurture a healthy and happy workplace and culture. Kristen helps our team grow by searching far and wide for talented professionals and interns.  She also serves as our Chief Entertainment Officer, helping to plan our monthly parties and treats for the firm.

In her spare time, Kristen is an actress and producer for the multi-media production company she runs with her husband – 27th Letter Productions.  So far together they’ve made one web-comic, three podcasts, four films, and a partridge in a pear tree.

EXPERTISE: Human Resources, Recruiting, Event Management, Administration

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: How supported I feel by everyone on the team. Everyone at Prosperity Partners has your back – whether you need advice, additional resources, time, encouragement, a sympathetic ear, or just another pair of hands. Your teammates will be there for you.
  • Desert island book: I love reading too much and would paste the following books together to create one giant mega book: “The Once and Future Witches” by Alix E. Harrow, “The Ten Thousand Doors of January” by Alix E Harrow, “Beneath a Scarlet Sky” by Mark Sullivan, “The Invisible Life of Addie LaRue” by VE Schwab, “The Power” by Naomi Alderman, “Code Name Verity” by Elizabeth Wein, and “Carrie” by Stephen King.  Possibly enough books to make a raft and sail away, but I’d never hurt my precious books!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My brother was married in Germany. I spent three days in Amsterdam, three days in Paris, and three days in Frankfurt. It was amazing! One of the countless highlights of the trip was hiking up the Black Forest with my new sister-in-law a to a castle-turned-winery where we shared a glass of Neuer Wein (new wine).
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? In addition to being an actress, I’m a painter! My medium of choice is acrylic and my subjects are primarily animals or fantasy landscapes.  I’m always on the lookout for cafes or small galleries to showcase them in.  I’m also a full-time Cat Mommy. If you’ve been on a Zoom call with me, you’ve met Lieutenant Ellen Ripley and Commander William Riker.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I’d want to go out for margaritas and guac with friends, and then go to Musical Theatre Night at Sidetracks until I lose my voice!
  • What would your last meal be? I could pretend to be fancy but instead I’ll be honest and say a Kaijo burger and fries from Kuma’s Corner. But I’d pair it with a really nice Malbec.

name: Lauren Frisoli
body_html:
Lauren Frisoli graduated Magna Cum Laude from Kean University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Writing. Following graduation, she started her administrative career in customer retention at Comcast, and joined Prosperity Partners in 2026. In her spare time, she is an acrylic painter and an aspiring author. She hopes to finish draft two of her first novel after tax season is over!

EXPERTISE: Customer Service, Administration, and Troubleshooting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Being back in my hometown every day!
  • Favorite Concert Attended: The VH1 Decades Rock Live tribute to Elvis Costello featuring Death Cab for Cutie, Fiona Apple, and Billie Joe Armstrong (Green Day). It was amazing hearing each of these talented artists cover each other’s songs, plus if you listen to Fiona’s cover of “I Want You” from the recording, I swear that’s my scream in the background!
  • What is the best dish you can make? My husband is the chef in our house, but I make the banana pancakes and the guacamole.
  • Go-to Karaoke song? “Ain’t It Fun” by Paramore – and I forget how long the ending refrain is every single time!
  • Desert Island Book: The Hunger Games complete series. They are infinitely re-readable and have some good survival tips.

name: Leah Dunbar
body_html:
Leah joined McGowan Guntermann in 2021. She has worked in both private industry and public accounting, with a diverse client group of high-net-worth individuals, nonprofits, trusts, and S-corps. She assists clients with their cash flow management, general ledger management, financial statement preparation, and payroll and sales tax compliance. In addition, she works closely with CPAs to complete annual tax returns. Leah customizes financial reporting to fit her clients’ needs, which provides them with valuable insight into their businesses. She enjoys leveraging technology to improve efficiencies in the accounting processes for her clients. Leah received a bachelor of arts from University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) and is a Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor. In her time away from the firm, she enjoys playing beach volleyball and traveling.

EXPERTISE: Personal Financial Accounting, Family Office Management, Small Business Accounting, Financial Statement Preparation

  • Favorite thing about my job: The diversity of work each day! There are always new challenges and new things to learn with the diverse group of clients I work with.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: LA Kings game. We rented a shuttle and went down to the arena to watch a game together. I love watching any and all live sports.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: With friends, starting off with something active (group workout or volleyball) and ending the day with great food and conversation (and preferably a great view too)
  • What would your last meal be? A fresh pasta dish, preferably in Italy
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Volleyball, both beach and indoor

name: Lee Ann Start
body_html:
Lee Ann Start has over 20 years of experience in the tax and accounting field at both large and small firms, as well as working as a Business Manager for a non-profit organization for several years. She graduated Magna Cum Laude from St. Michael’s College in 2003 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and Minor in English Literature. She passed the CPA exam that same year and became a licensed CPA in 2009 after meeting the remaining licensure requirements. Lee Ann is a member of the American Institute of CPAs and the Vermont Society of CPAs. In her free time, she enjoys gardening and spending time with her family!

EXPERTISE: Fiduciary, Gift, and Individual Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: Our team! We have an amazing group of professionals who create a welcoming and supportive environment.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Trip to Ireland with my parents and sister. It was beautiful and I can’t wait to go back!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love to garden and work on sewing projects such as quilting and embroidery!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Dropkick Murphy’s when they came to Vermont for an outdoor summer concert.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I love to kayak in Lake Champlain during the summer months.

name: Lileosa Tan
body_html:
Lileosa Tan is an experienced Accountant with a demonstrated history in public accounting. She received her Bachelors in Accounting from the University of San Carlos in the Philippines and started out her career in Audit with PWC-Phils.  Following PWC, she went into Accounting Systems Consulting while also managing her family’s business on the side. After her young family moved to the United States, she worked for almost 10 years with Teti & Carswell CPAs (now Carswell & Associates, CPAs) where she took on small to medium sized clients in varied industries, providing Accounting and Business Services such as: Accounting and Bookkeeping, Payroll Processing and Business Tax Compliance, QuickBooks Setup/Tune-up and Reconciliations, and Tax Preparation. In 2020, she joined Wiener & Garg, LLC (now Prosperity Partners), because of her strong interest for growth in the field of Tax Preparation.

EXPERTISE: Tax Preparation, QuickBooks Consulting, General Ledger Reconstruction and Reconciliations, Bookkeeping, Payroll and Business Tax Compliance.

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The feel-good moments I get when I help resolve the client’s bookkeeping or tax compliance issues. And, I get to learn something new every day!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Hmmm… It’s not easy to pick one because I get compliments whenever I bring any dish to Filipino potlucks! So, to mention a few: Lumpia, Pancit, Chicken BBQ, Chop Suey, etc…
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I recently joined our parish choir and am enjoying it!
  • Favorite movie quote: “If you only do what you can do, you will never be more than what you are now.” – Kung Fu Panda
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? “Top of the World” – Carpenters
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: KFFF – Karaoke and good Food with Family and Friends!
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? Wolverine because I like Hugh Jackman and I’m curious how he would feed himself!

name: Lilly Hu
body_html:
Lilly is a Tax and Financial Reporting professional with more than ten years of experience at Public Accounting firms and Private Equity foundations. She earned a Master’s Degree in Accounting from Queens College and has been an active Certified Public Accountant since 2014. She is also a board member of the Chinese American Society of CPAs. Throughout her career, she has helped businesses and individuals navigate complex tax rules, meet important deadlines, and make informed financial decisions year-round. Outside of her work, she enjoys hiking, swimming, and playing badminton, activities that reflect a strong commitment to health, balance, and an active lifestyle.

EXPERTISE: Financial Reporting, International Tax Law, Partnership Taxation, Tax Planning for HNWIs

  • Favorite thing about my job: One of the best parts of the job is translating complex tax code into plain English — because clients don’t need more confusion, they need clarity. Tax law is famously detailed and constantly evolving, which makes turning technical rules into real-world guidance both a skill and a daily challenge.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Salmon roasted in Butter and Almonds
  • Desert Island Book: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari
  • Favorite movie quote: “In another life, I would have liked doing laundry and taxes with you” – Everything Everywhere All At Once
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Paris, France!

name: Lisa Fernandez
body_html:
Lisa Fernández graduated from California State University Channel Islands with honors, earning a bachelor’s degree in business. Lisa is a CPA candidate working toward certification and is currently in a tax mentorship program. Lisa joined Prosperity Partners, LLP in 2024 and works out of the Santa Barbara office. She provides bookkeeping services for a variety of business clients operating in industries such as petroleum, machining, and ranching. She also provides bookkeeping services for private individuals. In addition, Lisa has experience preparing individual tax returns and is training to prepare S corporation returns as well.

EXPERTISE: Bookkeeping and Tax Preparation.

  • Favorite thing about my job: Working with clients. I love to help them achieve their goals.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve been on: Snorkeling in Kona, Hawaii and staying at the Hilton. One memorable moment was seeing the green flash at sunset from the hotel veranda!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby: Playing classical guitar with the ambition to play as well as Berta Rojas and Max Anayev to say the least!
  • What would your last meal be? A Persian meal consisting of fresh herbs, white fish, tahdig, ghormeh sabzi, and a fine bottle of Shiraz!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Running.

name: Lisa Pallen
body_html:
lpallen@prosperityllc.com

Lisa Pallen is a highly accomplished professional with over a decade of experience at Prosperity Partners. Her expertise spans accounting, operations, and human resources. She is a natural problem solver, has a passion for entrepreneurship, and thrives in dynamic environments. Her strategic skillset is what sets her apart and enables her to navigate the ever-changing landscape of business with ease. In addition to Prosperity Partners, she manages the operations of a successful business, Mikerphone Brewing, with her husband.

EXPERTISE: Small Business Accounting, Controllership, Payroll & HR.

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: There is a lot to love about working at Prosperity Partners. One of my favorite things is the challenging work environment. It really keeps me on my toes and helps me grow and learn new things every day. Also, working with such a diverse group of people is fun and inspiring. So the combination of a challenging work environment and amazing clients and colleagues make Prosperity Partners a special place to work.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Being an entrepreneur and managing Mikerphone Brewing with my husband is my favorite side hustle. We have a passionate staff and supportive customers that have enabled us to grow our business and give back to the community over the past ten years.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Gangsters Paradise or Regulate (RIP, Coolio & Warren G/ Nate Dog ☹)

name: Liz Butler
body_html:
Liz Butler serves as Prosperity’s Director of Operations and leads the firm’s Learning and Development initiatives. She’s passionate about lifelong learning and fostering a culture of learning and development at Prosperity. Prior to the acquisition, Liz spent 12 years as the Director of Operations for Pipaya, building out the entire back-office operations of the firm. Liz is a CPA and began her career as an Auditor with Arthur Andersen. Other career highlights include working in Accounting Operations at various companies in the commercial finance, hospitality, real estate, and healthcare industries. She graduated from the University of Virginia McIntire School of Commerce with a Bachelors Degree in Commerce and a concentration in Accounting. In her spare time, she enjoys spending time with family, crafting, and decorating beautiful spaces at home.

EXPERTISE: Talent Development, Operations, Strategic Execution

  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My honeymoon in Belize. The excursions and adventures were amazing – sleeping in a treehouse, ziplining and horseback riding through the jungle, and kayaking on the Sittee River, just to name a few.
  • Favorite Quote: “Choose the bigger life.” – Gretchen Rubin, Author
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Jimmy Buffett at Wolf Trap. It was my first concert, and I went during an intern recruiting event. Jimmy was awesome but the “Parrot Heads” were even more entertaining!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Field hockey – I played in high school and fell in love with the sport. Playing AAU my senior year was the ultimate highlight.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? My kids are social kidpreneurs running a small business, so my side hustle is “volunteering” for them in the evenings and on weekends.

name: Logan Nielsen
body_html:
Logan Nielsen graduated from The University of North Florida with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, joining Prosperity Partners in October 2024 as a Tax Manager. Prior to joining the firm, he had over 15 years of experience in public accounting, with the majority spent at a boutique tax practice in Florida focusing on high-net-worth individual tax compliance and strategy. As a generalist, he handles a variety of tax issues with a continued emphasis on comprehensive tax services, successful individuals and family offices, as well as estate, gift, and trust taxation. Logan and his wife live in Jacksonville, Florida and enjoy spending time with their menagerie of pets, going to the movies, and attending sporting events!

EXPERTISE: High Net Worth Individual Tax Compliance and Planning, Estate, Gift, and Trust Taxation, IRS Representation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Prosperity has a robust personnel structure and implements cutting edge technology that makes us more accurate and efficient. I appreciate that they embrace the family culture of a small firm, while providing the benefits and resources of a larger firm.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Anything… so long as it comes in a Hello Fresh box with detailed instructions and pre-measured ingredients!
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: For our honeymoon we went out to Napa Valley, California for half of the trip and then to San Francisco for the remainder. It was a fantastic blend of calm settings, beautiful sceneries, and exciting adventures.
  • Favorite Concert you attended: The Hella Mega Tour at EverBank Stadium in Jacksonville, Florida. Headliners included Green Day, Fall Out Boy, and Weezer. It felt like a surreal and nostalgic trip back in time to see the bands I listened to non-stop when I was younger.
  • Favorite Workout or Sport to play? I love to kayak. We live very close to the St. John’s River in Northeast Florida, so I go out for a paddle any chance I can!

name: Loise Kyalo
body_html:
Loise joined Prosperity Partners in January 2025 as an Administrative Assistant, overseeing the office administration and client billing for the Rockville team. Loise is originally from Kenya, where she pursued a Bachelor of Pharmacy at the University of Nairobi. After relocating to the United States, Loise transferred to Capella University and received a Bachelor of Public Health. Loise lives with her family in Rockville, Maryland, just a 5-minute drive from the Prosperity Partners office! Loise is fluent in three languages (English, Swahili and Kamba) with an intermediate knowledge of French. Before joining Prosperity Partners, Loise worked as an Administrative Assistant for the Henry M. Jackson Foundation (HJF), directly supporting the US Military HIV Research Program (MHRP) since 2022.

  • EXPERTISE: Administration, Procurement, Event Planning
  • Favorite thing about my job: Learning how to utilize and navigate new accounting systems and tools.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Chapati and Fowl Stew. This is one of my favorite East African dishes. It is a time-consuming meal to make, therefore we make this on Saturdays.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I accompanied my dad on his international audit assignment in Amman, Jordan. We took a drive from Amman to the Dead Sea to swim and enjoy the Jordanian shawarma(cuisine).
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Zuchu’s concert In Silver Spring, Maryland. Zuchu is a young, upcoming East African artist who has tremendously grown over the past five years!
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Life is like a box of chocolates, you never know what you’re going to get” – Forrest Gump

name: Lounise George
body_html:
Lounise George brings 19 years of tax experience to Prosperity Partners, reinforcing her reputation as a trusted professional. As a Tax Manager, Lounise demonstrates expertise in all facets of tax management. She skillfully coordinates with staff, ensuring seamless operations and the highest standards of accuracy. Her client interactions are marked by clear communication, reliability, and unwavering integrity.

Lounise earned a Bachelor of Business Administration from Bernard Baruch College in 2001. She further advanced her education with a Master of Science in Accounting and Financial Management from Devry University in 2010. These academic achievements have laid a strong foundation for her distinguished career.

Lounise’s personal journey is a testament to her resilience and drive. Originally from Haiti, she has built a life and career in the United States, now calling the Bronx home with her family. Her experiences have shaped her perspective and fueled her passion for helping others achieve success.

EXPERTISE: High-Net-Worth Individuals and Non-Profit Organizations

  • Favorite thing about my job: One of my favorite aspects of being a Tax Manager is having the opportunity to solve complex tax challenges for my clients. I find great satisfaction in collaborating with my team and guiding clients through ever-changing tax laws. By ensuring that clients feel supported, I am able to build lasting relationships. The fulfillment I gain from making a meaningful impact on my clients’ lives is what makes my role especially rewarding!
  • What is your hobby/side gig/passion project? I enjoy home decoration, finding creativity and relaxation in transforming living spaces. I love exploring new design trends and personalizing my surroundings to create a warm, inviting atmosphere for family and friends.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Recently, I’ve embraced Pilates as my latest workout, using a Pilates board to enhance my strength and flexibility.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: One of my favorite memories is attending a K-Pop concert with my younger daughter, an experience filled with excitement, music, and bonding that we both cherished.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Outside of my professional responsibilities, I enjoy traveling and cherish time spent with my family. I enjoy taking time away from my daily routine to unwind, recharge, and often choose destinations that offer beautiful surroundings and the chance to create cherished memories with my loved ones. One of my favorite vacations was a trip to Aruba a couple of years ago. The experience offered beautiful scenery, relaxation, and memorable moments, further deepening my appreciation for travel and family time.

name: Mahendra Gorule
body_html:
Mahendra Manohar Gorule is a seasoned Tax Specialist with extensive experience in U.S. taxation and tax software solutions. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree with a specialization in Financial Accounting and Auditing from the University of Mumbai. Mahendra gained experience working at Thomson Reuters Mumbai, where he was actively involved in the preparation, review, and compliance of U.S. tax returns, including Form 1040 (Individuals) and Form 1041 (Trusts). His professional responsibilities include reviewing financial statements, ensuring compliance with federal and state tax regulations, identifying eligible deductions and credits, and maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and confidentiality in tax reporting. He brings strong hands-on expertise in leading tax applications such as SPBinder, SurePrep Express, GoSystem, ProSystem, and CCH. In addition to tax compliance work, Mahendra has contributed significantly to the OCR team, where he worked with ABBYY FlexiCapture to test and validate data recognition, prepare templates, resolve system issues, and provide client support related to scanning workflows and data accuracy. With a strong foundation in U.S. tax compliance, technology-driven tax solutions, and process improvement, Mahendra adds valuable expertise and reliability to the Prosperity Partners team.

Expertise: US Individual Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: Applying my U.S. Tax expertise to deliver precise, compliant, and technology-driven solutions.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: A big, shared meal with friends or family, full of laughter and stories.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A meaningful vacation exploring the sacred sites of Somnath and Dwarkadhish Temple. Also, my spiritual journey to Bhimashankar and Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlingas.
    What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Exploring spiritual destinations, especially Jyotirlingas, and trekking in the mountains!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I love playing outdoor games and staying active through trekking and gym workouts.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? All types of Non-vegetarian food.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Hows the Josh? High, sir!” – Uri: The Surgical Strike

name: Mahendra Joshi
body_html:
Mahendra Joshi is a seasoned tax professional with over 19 years of experience specializing in U.S. Individual and Fiduciary tax compliance. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce Degree from Mumbai University, where he built a strong foundation in Accounting, Finance, and Economics. Mahendra began his career at SurePrep, focusing on Individual and Trust tax filings. His dedication and performance quickly earned him a promotion to Tax Reviewer. He also played a key leadership role in the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) department, where he led a team, managed operations, and implemented process improvements. Since 2008, Mahendra has frequently traveled to the United States to support onshore operations, preparing and reviewing complex 1040 and 1041 tax returns. After nearly two decades at SurePrep, he brought his deep expertise and leadership to Prosperity’s VGS team as an Assistant Tax Manager, where he continues to contribute to high-quality tax compliance and team development.

  • Favorite thing about my job: What I enjoy most about working in tax is the constant opportunity to learn and evolve. Each client and return bring its own unique challenges, which keeps the work both engaging and intellectually rewarding. I particularly enjoy reviewing complex returns and mentoring junior team members. Sharing my knowledge while also staying up to date with everchanging tax regulations makes this profession both dynamic and deeply fulfilling!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Aloo Paratha
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? One of my most memorable vacations was a road trip to Las Vegas, which proved to be a truly unforgettable experience!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Spending the evening with my family at a nice beach.
  • What would your last meal be? Misal Pav, a popular Maharashtrian Street food dish.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Jo darr gaya, samjho marr gaya” – Translates to “He who got scared is considered dead”.

name: Mansi Goud
body_html:
Hello, my name is Mansi Goud. I hold a Bachelors of Commerce and currently work as a Verification Associate at Prosperity. In my current role, I specialize in the verification of US tax documents. My strengths include verifying US tax documents and ensuring digital binders are an exact replica of the Tax software system, updating and incorporating definitions for new tax forms and fields annually to align with software updates, and maintaining data accuracy by ensuring all newly introduced forms are accurately reflected in the SurePrep binders.

Expertise: US Tax Document Verification, Tax Accounting, OCR Technology, Tax Software Compliance, Data Integrity

  • Favorite thing about my job: I like the team I work with and the overall environment. The continued support and positivity make each day enjoyable!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Chicken and Fish.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? My favorite vacation was visiting Konkan during the rainy season. The entire region transforms into a lush green paradise, with waterfalls cascading down the ghats and the smell of wet earth in the air.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is by spending quality time with my family and close friends.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Badminton.

name: Maria Rodriguez Pino
body_html:
Maria graduated from Andres Bello Catholic University in Venezuela with a bachelor’s degree in public accounting. In Venezuela, Maria worked as an auditor in a public accounting firm and held roles in financial reporting and accounts receivables with several international companies in the finance sector. Maria moved to the United States in 2018. She joined Prosperity in 2023 as an Administrative Assistant in their Houston office. In this role, she supports the accounting and tax teams with various tasks including client outreach, communicating with compliance agencies, and ensuring the timely processing and assembly of accounting and tax projects. In her spare time, Maria enjoys spending time with friends, walking, and enjoying nature.

EXPERTISE – Administration, Customer Service, Account Receivables.

  • Favorite thing about my job: Our team is awesome – regardless of or title or role, we support each other to achieve our common goals.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I have visited some amazing places over the years, and choosing just one as my favorite is quite challenging. But I would choose two places that share what I love most: the beach. One of these is La Tortuga Island in my country. Experiencing nature to the fullest on its stunning white sand beaches, despite a somewhat stressful journey to get there, remains unforgettable. After a work trip, spending a few days in Bali, Indonesia, enjoying its beautiful beaches, local culture, relaxing massages, and amazing views was a dream come true
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? My hobby is designing and crafting with silver, using jewelry-making techniques to create beautiful earrings, rings, and pendants
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Spending time with close friends and family, enjoying a relaxed dinner, and having fun together.
  • I have an irrational fear of: hurricanes and earthquakes.

name: Mark Benesiewicz
body_html:
Mark Benesiewicz graduated from California State University, Fresno with a major in accounting. After spending ten years in California, he decided to move back to Illinois in 2021, his childhood state, to be closer to his family and enjoy all the wonderful seasons Illinois has to offer even when he experiences them all in the span of a week. In his spare time, you’ll find Mark on the golf course working on his swing, playing soccer, or exploring the surrounding areas with his wife, Amanda. Mark is in the process of expanding his tax knowledge and finding better ways to assist his clients by pursing a master’s in taxation degree.

EXPERTISE: Taxation of High Net Worth Individuals, Tax Planning

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners:The team at Prosperity Partners. Working on tax returns and related projects will always be challenging and stressful against hard deadlines wherever you are. I am incredibly grateful to have a supportive and fun team around me to make the work less stressful and more enjoyable.
  • Favorite movie quote: “So you’re telling me there’s a chance…” Dumb and Dumber, 1994. Always loved the “glass half-filled” look on life and this quote captures it well.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Backstreet Boys – I want it that way. Fun Fact: there may be evidence of myself and friends in high school lip syncing in a choreographed video out there…
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Blink 182 and All-American Rejects. The punk rock hair may be gone but still very punk rock at heart.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Gordon Ramsay inspired Shepherd’s Pie. A classic feel-good down to your soul type meal. It’s always so filling and loaded with flavor.

name: Mary Beth Stanley
body_html:
Mary Beth attended Champlain College, majoring in the Executive Assistant program. She started her career in the banking industry as an Administrative Assistant on both the bank and corporate sides. While at the bank, she was able to transition into the legal department as a Legal Assistant, which then lead her to return to Champlain College and obtain her Paralegal Certification! She joined Danaher Attig & Plante in 2014 and now serves as a Tax Administrator for the Prosperity Partners team. Mary Beth always looks forward to the tax season and working with our clients to make it as smooth as possible.

EXPERTISE: Administration

  • My favorite thing about my job: One of the best parts about my job is my co-workers. They are an awesome team and always available to assist with any questions and help me to understand the best way to solve a problem. The second best thing is the interactions with our awesome clients!
  • Desert Island Book: Any book by Nora Roberts. She is my go-to author, and her trilogies are my favorites to read.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I have taken numerous vacations, but the one that stands out the most would be the two-week vacation to Jamaica with my family. It is such a beautiful place to visit and relax, as the pace there is much slower.

name: Matt Johnson
body_html:
After 4 years in the United States Coast Guard, Matt graduated from Lyndon State College with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting. After graduation, he moved to Washington DC where he worked his way to Partner in a CPA firm. Following 12 years in Washington DC, he decided to move back to Vermont, where he currently serves as a Partner at Prosperity. Matt provides tax and estate planning services for high-net-worth individuals, real estate businesses, and real estate investors. During his spare time, Matt can be found spending time with his family or on the golf course.

EXPERTISE: Real Estate Investments, High-Net-Worth Tax Planning, Estate Planning

Favorite thing about my job: Teaching younger staff and watching them evolve in their careers, as well as assisting with estate planning.
Favorite vacation you’ve taken: It’s a tie between Saint Croix where I learned to scuba dive with my oldest daughter and Disney World with the entire family. I loved both, but each was uniquely different.
Favorite concert you’ve attended: It hasn’t happened yet but Morgan Wallen, August 23, 2025 with my wife and daughters at Gilette Stadium!
Favorite workout or sport to play? Golf. I enjoy playing as well as watching.
What is the best dish you can cook? Filet Mignon with baby red potatoes and asparagus.
Favorite Movie Quote: “Get busy living, or get busy dying” – Shawshank Redemption

name: Matthew Segel
body_html:
Matthew Segel graduated from Colorado College with a degree in Political Science. A lifelong learner, he continued his education at the University of Vermont and St. Michaels College to earn the right to sit for the CPA exam. He has worked for a small number of Vermont CPA firms and currently serves as a Senior Tax Accountant with Prosperity!

EXPERTISE: Tax Theory and practice

  • Favorite thing about my job: Working with clients to properly help them meet their tax obligations in an efficient and thoughtful manner. There is also such a thing as an “accountant’s rush”, which is when a super difficult return involving countless steps and calculations comes into balance. That’s a great feeling.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I can cook anything, but I have been experimenting with quesadillas lately, and the results have been fantastic!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Golf with tennis being a close second.
  • What is your go to karaoke song? We’ll assume this is shower Karaoke and I’ll go with Sing me Back Home by Merle Haggard and Jerry Garcia.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? My passion project is landscaping. It must be a passion if I am on the stone driveway for hours pulling up weeds. I guess it could be madness, but I’ll go with passion!
  • Desert Island Book: I love reading The Bible. The Brothers Karamazov by Fyodor Dostoyevsky would be my second choice if I had two books in my carry-on and survived the plane crash (the desert island scenario).

name: Maureen Nulty
body_html:
Maureen graduated Suma Cum Laude from the University of Michigan Stephen M. Ross School of Business, with a secondary major in English. She began her career as a direct entry into the Tax Department of Ernst & Young where she spent the next 13 years, ultimately achieving the role of Tax Principal. Maureen joined CCA (now Prosperity Partners) as a Tax Partner, continuing her focus for another 20+ years on highly technical real estate and other industry transactional activity.

Building on this rich and deep background in taxation and business transactions, Maureen now consults with the executive suite of family offices, often serving as interim CFO during periods of transition. Maureen’s CFO services provide a sounding board based on real-life experiences and knowledge to business owners and executives regarding strategic vision, wealth transfer, philanthropic initiatives, business transitions, succession planning, and entity structuring.

EXPERTISE:

  • Tax consulting for multi-generational family offices, concentrating on operational and ownership succession planning
  • Temporary CFO services for privately held professional service companies.
  • In-depth understanding of Hospitality and Franchise operations, tax planning, tax structuring, and operation and reporting efficiencies
  • S-Corporation transactional planning, including deferred tax transactions and distribution and liquidation considerations

ABOUT ME:

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love to learn, and I learn something new every single day. Who else can say that?!?
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I love to cook, because I love sharing food with others – it’s a basic human need that develops connections and friendships. There’s something about the act of sharing food that enhances our relationships with friends, family, and former strangers. One of my favorite meals is a spinach, feta, and sundried tomato stuffed flank steak with garlic mashed potatoes and stir-fried broccolini. Another is seared ahi tuna with wasabi cream sauce, roasted sweet potatoes, and stir-fried peapods. Or grilled lamb chops, homemade rice pilaf, and creamed spinach. I also make many ethnic dishes from my Austrian/Polish heritage.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I grow many herbs – basil, rosemary, tarragon, thyme – and this year I grew my own garlic! I googled how to harvest the cloves and the cloves are drying as instructed now!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Machu Picchu, Peru. I’ve traveled many places in the world and still remain mesmerized by Machu Picchu. Read about it. It’s mystical, magical, totally impossible, and incredibly beautiful. It’s an engineering masterpiece with no history and no remains.
  • Favorite movie quote: “You make me want to be a better man” – Jack Nicholson, As Good as It Gets. When said to me, I consider it the greatest compliment I’ve ever received.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Birds. Flapping wings terrify me. It’s irrational. Which is funny because I’m good with snakes, spiders, flying insects, some rodents, frogs, bats, etc. I visited Gibraltar and had a 30-pound monkey jump on my head. They’re protected so you can’t touch them or shoo them away. He enjoyed clawing at my hair. It was an experience!

CERTIFICATIONS:

  • CPA in Michigan
  • Certified Valuation Analyst (CVA)
  • Accredited In Business Valuation (ABV)

name: Max Louis
body_html:
Max Louis graduated from New York University in 2023 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics. Max joined Prosperity Partners in June 2026, where he supports the internal operations team with billing and general administration. Before joining Prosperity, Max worked in Billing Administration for a luxury retailer. Outside of the office, Max enjoys playing tennis, reading, and rooting for the New York Knicks.

EXPERTISE: Administration, Billing Management, Customer Service

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The workplace culture. I value Prosperity’s emphasis on supporting the growth and development of its employees, especially those who want to transition into a new specialization or learn new skills.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “And then I woke up…” – Tommy Lee Jones in No Country for Old Men
  • What would your last meal be? Too many options! I would have to say all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ in K-Town in Manhattan, followed by Churro Waffles from Grace Street.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My trip to Marseille, France was the most beautiful vacation I have ever been on. The food and wine are amazing, the city is beautiful, and the weather is perfect. The best part is that it is super affordable!
  • Desert Island Book: The Ascent of Money by Niall Ferguson. Probably the most fascinating book I have ever read about the history and evolution of finance.

name: Mazin El Harith
body_html:
Harith joined the firm in 2024 as a Senior Accounting Associate. He brings to the table a diverse set of experiences in accounting, flow-through entity tax, and small business acquisitions. He started his career within the construction and real estate tax group at a national public accounting firm and later moved on to a boutique firm to focus on serving small business clients before ultimately joining Prosperity Partners.

Harith is a CPA and holds a bachelor’s degree in business administration from the University of Medical Sciences and Technology and a master’s degree in law, business, and economics from the University of Law.

Outside of work, Harith spends time playing and watching soccer, working out, and listening to podcasts.

EXPERTISE: Small Business Accounting, Business Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: Being able to support clients as they grow their businesses. It’s incredibly rewarding to look up one day and see that the small two-person operation you remember from not too long ago has grown to a 30-person team.
  • Best Dish: Taking a very liberal interpretation of the word dish here and going with Limonada (Brazilian lemonade). It doesn’t take much to master and once you have it down it is the perfect summer drink.
  • Board Game: Risk! It’s simple to understand, merit based, rewards risk, and has a well weighted luck component so it won’t ruin your family night like
    Monopoly.
  • Favorite Sport: Soccer. I’ve played soccer since I can remember and still find time to do it today. Indoor, outdoor, messy pickup, organized league – doesn’t matter, I’m in! Favorite player of all time: Ricardo Kaka.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “First prize is a Cadillac Eldorado. Second prize is a set of steak knives. Third prize is you’re fired.”

name: Megan Miskinis
body_html:
mmiskinis@prosperityllc.com

Megan graduated Cum Laude from the University of South Carolina in 2012, with her bachelor’s of science in business administration with a focus in accounting. The following year, Megan graduated from the University of Maryland with a master’s of science in business and management: accounting. Megan joined Prosperity Partners in August of 2023 as an Accounting Manager, specializing in providing outsourced accounting services for a variety of clients including start-ups, small businesses, and personal accounting for high-net-worth individuals. Prior to Prosperity Partners, Megan worked in the Assurance practice at EY in Washington DC, where she spent 3 years working on a variety of public clients. She met her husband and relocated to Pennsylvania where she started a job with Baker Tilly in the Assurance practice working on primarily private clients in the hospitality, franchise, and financial industries. After almost six years, Megan ventured into the client accounting services industry working for Williams Marston, based out of Boston, MA for one year before relocating to South Bend, IN for her husband’s job and starting at Prosperity Partners. In her spare time, Megan likes to go for bike rides with her family, go to Lake Michigan, and golf.

EXPERTISE: US GAAP, Financial Reporting, Process Improvement, Small Business Accounting

Favorite thing about my job: The people! Everyone at Prosperity is so welcoming and supportive, the work environment is unmatched!

Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Hawaii. My husband and I went to Oahu and Maui for our honeymoon and the islands are absolutely incredible. We ate delicious food, hiked Diamond Head, swam in a waterfall, paddle boarded with sea turtles, among other amazing adventures. I can’t wait for another chance to go back!

What is your go-to karaoke song: “Suspicious Minds” by Elvis Presley

I have an irrational fear of: Fish

Favorite workout: Reformer Pilates

name: Megan Nolan
body_html:
Megan Nolan graduated from University of Wisconsin – Madison with a bachelor’s in English literature. After working as General Manager for a restaurant group in Madison, Megan relocated to Chicago and joined Prosperity Partners in 2021. In her spare time, Megan enjoys trying new restaurants, reading, playing video games, and a good beach day at Hollywood Beach.

EXPERTISE: Administration, Customer Service, Project Management

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: My coworkers. Everyone works really well together and the group is great at fostering an environment where you feel comfortable asking questions and learning.
  • Desert island book: “Good Omens” by Neil Gaiman. I have read it about 600 times and could read it another 600 more.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: The month-long trip through Europe. In particular, I really loved Florence and Madrid. I spent way too long staring at “The Garden of Earthly Delights” and “Saturn Devouring his Son” at the Prado and at “La Guernica” at the Reina Sofia. And “The Gates of Paradise” in Florence are beautiful.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I own entirely too many books. My movers when I came to Chicago definitely hated me.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Volleyball! Thank goodness for the Prosperity Partners summer team!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Chappell Roan’s set at Lollapalooza! She is amazing and the crowd was so fun and we were ALL in pink!

name: Melvin Dsouza
body_html:
Melvin is an experienced tax professional with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and Taxation and a strong background in U.S. tax compliance and tax technology. He has hands-on experience preparing and filing federal, state, and local tax returns for Individuals (Form 1040) and Estates (Form 1041), ensuring accuracy and full compliance with current tax legislation. Melvin is proactive, disciplined, and detail-oriented, with a strong ability to solve problems and implement innovative solutions. He is a collaborative team player who builds relationships, communicates effectively, and adapts quickly to new challenges.

Melvin spent three and a half years with Thomson Reuters (SurePrep), where he gained deep expertise in tax preparation workflows and SurePrep binder processing. In addition to tax compliance, he played a key role in supporting tax technology initiatives, including assisting with the development and enhancement of SurePrep (SPBinder) functionality. In addition to tax return preparation, he played a key role training junior staff in an OCR project focused on text extraction, gaining valuable experience at the intersection of tax operations and automation technology. His dedication and performance were recognized at Sureprep with the highest rating from his manager.

With a solid foundation in tax compliance and a strong understanding of tax software ecosystems, Melvin brings accuracy, efficiency, and a continuous improvement mindset to his work. Looking ahead, Melvin is eager to expand his expertise to business tax returns, aiming to broaden his knowledge in corporate and partnership tax compliance.

Expertise: US Individual Tax Preparation, ProSystem, CCH, GoSystem, UltraTax

  • Favorite thing about my job: Working on U.S. tax preparations feels like solving a detailed puzzle. I enjoy analyzing tax documents, applying the right regulations, and finding opportunities to maximize accuracy and compliance. It’s rewarding to turn complex tax information into a clear, correctly filed return that gives clients peace of mind.
  • What would your last meal be? Butter chicken with warm naan on the side. Rich, comforting, and full of flavor – it’s the kind of meal that never gets old and would be the perfect final indulgence.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A trip to the Konkan region in Maharashtra. The quiet beaches, scenic coastal roads, fresh seafood, and relaxed pace made it the perfect escape. Watching sunsets by the sea and exploring lesser-known beaches was incredibly refreshing and memorable!
  • Favorite movie quote: “With great power comes great responsibility” – Spider-Man
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Cycling. It’s my go-to way to unplug, clear my head, and stay active. Whether it’s an early morning ride or a long weekend route, cycling helps me reset, build endurance, and come back refreshed and focused.

name: Michael Clark
body_html:
Michael Clark is a Certified Public Accountant with a Master’s in Professional Accounting from Colorado State University Global and a Bachelor’s degree from the University of Alabama. Since 2015, he has specialized in tax planning, preparing individual and business returns, and providing tax projections to help clients minimize their tax liability. Michael joined Prosperity Partners in October 2024, where he is dedicated to offering personalized advice and strategies to ensure clients make the most of their financial opportunities. Outside of the office, Michael enjoys perfecting his golf game and cheering on Alabama football—Roll Tide!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance, Tax Planning

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Identifying strategies that help minimize my clients tax liability and maximize their financial opportunities! It’s rewarding to know that my expertise can make a tangible difference in their success and help them navigate the complexities of taxes more effectively.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? A charcoal grilled steak (Filet or Ribeye) with a delicious twice baked potato! Our family loves a good Sunday steak dinner.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: For our honeymoon, my wife and I spent an unforgettable week at a Sandals resort in Saint Lucia. The scenery was absolutely stunning, and we were treated to an incredible level of luxury and relaxation throughout our stay.
  • Favorite Concert you attended: Breaking Benjamin or Staind – If you enjoy rock music, I would recommend both!
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Somebody stop me!” – Jim Carrey in “The Mask”

name: Michael Payne
body_html:
Michael Payne graduated from St. Francis College, where he completed a five-year accelerated program earning his Master’s degree in Accounting. During his academic career, he developed a strong foundation in financial reporting, taxation, and business strategy, equipping him with the technical expertise necessary to support complex accounting operations. He brings professional experience in payroll processing, multi-entity bookkeeping, and financial record management, with a focus on accuracy, compliance, and process efficiency. Michael works closely with clients and internal teams to ensure timely reporting and organized financial systems that support informed decision-making. He is committed to continuous learning and maintaining the highest standards of professionalism in his work.

EXPERTISE: Revenue Recognition Analysis, Audit Support

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite thing about my job is the culture, which is rooted in continuous learning and professional growth. Team members are always willing to provide guidance and insight, ensuring that we understand not just how to complete a task, but why it matters. The firm fosters a collaborative and supportive environment where questions are encouraged, and mentorship happens organically. That commitment to development empowers employees to expand their expertise, build confidence, and grow both personally and professionally.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation has to be St. Maarten, a stunning Caribbean Island divided between the Dutch and French sides. I was blown away by the mix of amazing cuisine, the endless mystical beaches, and the breathtaking views at every turn. Honestly, I’d go back every year if I could—maybe even retire there someday! If you haven’t been yet, I’d put it on your bucket list.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Basketball has always been my favorite. I played in high school and college, and I still love the game. These days, I don’t get to play as much as I’d like, but I’m hoping to work it back into my schedule. NYC gyms with courts can be hard to find, so if anyone has recommendations, I’d love to hear them!
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel character, who would it be and why? I’d have to pick Ironman. First off, he’s probably the richest, which guarantees a great dinner no matter what. Then, I need answers—was there really no other way for the Avengers to beat Thanos? And honestly, why didn’t he just send JARVIS in the suit to replace him? Talk about a selfish move. But yeah… Ironman, for sure.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: I’ve only been to two concerts—Drake and Nicki Minaj—so I’d have to go with Drake. He was flying through the air, there was mist everywhere, and I swear he paid someone’s college tuition right there in the floor seats—how cool is that?! Definitely a show I’ll never forget.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is to let my wife take full control of the plans. She proudly claims my birthday as her “half birthday,” since it falls exactly six months from hers — a tradition I’ve learned not to challenge. While I don’t always agree with the budget she has in mind, I can’t argue with the experience. In the end, I always appreciate the time we spend celebrating together… and if I’m being honest, I sometimes enjoy it even more than she does.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Everything by Mary J Blige. The song is just a classic and I have moved rooms while singing it at karaoke. I actually think in my past life I could’ve been a singer, but that’s a tale for another time!

name: Michelle Cantrell
body_html:
Michelle Cantrell started her Bachelor’s in Business Administration with a focus in Finance at DeVry University and finished online with Rasmussen University while working a full-time job in the Mortgage Industry. Additionally, she completed a Mid-Level Leadership Program from Rockhurst University sponsored by The Labor Management Council of Greater Kansas City. The past 6 years she has worked in the Industrial Construction Industry as a Midwest Regional Accounting Manager. Michelle is excited to join Prosperity Partners and for the change in career to have better work-life balance. In her spare time, she enjoys hiking, kayaking, pretty much anything outdoors, and taking in live music at one of the local bars here in Kansas City!

EXPERTISE: GL Budgets, Expenses, Event Planning, Fleet Management

  • What is the best dish you can cook? It would be a tie between Sausage and Shrimp Jambalaya or Creamy Chicken Enchiladas.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: A Caribbean cruise to Honduras, Belize, and Cozumel. My favorite excursion was in Belize where we went cave tubing and zip lining through the rain forest!
  • What is your go to karaoke song? Lose Control by Teddy Swims or Someone Like You by Adele
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: At a previous company, we had a team building event out in Barnard, KS where we shot targets from 500 ft to 1 mile away. I was able to hit every target! It was out in the middle of nowhere, the only way you had cell phone service was back at our cabins with a lodge.
  • Favorite Concert you’ve attended: That is a hard one! Tom Petty was pretty phenomenal, and in the last year I saw Jelly Roll, Shaboozey, Clint Black, Jamey Johnson, Sawyer Brown, & Rascal Flatts. They were all great!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Pickleball.

name: Michelle Glass
body_html:
Michelle Glass started as an accountant with Cendrowski Corporate Advisors and now offers her several years of accounting and tax experience to Prosperity Partners! Prior to Prosperity, she served as a Controller and led the accounting team for a small business that produced merchandise for both wholesale and resale. She managed the accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and daily banking activities, as well as assisted with establishing an inventory system and integrated a cashless point-of-sale option for the company.

EXPERTISE: Accounting, Bookkeeping, Payroll, Tax Preparation 

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The continuous opportunities for professional development. My colleagues have so much to offer with their tax knowledge and are always eager to assist with my growth.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My son and I met my friends in Hershey, PA. I may be “that parent” who allowed the kiddos to eat way too much sugar and run wild – supervised wild of course!
  • I have an irrational fear of: My toes being crushed. This could have something to do with the fact that my sister broke my toe while dancing. We both have no business trying to dance – two left feet is an understatement!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love being outdoors in nature! I’m not the rustic type, but I do love exploring and hiking new trails.

name: Mike Jain
body_html:
mike@prosperityllc.com

Umesh “Mike” Jain hails from the Punjab region of India. He received his bachelor’s degree in 1975 from Punjab University and earned his credentials as a Chartered Accountant while working for A.F. Ferguson & Co (now a part of Deloitte) which at the time was the oldest and most prestigious public accounting firm in India. Mike came to United States in January, 1981 and quickly earned his CPA credentials in Texas. In 1986, he founded the public accounting firm, Jain & Jain, with this wife, Rajni. With a strong focus on client service, Mike and Rajni earned a strong reputation for providing pragmatic, actionable tax and accounting advice and carved out a niche in serving businesses and their owner/operators. Mike is actively involved in the community and currently serves on:

Executive board of The University of Texas Health System
Board member of Woodforest National Bank
Member of the Audit committee of Greater Houston Community Foundation
Member of the economic advisory committee of Lieutenant Governor of Texas.

Mike authored a new book for which he continues to receive plaudits from various political operatives for his prescient perspective. In his spare time, Mike enjoys spending time with his clients, close friends, and family – especially his grandchildren.

EXPERTISE: Partnership Taxation, M&A Tax Structuring, Tax Strategy/Planning

  • Favorite thing about his job – Mike often quips that his last day of work will be the day of his funeral. He truly believes he is one of the lucky few who have been able to turn a passion into a vocation. He loves helping clients solve complex tax and business questions and strongly believes in going the extra mile to ensure that our team is proactively thinking about we can deliver additional value. He loves meeting high-caliber people and developing strong, long-term relationships with them

name: Morgan McCarty
body_html:
Morgan earned her Bachelor’s Degree in Elementary Education before completing her Master of Science in Management and Leadership from Western Governors University. She has built her career around organization, operations, and creating efficient systems that help businesses run smoothly. As a Billing & Licensure Administrator, she enjoys solving problems, streamlining processes, and making sure the details are taken care of so her teammates can focus on serving clients. Morgan believes in building strong relationships, communicating clearly, and always finding a way to get the job done! Outside of work, she teaches Yoga Sculpt classes, loves spending time with her husband and their two dogs, enjoys being at the barn with her horses, and is always looking for new restaurants and foods to try.

EXPERTISE: Billing Administration, Professional Licensure, Operations, Process Improvement, Organization, Client Service, Administrative Support

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: I love finding ways to make things run more efficiently and helping create systems that make everyone’s job easier. There’s nothing more satisfying than solving a problem before it becomes one.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Cabo! Between the views, the amazing food, and the relaxing atmosphere, it’s one of my favorite places to recharge. Riding camels was fun to do as well.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I teach Yoga Sculpt classes outside of work and love helping people feel stronger and more confident. When I’m not teaching, I’m usually spending time with my husband, our two dogs, visiting the barn with my horses, or checking out a new restaurant.
  • What’s the best dish you can cook? Probably tacos or chili. I love cooking, but I also love checking out new restaurants and trying different foods whenever I get the chance.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Yoga Sculpt and strength training.

name: Moshe Bass
body_html:
mbass@prosperityllc.com

With over 15 years of experience in tax consulting and income tax compliance, Moshe is a tax adviser with a broad range of knowledge of tax issues at the federal, state, and local levels, including expertise in high-net-worth tax planning, executive compensation, mergers & acquisitions, and partnership taxation.

Moshe graduated from Yeshiva University with a bachelor’s degree in accounting in 2008 and began his career in New York City. He later moved to Chicago, where he has worked at both small and large public accounting firms, as well as for an ultra-high-net-worth private family office. Since joining Prosperity Partners Chicago office in 2019, Moshe has advanced to tax Partner by 2023, recognized for his knowledge and dedication to providing the best service to clients. As a tax adviser, Moshe focuses on tax consulting and income tax compliance for family offices, executives, privately held businesses, and private equity and venture capital groups. He has a deep understanding of the unique tax needs of his clients and helps them develop personalized strategies to achieve their goals.

As the leader of Prosperity Partners’ mergers & acquisitions team, Moshe manages a range of tax services related to buying and selling businesses. He specializes in optimizing deal structures, guiding tax due diligence, and providing thorough post-transaction support to ensure the best outcomes for clients and their stakeholders.

Moshe is also actively involved in the Illinois CPA Society and is a member of American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He is committed to staying up-to-date with the latest tax developments and trends and using that knowledge to help his clients succeed.
Outside of work, Moshe is a proud husband and father of four children and enjoys spending time with his family.

EXPERTISE: Mergers & Acquisitions, Ultra-high Net Worth Tax Planning, Equity Compensation, Partnership Taxation, State and Local Tax, Estate Planning, Volunteer Disclosure Agreement (VDA) Programs.

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The people! We have an amazing team here at Prosperity Partners, and I feel lucky to learn from and work alongside such talented and dedicated individuals every day.
  • Favorite Prosperity Partners outing you’ve been on: Our 20th Anniversary glamping trip to Camp Aramoni was unforgettable. We had a great time bonding and enjoying the beautiful scenery at Starved Rock State Park.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My family and I spent five incredible weeks in Israel during the summer of 2022. We toured holy sites, explored and excavated ancient caves, swam in the Mediterranean, and enjoyed the middle eastern cuisine.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I like to celebrate at home with my family. The kids make me cards and we order sushi.
  • What would your last meal be? Anything my wife makes! Everything she makes is amazing; she’s a great cook.
