  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Swimming is a personal favorite, but cardio and weights at the gym also gets the job done.

name: Myriam Neesan
body_html:
Myriam Neesan is a Finance Manager with a background in international business, global strategy, and family office operations. She graduated from Valparaiso University with a double major in International Business and German. Myriam has gained expertise across areas such as strategy planning and execution, financial planning, and global operations, ultimately helping clients optimize their resources and achieve long-term goals. She joined Prosperity Partners in 2025, where she focuses on bringing thoughtful financial insights and operational efficiency to support client success. Outside of the office, Myriam enjoys traveling, exploring new restaurants, and hosting themed dinner parties.

EXPERTISE: Financial Strategy, Operations & Project Management, Global Business Strategy

  • Favorite thing about my job: Turning ‘chaos’ into structure and numbers into stories! I enjoy streamlining processes, improving efficiency, and ensuring the numbers tell a clear story that supports the company’s growth.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: On vacation at a great restaurant – bonus points if there is a wine pairing with dinner!
  • What would your last meal be? Medium rare steak, mashed potatoes, a small Caesar salad, and a glass of an amazing red wine.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Anything by Shakira, English or Spanish!
  • I have an irrational fear of: Birds – mostly Chicago pigeons because they’re fearless and basically flying rats.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I recently went to Costa Rica and not only was it beautiful, but we also did so much! We hiked volcanoes, swam with turtles, chased some waterfalls, chartered a boat, surfed, zip lined, and then relaxed at a beach club. It was the perfect combination of adventure and luxury R&R.

name: Nabila Paules-Kiami
body_html:
Nabila Paules-Kiami is a graduate of Walsh College in Troy, Michigan, where she earned a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and a Master’s Degree in Taxation. She is also a Certified Public Accountant (CPA). Following her experience at small to medium-sized firms, she joined Deloitte and KPMG, specializing in international groups. After taking a break from the profession, Nabila returned in 2023 to join the Cendrowski firm, and now serves as a Tax Associate with Prosperity Partners!
EXPERTISE: Business, individual, trust, gift, and private foundation taxes

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: The constant opportunity for learning and growth.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love traveling and have visited over 10 countries!
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Dubrovnik, Croatia. I had the chance to visit various locations where “Game of Thrones” was filmed.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Pilates
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: With my family

name: Neha Brahmania
body_html:
Neha Brahmania is an Enrolled Agent (EA) certified by the IRS with expertise in Taxation and Tax Compliance. She also holds a Master’s Degree of Commerce from Mumbai University. Upon graduation, she joined SurePrep India Pvt. Ltd. where she laid the foundation for her journey in US Taxation, working primarily with Individual and Fiduciary Tax filings. She spent a significant part of her career at Sure Prep as a Tax Reviewer, gaining experience in reviewing returns for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to IRS rules and deadlines. She had the opportunity to work as part of the Tax Technology team, where she was involved in testing the company’s proprietary application, SP Binder, contributing to multiple updates to enhance the application. Since 2009, Neha has frequently traveled to the United States (mostly California and Arizona) for onshore busy season operations, preparing and reviewing complex 1040 and 1041 tax returns. Neha has recently joined Prosperity’s VGSL team as a Tax Reviewer, where she continues to contribute to high-quality tax compliance and team development.

EXPERTISE: Individual and Fiduciary Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy working on tax compliance and constantly keep learning and updating my tax knowledge. Also, I get the opportunity to coordinate with clients which I enjoy!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Staying on the Maldives islands near the ocean. Watching the sunrise and experiencing the local culture was a truly memorable experience.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Painting and drawing! I love expressing creativity through art. Also, I love traveling to new places.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I love jogging and running in the park, and I also enjoy playing Badminton.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be: ‘From Goals to Growth’ would best define my autobiography.
  • What would your last meal be? A home-cooked meal shared with loved ones, ideally eating some Shahi Paneer.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Spending quality time with family, enjoying good food, and relaxing by the beach in the evening.

name: Neha Gupta
body_html:
Neha Gupta received her postgraduate degree in Commerce from Mumbai University. She began her career in 2018 at a Chartered Accountant firm, gaining hands-on experience in Indian accounting, GST, and TDS compliance. In 2021, she expanded into U.S. taxation, and now specializes in Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance, as well as the preparation and review of returns for organizations exempt from Income Tax. Currently working at Prosperity Partners since March 2025, Neha offers expertise in handling complex tax scenarios and is skilled in tax software such as Case Ware, CCH Axccess, SurePrep Binder, and SAGE FAS.

Expertise: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance, Organizations exempt from Income Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy solving complex tax challenges and helping clients stay compliant while optimizing their tax outcomes. The dynamic nature of tax laws keeps me engaged and continuously learning!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I love preparing traditional Indian meals. My best dishes are Pulao, a fragrant rice dish with spices and vegetables, and Aloo Paratha, a stuffed flatbread filled with spiced mashed potatoes served with curd and pickle. They’re my go-to comfort foods.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? One of my most memorable trips was to Ujjain, a city rich in spirituality and history. Visiting the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and the peaceful Ghats made it an unforgettable experience.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love traveling to places rich in history, culture, and food—it recharges me and broadens my perspective!
  • Favorite movie quote: “Bade bade deshon mein aisi chhoti chhoti baatein hoti rehti hain, Senorita.” – Shah Rukh Khan in Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge. Translation is “In big countries, such small things keep happening, Senorita.”

name: Nimesh Sawant
body_html:
Nimesh earned his Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce from Mumbai University in 2018. He entered the field of Tax and Accounting in 2019 and has since gained three years of practical experience in Indian and U.S. Accounting, Taxation, Finance, and Audit. Before joining Prosperity, he served as a Process Associate at Thomson Reuters (part of SurePrep) where he was involved in U.S. Tax operations, focusing on the preparation and review of U.S. Individual Tax return forms 1040 and 1041. His professional experience reflects a strong commitment to accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery for a wide range of clients. He is keen to expand his expertise in U.S. Business Tax returns and U.S. Accounting.

Expertise: Indian Accounting and related software including Tally, Tally Prime, Winman, and WinTDS; U.S. Tax Compliance with Forms 1040 and 1041; Tax Software such as CCH, Go System, ProSystem, UltraTax, and SP Binder

  • Favorite thing about my job: What I enjoy most about my role as a Tax Preparer is the balance between analytical problem-solving and continuous learning. Each tax return brings a unique set of circumstances, allowing me to apply tax laws thoughtfully while staying current with changing regulations.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Dal Rice and Egg Curry.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Visiting Temples and providing a donation.
  • Favorite movie quote: Not a movie quote but once Rohit Sharma (professional Indian Cricketer) said during IPL “Smile… whether we win, whether we lose, we have to just smile…”
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Bike riding, exploring new places, sports activities, and working out!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Cricket and Football

name: Nitin Chandra
body_html:
Nitin Chandra graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a bachelor’s in political science and subsequently earned a master’s degree in mathematics while serving as a New York City Teaching Fellow. He served as a school leader and high school principal at a high performing charter school in Harlem, New York before enrolling at the University of Chicago to earn his MBA where he graduated with concentrations in Strategy, Finance, and Accounting. He subsequently worked in the management consulting groups at McKinsey & Co, Bain & Company before joining the public accounting industry via Jain & Jain. At Prosperity Partners, Nitin is a Partner in the Houston Office where he helps oversee the Tax and Accounting teams. When not working, Nitin loves spending time with his family and friends.

EXPERTISE: Business Operations and Strategy, Mergers & Acquisitions, Client Relations & Business Development

  • Favorite thing about my job – Our clients rely on us to solve their most complex business and personal tax/accounting problems and often lean on discuss larger business strategy and operations challenges as well. There is no better feeling than digging in to work alongside an awesome team to continually earn clients’ trust and confidence. I draw so much energy and motivation when meeting with a prospective client who has been referred to us by an existing client or friend of the firm and they highlight our reputation as a key driver for considering a move to our firm.
  • Work outing: Annual firm retreat to Park City – it’s been a great way to celebrate and build bonds with our incredible team members.
  • Best thing I can cook:  I received a wood-fired pizza oven for my birthday a few years ago and have been working on my pizza skills ever since. Nothing better than slinging some homemade pies for friends and family on the weekends!
  • Favorite vacation: After we got married, my wife and I escaped from the world via a six-month honeymoon backpacking across Southeast Asia and Japan. It was the trip of a lifetime. We limited ourselves to a budget of $40/day which led to some very interesting decisions and experiences including sleeping in a treehouse that we could only zipline into and out of in Laos!

name: Otto Maeglin
body_html:
Otto Maeglin graduated from the University of Virginia earning a BS in Commerce with a concentration in Finance, as well as a BA in Economics. After graduating from college, he joined Pipaya (now part of Prosperity Partners) to pursue his interest in mergers & acquisitions and transaction advisory. He is passionate about helping clients navigate a successful transaction and enjoys the learning and problem solving unique to each deal. In his spare time, he enjoys traveling, hiking, and cheering for the Eagles, Phillies and 76ers!

EXPERTISE: Mergers & Acquisitions, Financial Modeling, Aerospace, Defense & Government Services (ADG) accounting, and Post-Acquisition Integration Consulting

  • Favorite thing about my job: Tackling new and unique problems every day to help serve our clients.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The Transaction Advisory Group’s annual retreat to Breckenridge where I have the opportunity to get to know my coworkers better during a variety of events including skiing, snowmobiling, and firm dinners.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Driving coast to coast across the United States the summer after graduating college while hiking and camping in 15+ national parks along the way!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Fishing (though often not catching anything)!
  • What would your last meal be? Either sushi or a steak – maybe both because it’s my last meal.

name: Owen Byrne
body_html:
As a Tax Manager, Owen works with a wide variety of clients, including Individuals, Estates, Trusts, Family Partnerships, and Small Businesses. A professional in the accounting field since 1985, Owen spent most of his career—28 years—with CPI Associates Inc. until they joined with Farkouh Furman & Faccio in 2018. He is looking forward to new challenges and opportunities with the recent merger of FF&F to Prosperity Partners.

An honest and dependable professional, Owen strives to focus on client relationships by putting his clients’ needs first. He is a valuable resource for his clients – they regularly seek him out for his opinion on business and personal financial matters. Owen chose to pursue a career in accounting because of the job stability that the field offers. He attributes his success to his attitude and ability to offer his clients what they want.

Owen lives in Hazlet, New Jersey with his wife of 36 years, Florence. They have three adult children.

  • Favorite work outing you’ve attended: I enjoy the annual softball outing in Central Park, shagging fly balls in the outfield!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My birthday is in February, so I like to travel to the sunshine state to play golf.

name: Patricia Krout
body_html:
Patricia Krout graduated from the University of California at Santa Barbara with a bachelor’s degree in business economics.  After joining the firm in 1991, she completed her master’s degree in taxation at Golden Gate University.  She has served as President of the Santa Barbara Chapter of the American Society of Women Accountants and as the President of the Channel Counties Chapter of the California Society of Certified Public Accountants.   She also spent many years as the chair of the local Scholarship Committee.   Patricia was promoted to partner in 2008.

EXPERTISE: Privately Held Business, Ultra-High Net Worth, Family Tax & Estate Planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: Collaborating with the unique clients and our team to produce customized solutions for their needs.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Off the grid camping on Santa Barbara Island in the rain during Spring.  Abundant giant coreopsis and brown pelicans everywhere.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Gardening, hiking and animal rescue.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Alejandro Escovedo with Tosta at the Lobero Theatre.  They played an acoustic set in the audience (right next to me), it was magic.

name: Patricia Wilkie
body_html:
Patricia Wilkie attended Grand Valley State University and began her career in business development in the non-profit sector. After discovering a love for accounting, she pursued further education at Santa Barbara City College, and has been in public accounting since then. Patricia joined Prosperity in August of 2022 and her focus is client accounting services. In her spare time, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, traveling, hiking, and reading.

EXPERTISE: Small business accounting, personal financial accounting, non-profit accounting.

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love to learn and am naturally curious, I also enjoy providing support. And there is always something novel to learn, a collaboration to foster, and a client to support.
  • Desert island book: “Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy” by Douglas Adams. (So long, and thanks for all the fish!)
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Recently my partner and I visited Siena, Italy. The scenes, cycling, history, culture, pasta and wine were all incredible.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby?: I love anything creative: Fiber arts, cooking, advocacy writing, gardening, and floral design.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: A small dinner party with close friends.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play?: My favorite sport to play is soccer, and I enjoy running, cycling, and yoga.

name: Peggy Challe
body_html:
Peggy Challe graduated from the University of Wisconsin with a B.S. in Communication Arts and brings over 20 years of experience in Public Accounting and Asset Management Talent Acquisition. She began her career at Citi and most recently worked at Grant Thornton before joining Prosperity Partners. Peggy has a strong track record of sourcing and placing senior, mid-level, and early-career professionals, managing the full recruitment lifecycle. She serves as a trusted advisor to both stakeholders and candidates, aligning top-tier talent with opportunities where they can thrive and create long-term value. Her dedication, insight, and personal approach make her a valued partner in executive recruiting. In her spare time, Peggy is an avid skier and enjoys running and participating in races around NYC.

EXPERTISE: Talent Acquisition

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy the collaborative, entrepreneurial environment. It’s rewarding to be part of a growing firm where relationships matter, and everyone is invested in long-term success.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: The Central Park summer picnic was a great work outing, and it was so funny seeing how quickly “just for fun” turned into “we’re keeping score, right?”
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was a 2025 ski trip to Cortina d’Ampezzo, Italy. Skiing the Dolomites and taking in the breathtaking scenery was an unforgettable experience.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? According to my family, my signature dish is Buffalo Chicken Dip — a recipe that has achieved near-legendary status at gatherings and is rumored to bring good luck during Packers games. I don’t claim to control the outcome, but the theory has been well tested!

name: Priya Desai
body_html:
Priya Desai graduated from Mumbai University with a specialization in Accounting and Economics. She began her career at Sure Prep in 2002 as a Tax Preparer. Due to her strong performance and dedication, she was quickly promoted to Tax Reviewer. At Sure Prep, Priya also led a team within the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) department, managing team operations and driving process improvements. Since 2011, she has had the opportunity to work onshore in the United States, frequently traveling to prepare and review individual (1040) and fiduciary (1041) tax returns. After 23 years of dedicated service at Sure Prep, Priya joined Prosperity’s VGS team as an Assistant Tax Manager, bringing extensive experience and leadership in tax preparation and review.

  • Favorite thing about my job: One of my favourite aspects of working in tax is the continuous opportunity to learn and grow. Each client and return present a unique challenge, keeping the work engaging and intellectually stimulating. I especially enjoy reviewing complex returns and mentoring junior team members. Sharing my experience while staying current with evolving tax regulations makes the field truly fulfilling for me.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? An Indian favorite — Puran Poli.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: One of my most memorable work outings was a team-building trip organized by Sure Prep at a scenic resort outside the city. We participated in group activities, workshops, and team games, which helped us bond outside the office, strengthen teamwork, and relax after busy tax seasons. The experience fostered lasting professional relationships and made me value the power of collaboration.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday? With my family members.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? Visiting my brother’s house in Texas.
  • Title of my autobiography: Finding My Way: A Journey of Growth and Resilience
  • Favorite movie quote: “Babu Moshai, life should be big, not long” – Annand.

name: Rafael Ramirez
body_html:
Rafael Ramirez graduated from the University of Kansas in May of 2024 with a bachelor’s degree in Accounting and Information Systems. Rafael is currently pursuing a master’s degree in Business Analytics at Loyola University, Chicago. Rafael joined Prosperity Partners in September of 2024 as a Tax Technologist. In this role, he strives to bridge the gap between accounting and information technology professionals. In his spare time, Rafael enjoys exploring Chicago with his dog, Georgia, and watching the Kansas City Chiefs.

EXPERTISE: Accounting Information Systems, Problem Solving, Analytics

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people. Everyone here at Prosperity Partners is committed, helpful, and team oriented. It has made the transition into this new role very easy.
  • Favorite movie quote: “So you’re telling me there’s a chance…” “Dumb and Dumber” – 1994
  • I have an irrational fear of _____: birds.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I always enjoy a nice meal with my family and close friends. The meal is typically a nice steak dinner and an ice cream cake for dessert.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Rihanna’s Super Bowl 57 Halftime Show. It made it even better watching my hometown team win the Super Bowl shortly after.

name: Rajni Jain
body_html:
Rajni graduated with a master’s degree in accounting, from Punjab University in India. She began her career as a Professor of Financial Accounting and Business Management and subsequently served as the Dean of the Business School at Khalsa College for Men, Ludhiana, India. Rajni came to the US after getting married to Mike Jain in 1983.  After moving to the US, she started working in public accounting and earned her CPA. In January 1986, Rajni and Mike started their own practice – Jain & Jain, P.C. Rajni supports the CAS team in Houston and has led the charge in identifying and implanting various outsourcing solutions for accounting and bookkeeping services. Under her leadership, the outsourced function continues to grow in the breadth and depth of services they are able to provide.

In her spare time, Rajni loves to sing Bollywood songs and leads several Karaoke groups. She enjoys spending time with close family, friends, and clients and loves to foster and build new relationships. She has a knack for bringing people together and never shies away from an opportunity to host an event at her home – whether staff holiday celebrations, social dinners with clients, fund-raising events for various political officials, or equity-raising for new business ventures.

EXPERTISE: Accounting, Event Management, Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love talking to and spending time with our clients. I truly believe that socializing and building deep relationships is crucial to truly understanding the challenges they face and the unique perspectives they have. And doing so also allows us to help them in a much more proactive and meaningful way.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: For the past several years, we have taken our team on an annual retreat to Park City where we get to unwind and spend time with one another in a relaxed manner over several days. It’s been a wonderful way to really get to know some of our newer team members and to for the entire team to bond with one another.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I love to cook and try new recipes. I am most comfortable with traditional Indian cooking but can also make some delicious vegetarian Mexican dishes including a very tasty pinto beans and rice.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love to sing & playing card games (spades, rummy, flash)  with friends/clients
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Bollywood
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday:  Spend time with the whole family!
  • If you could have dinner with one celebrity, who would it be and why? Amitabh Bachchan! He is one charismatic person that I admire for who he is, has gone through and come out in flying colors, and the respect and adoration of the entire nation that he commands!

name: Rangoli Sen
body_html:
Rangoli Sen graduated with a Bachelor of Science Degree and is a Chartered Accountant from India. She started her career at PwC Consulting and worked as a finance professional at Watson Wyatt (now Towers Watson) in Gurgaon, Kolkata India. After moving to the US, she passed the US CPA exams and has worked for 10+ years as a tax professional/supervisor for boutique public accounting firms in NJ.

She joined Prosperity Partners in December 2025 as part of the merger between Prosperity Partners and Mizrach Group (Dorfman Mizrach and Thaler), taking on the role of Senior Tax Associate.

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, Corporate Taxes, Tax Planning and Tax Projections, 1031 Exchange Transactions analysis, Preparation of PFS, Preparation of benchmark reports comparing internal KPIs against industry standards to assist clients with strategic decision-making

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Working with talented, supportive people and engaging in challenging, new tasks which help me gain expertise. Solving clients’ tax problems and bringing them peace of mind is truly rewarding!
  • Favorite Concert you’ve Attended: Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony at Phoenix Symphony Hall conducted by Tito Munoz – an orchestral masterpiece!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I am a seafood enthusiast who loves making Indian seafood recipes.
  • Desert Island Book: The Charles Dickens Collection. Each book is immersive enough to keep my mind engaged on a desert island.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Alaska’s Inside Passage cruise in 2013. It was a breathtaking and unforgettable voyage through fjords, islands, and coastal towns of Alaska.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I enjoy listening to music. I also like to do embroidery and pencil sketching.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Bollywood dance-cardio workouts and yoga.

name: Ravinder Jain
body_html:
Ravinder earned his master’s degree in mathematics from premier institute IIT Roorkee in India. He also graduated with a law degree from Panjab University in India. Ravinder served as Economic Adviser to Government of Punjab prior to joining Jain & Jain, PC in 2004. In 2024, Ravinder joined Prosperity Partners as a senior associate as part of the partnership between Prosperity Partners and Jain & Jain.

EXPERTISE:  Individual Tax & Tax Planning, Client Accounting Services

  • Favorite thing about my job:  Tax planning has been my passion the since beginning. I love working closely with my clients.
  • What is the best dish you can cook?  I can make best tofu in the world
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby?  Reading books and current affairs
  • What would your last meal be?  Lentils with rice
  • Favorite workout or sport to play?  I love to play Tennis in my spare time

name: Rebekah Carr
body_html:
Rebekah Carr graduated from the University of Illinois at Chicago with her master’s in accounting. After completing the internship program at Prosperity Partners, Rebekah joined the team as a full-time associate concentrating on accounting. She eventually switched focus to tax and now, as a Senior Associate, specializes in preparing returns for foreign individuals and individuals with stock option income elements. Rebekah enjoys walking nature trails with her dog, attending metalcore concerts, reading, and playing video games. She’s lived in 5 states, the latest of which is South Carolina.

EXPERTISE: Tax Compliance and Consulting

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: Being able to own my work and move things forward in a productive manner. I can work independently while having incredibly knowledgeable coworkers a Teams message away to bounce ideas off.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Tequila – The Champs.
  • Desert island book: Don’t make me choose one! Daisy Darker by Alice Feeney is a good one; it’s heavily inspired by Agatha Christie’s And Then There Were None and the ending had me questioning everything I’d read. The Scythe series by Neal Shusterman is also a great read with excellent social commentary.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Either lemon chicken parmesan pasta or my breakfast casserole.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: In no particular order: a large brown sugar boba, a slice of peanut butter pie, a long walk in nature, video games, a beach day, and flatly singing songs in the car.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Taking a shower during a lightning storm and being electrocuted.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Bring Me The Horizon in 2017 at the Aragon Ballroom or Sleep Token in 2024.

name: Rhonda Stewart
body_html:
Rhonda is a skilled administrative professional with a proven track record of efficiency and organization. With over 25 years of experience in the field, Rhonda has developed a keen eye for detail and a strong ability to prioritize tasks effectively. Known for exceptional time management skills, Rhonda consistently meets deadlines and delivers high-quality work in a friendly and approachable demeanor. She excels in providing excellent customer service and builds strong relationships with clients and colleagues. She has a passion for streamlining processes and improving productivity. Rhonda is dedicated to making a positive impact in the workplace.

EXPERTISE: Administrative Support, Customer Service, Organization and Time Management, Adaptability, and Teamwork.

  • Favorite thing about my job: Rhonda loves spending time with her Houston-based colleagues at Prosperity Partners – especially the daily routine of breaking for lunch and using that time to catch up with colleagues.
  • What is the best dish you can cook?: My best cooked dish is Cream of Baked Chicken Legs with rice, green beans, and biscuits.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? The title of my autobiography would be Homegirl Rhonda.
  • I have an irrational fear of… I have an irrational fear of ALL insects, EVEN LADY BUGS.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? My favorite work out is punching a boxing bag, and my favorite sport is softball.

name: Richard Lemanski
body_html:
Richard Lemanski is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) with extensive experience in both auditing and tax preparation. He graduated from George Mason University with a degree in Accounting and quickly passed the CPA exam, aided by a review course led by his professors. Richard began his career working for various local, regional, and national CPA firms, where he gained valuable experience as an auditor and tax preparer.

He later joined Wiener and Garg CPAs, where he focused on his passion for tax work. Over the years, Richard has developed a deep expertise in the tax treatment of real estate development and rental activities and has enjoyed working with a diverse range of businesses and individuals throughout the Washington, DC area.

Outside of his professional life, Richard enjoys hiking with his dogs along the Potomac River trails in Northern Virginia and spending time at home working on small projects.

EXPERTISE: Real Estate Tax, Rental Income, Business and Individual Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: The constant change in the tasks at hand, from reconciling the year-end books for a client, projecting a client’s yearly tax liability, to staying up to date on the latest tax law changes. It’s always something new.
  • Desert island book: I’m a fan of John LeCarre spy novels
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Smoking a rack of ribs on my Weber barbeque
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken:   My favorite vacation spot is on Ocracoke Island, NC. It’s a small island on the Outer Banks of NC, part of the Cape Hatteras National Seashore, with no franchised hotels or restaurants on the island. Just miles of pristine, natural beaches.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I enjoy spending time with friends and family that I’ve known for years, and who know me as a person, but like me anyway!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My favorite recent outing was going with my son to a Joe Bonamassa concert, where I introduced him to what real music sounds like. (Joe B. is, in the opinion of many, myself included, one of the worlds greatest living guitarists!)
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? I enjoy watching Baseball, especially when DC has a contending team, (But that’s been a while now since the National’s 2019 World Series win!) The football here in DC has been atrocious for some time now, but we’re finally improving, now that new ownership has taken over.

name: Rohnish Santosh Shinde
body_html:
Rohnish Santosh Shinde is a Verification Associate at Prosperity with a Master’s Degree in Advanced Accounting and a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and Finance from Vidyalankar Institute of Information Technology. He began his professional journey in 2021, specializing in U.S. individual tax verification and preparation using SurePrep, a Thomson Reuters platform. In November 2024, Rohnish joined Instalogic Solution Private Limited as an Audit Consultant, contributing to high-impact government projects for the Government of Maharashtra. His work focused on Financial Impact Assessments, where he analyzed budget allocations, resource utilization, and financial outcomes to provide data-driven policy recommendations for improving governance. He also led social audits of welfare schemes, evaluating program effectiveness, transparency, and alignment with intended goals. His insights played a key role in workplace implementations and enhancing accountability within public service delivery. In August 2025, Rohnish took on the role of Verification Associate, bringing his analytical expertise and commitment to precision into the verification domain.

Expertise: U.S. Individual Tax Verification & Preparation, Financial Impact Assessments, Social Audit and Policy Evaluation

  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Theatre/acting, bike riding, and exploring new places!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Chicken Curry with Grilled Chicken and Dal Rice
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday? Spending birthdays with orphaned children and senior citizens.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? Some favorite locations I have visited include Leh-Ladakh, Manali, Punjab, Kerala, and Jaipur!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Papon or Arjit Singh
  • What would your last meal be? Maharashtrian and Chinese food.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Cricket, Tug of War, or Kabaddi

name: Roland Diobe
body_html:
BIO: Roland Diobe is a Certified Public Accountant with an MBA from Cardiff Metropolitan University, UK, and a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Oxford Brookes University, UK. He worked for two other public accounting firms before joining Prosperity in 2023 as a Senior Tax Associate. He works principally on business taxes and takes pride in completing tax engagements accurately and efficiently! When he is not at work, he enjoys spending time with his family.

EXPERTISE: Tax and Accounting

  • Favorite thing about my job: Team Spirit! Everyone is so committed and helpful.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Soccer and Tennis

name: Romie Gallardo
body_html:
Romie comes to us with years of bookkeeping experience in a variety of fields – both business & individual. She is a Santa Barbara native having raised her son & daughter here. When not at the office, she enjoys spending time with family & friends either enjoying a good home cooked meal or the beautiful outdoors of the city she calls home. As a lover of animals, there is always a resident fur critter.

EXPERTISE: Bookkeeping, Court Accounting, Property Tax Returns, 1099 Filings, Bill Pay, Statement of Information Forms, Special Projects

  • Favorite thing about my job: Variety of my duties, the camaraderie with my co-workers, working in an environment that fosters learning.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Pop Tarts
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Don’t take vacations.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I don’t have any hobbies, I just do things.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Don’t do Karaoke.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My birthday is just another day.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Have never attended a concert.
  • What would your last meal be? Pop Tarts

name: Ryan Goodfellow
body_html:
Ryan Goodfellow graduated from Michigan State University with a Major in Finance and a Minor in Economics. Ryan started his career as an intern with Cendrowski Corporate Advisors before joining the Prosperity Partners Tax team fulltime in 2025. As a Tax Associate, he assists our team by using the accounting and financial analysis skills he developed through his two successful internships at Prosperity. Ryan served as the President of Michigan State’s Club Hockey Team while in college and continues to play hockey in his free time.

EXPERTISE: Financial Accounting, Financial Analysis, Tax

  • Favorite thing about my job: Learning every day! As a young and eager-to-learn team member, being able to work alongside so many colleagues that are experts in my field allows me to develop into a better professional.
  • Favorite movie quote: “The secret impresses no one. The trick you use it for is everything.” – The Prestige
  • What would your last meal be? A Tomahawk Steak and Lobster Mac and Cheese
  • If you could have dinner with one Marvel Character, who would it be and why? Wolverine – I am curious to see if he would use his claws as utensils.
  • What is the best dish you can make? Sushi! In high school I worked as a Sushi Chef at a revolving sushi restaurant for a summer.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: During my junior year of college, my roommate and I went to Madrid and Barcelona on spring break to visit a friend that was studying abroad. Although I got food poisoning on the first day, the museums, restaurants, architecture, and cultural experiences made up for it!

name: Samantha Gordon
body_html:
Samantha Gordon graduated from the University of Illinois at Chicago with a master’s of science in accounting; shortly after graduating she joined the firm as an intern in 2015. She works mainly on the financial solutions side of the firm with extensive experience with start-ups, SaaS, and whole-sale businesses. When not working, Samantha enjoys spending time with her chocolate lab (aptly named Hershey), reading, and going to music festivals.

EXPERTISE: GAAP/IFRS Compliance, Revenue Recognition Analysis, Audit Support/Preparation

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: How collaborative everyone is and their willingness to help.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Aruba – Celebrated a friend, enjoyed the beautiful beaches and went cliff-diving and para-sailing for the first time.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? “Sure, Why Not” – This response has been the start of many fun adventures for me.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Scrabble – I get handed a lot of pieces and have to figure out how to make sense of them.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: A music festival or vacation – but definitely somewhere sunny with friends and family.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Beyonce – the answer is always Beyonce.

name: Samuel Kang
body_html:
Samuel Kang graduated from Rutgers Business School with his Bachelors in Accounting and a Master of Science in Taxation, bringing over 15 years of experience in Tax Advisory services to Prosperity Partners. He focuses his practice in real estate and financial services, providing both tax planning and compliance services for pass-through entities and high-net-worth individuals. During his spare time, he enjoys spending time with his family, attending church every week, golfing, and playing cards with his close friends.

EXPERTISE: Partnership Taxation, Ultra-High-Net-Worth Tax Planning, State & Local Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: My colleagues! We have an extremely talented and fun team who I can rely on and trust to tackle almost any tax problem that comes our way.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Livin’ la Vida Loca by Ricky Martin. It’s always a crowd pleaser.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Our annual picnic at Central Park. Free food and drinks, dodgeball, softball …. what’s there not to like here?!
  • Favorite quote: “Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the mouth” – Mike Tyson. It reminds me to have resilience when adversity inevitably comes my way.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? I’m not sure, but I am always down to play a game or two of Settlers of Catan!

name: Sandeep Guha
body_html:
Sandeep completed his Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce with a double major in Tax and Accounting. As a dedicated Tax professional since 2019, he finds immense satisfaction in deciphering the complexities of financial regulations to help individuals and businesses navigate their tax obligations efficiently and ethically. Sandeep has developed a strong expertise in preparing individual and trust returns within collaborative environments. He is able to leverage data analysis to drive growth and has hands-on experience with five different tax software programs. He served as a Senior Tax Analyst and ATR Reviewer at Thomson Reuters, a role he held since January 2022. At Thompson Reuters, Sandeep independently managed over half of the e-filing workload, prioritizing returns based on due dates, page count, and domain, while diligently staying updated with current tax provisions. Additionally, he mentored junior team members in creating tax case studies and sorting PDFs for training purposes.

Expertise: 1040/1041 (HNI) Clients, Reporting of Foreign Forms FinCen 114, 8621, 8865 & 8886 Disclosure Statement.

  • Favorite thing about my job: The most rewarding aspect of my job is the direct impact I have on my clients’ financial well-being, providing clarity and peace of mind in what can often be a confusing landscape.
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Beyond the number-crunching and client meetings, my firm values team cohesion, and the annual work outings are always a highlight. A memorable one was an interactive outdoor badminton tournament followed by a shared meal; it was a great way to bond with colleagues outside of spreadsheets and deadlines. It allowed us to see each other in a different light and fostered a strong sense of camaraderie.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: When it’s time to recharge, my favourite vacation was a serene two-week trip to Manali in Himachal Pradesh. The breathtaking mountain scenery offered the perfect escape, blending peaceful hiking during the day with delicious local cuisine in the evenings. The change of pace and majestic views were truly restorative, helping me return to work with a fresh perspective.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Away from my professional life, my side passion is reading lit classics and painting. These hobbies are wonderful creative outlets that contrast nicely with the abstract nature of tax consulting.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: To maintain balance and fitness, my favourite workout is trail running. The varied terrain and connection with nature provide an invigorating challenge that clears my head and keeps me energized for both my work and my hobbies!

name: Sara Agin
body_html:
Sara joined Prosperity Partners as an Intern during her senior year at the University of South Carolina, where she earned a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance and Accounting. While at UofSC, she was recognized as an Accounting Scholar and broadened her perspective through a semester abroad in Florence, Italy. After graduation, Sara returned to Prosperity full-time as an Accounting Associate in the Chicago office. In this role, she leverages her foundation in financial accounting to support clients and contribute to the success of the Client Accounting Services (CAS) team. Outside of work, Sara enjoys trying new recipes and oil painting.

EXPERTISE: Financial Accounting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: I enjoy working with a diverse group of clients and collaborating with our amazing CAS team!
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “You’re a wizard, Harry!” – Rubeus Hagrid, Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Brown Butter Cinnamon Rolls
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Spending a night in the Sahara Desert in Morocco
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Rummikub

name: Sarah Bassett
body_html:
Sarah Bassett graduated from Hillsdale College with honors in 2016 with a major in Accounting and a minor in Math. While at Hillsdale College, she was an active member of Kappa Kappa Gamma sorority. With 8 years of experience in public accounting, Sarah joined the firm in June 2024. She has been an active licensed CPA since 2019. Her main focus is individual and business tax compliance.

Sarah enjoys a variety of physical activities including swimming, walking, and gym workouts. She loves the great lakes and savors her summer weekends on Lake Huron. She loves to visit family in Florida – especially to warm up in the winter!

EXPERTISE: Tax Preparation and Review, Individual and Business Tax Compliance, Tax Planning, Accounting

  • Favorite part of my job: I love the people and how supportive everyone has been since my arrival. My passion is assisting taxpayers to maximize their tax savings and save for the future.
  • Favorite Vacation Taken: 14 days in Maui, Hawaii
  • Favorite Work Outing: I have enjoyed every outing getting to know my coworkers better, particularly my first trip to the Birmingham Country Club
  • Irrational Fear: Snakes
  • Favorite Concert: Bon-Jovi
  • Favorite Workout: Speedwalking/Running preceded by lunges and pushups

name: Scarlett Williams
body_html:
Scarlett Williams is a Certified Public Accountant with an MBA from Louisiana State University and a Bachelor’s Degree from the University of Arkansas. She was a student athlete on the collegiate gymnastics team for both schools (3 years and 1 redshirt at Arkansas and 1 year at LSU). Since 2016, Scarlett has worked with various CPA firms including the Big 4 and has found her passion supporting family offices and high net worth individuals. Outside of work, she enjoys being active and spending time with her 100lb Akita fur-baby named Kuma!

EXPERTISE: Family Office, Individual, Partnership, and Trusts

  • Favorite thing about my job: Helping families tax plan and leave behind a legacy for their children and grandchildren.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Red beans and rice. Tradition in Louisiana on Mondays!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Rome. Went with my family and would go back in a heartbeat.
  • Favorite Movie Quote: “Bye Buddy! Hope you find your dad!” – Elf
  • I have an irrational fear of: Eighteen wheelers carrying logs… blame Final Destination 2!
  • What would your last meal be? Sushi

name: Scout Precourt
body_html:
Scout Precourt completed her Undergraduate and Master of Accountancy Degree at the University of Vermont. She interned at Danaher Attig & Plante, PLC for three of her undergraduate years and ended up joining the firm as a fulltime employee upon graduation! Scout joined Prosperity Partners as a Senior Tax Associate in the spring of 2025, specializing in preparing and reviewing complex tax returns for high-net-worth individuals, trusts, estates, and businesses. However, she favors the challenge of estate and gift tax returns, which require a smart mix of accuracy, planning, and attention to what makes each case unique.

In her spare time, Scout enjoys spending time with her kids (Michael, Adalyn, Montie, and Imani). Taxes could never compete with the sound of their laughter. And when a rare quiet moment arises, she happily reclaims it for some much-needed rest!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Trust, and Gift Tax Preparation & Review

  • Favorite thing about my job: My coworkers are the best part of my job! I’ve had the true privilege of working alongside some of the kindest, most supportive, and encouraging people imaginable.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Chuletas Guisadas (Puerto Rican Stewed Pork Chops) served over rice or mashed potatoes.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My birthday is a long, drawn out, holiday. I enjoy spending time with my family, spending time alone, and taking up a little more space in the world.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love helping my son with his lemonade business, Mighty Mike’s Lemonade. His business has grown from doing the local farmers markets to doing large, local events. It’s fun to watch him grow as a young entrepreneur and help behind the scenes!
  • I have an Irrational Fear of: Insects and spiders.

name: Sela Hocker
body_html:
Sela Hocker graduated with honors from the University of Washington, earning a Dual Bachelor’s Degree in English and Education, Communities, and Organizations (ECO). After graduation, she relocated from Seattle to Chicago where she began working in education and classroom management. In 2025, she earned her Project Coordinator Certification from Cornell, which inspired her transition into an administrative role. As Office Coordinator, Sela oversees all matters related to our Chicago Headquarters, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while fostering a positive and welcoming office culture. In her spare time, Sela enjoys dancing at shows, spending time by the lake, junk journaling, and unwinding with a good book.

EXPERTISE: Project Management, Customer Service, Administration

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: How supportive and positive the team is! The prospect of diving into the corporate world made me more nervous than parent-teacher conferences ever did, but the energy at Prosperity is so welcoming that I immediately felt comfortable. Everyone genuinely wants you to succeed, which made transitioning into a new field far less intimidating than I ever expected. At Prosperity, your colleagues are always happy to lend a hand or answer a question, all you have to do is ask. I feel incredibly fortunate to be part of such a cohesive team.
  • Desert Island Book: Jane Eyre or The Picture of Dorian Gray – I’m a self-proclaimed English lit nerd!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Electric Forest in Rothbury, Michigan is my all-time favorite festival. It’s a whole weekend of escaping into nature, listening to my favorite music, and connecting with the coolest people!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Dance and Pilates! I’ve danced my whole life, and it has always been my favorite way to clear my mind and re-center. Music + movement is my go-to mood booster.

name: Shannon Richards
body_html:
Shannon Richards is from Chicago, Illinois and currently works as a part of the Client Accounting Services team in the New York City office. She graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Miami and has a Master’s Degree in Music from Indiana University. Shannon has been working in the accounting field for several years and has gained experience in a myriad of sectors (anything from non-profits to starts ups) but primarily focuses on high-net-worth individual and family office accounting. Outside of the office, Shannon continues to pursue creative endeavors in both the music and ceramic realms.

EXPERTISE: High-Net-Worth/Family Office Accounting, Personal Financial Accounting, Small Business Accounting, Administration

  • Favorite thing about my job: I really like the people that I work with. Our office has a great community of associates, and I enjoy getting to spend time with the team.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I sell pottery that I make, and I do gig work as a singer! Both bring me a lot of joy.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: That’s tough, but I recently saw Lady Gaga in Paris and it was incredible.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I run a decent amount and enjoy it! I run a few small races a year.

name: Shashin Bhukhanwala
body_html:
Shashin Bhukhanwala graduated from Mumbai University with a degree in Accounting and Economics. After graduating, he pursued his Chartered Accountancy from the ICAI and cleared his Intermediate examinations. He joined SurePrep India (Pvt) ltd in 2004, heading a project for one of the biggest clients of the company for 7 years. For many years, he was a part of the testing team that tested 1040 SCAN products before being released for use. After working for more than 20 years with SurePrep, he joined Prosperity’s VGS team as a Tax Manager.

Expertise: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: Interacting with different Tax Managers from various offices across the US.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I am not a good cook, but can cook a nice Jeera Rice dish (easy and quick)!
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday? Spending the evening with my family at a nice beach.
  • What would your last meal be? Pooran Poli – A wheat tortilla bread stuffed with sweetened chickpea stuffing.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Mera naam hai crime master gogo—aya hu to kuch lekar hi jaaunga.” Translation is “My name is Master GoGo – If I come, I will take something with me.”

name: Siu Tsang
body_html:
Siu Tsang graduated from the University of Houston with a bachelor’s degree in business administration and accounting. He is a Certified Public Accountant with a specialization in accounting and business taxation across various industries including real estate, waste management, construction, and healthcare service providers. In his spare time, Siu enjoys cycling with his son, travelling, and spending time with his family.

EXPERTISE: SALT, Partnership Taxation, Mergers and Acquisitions

  • Favorite thing about my job: One thing that I love about my job is that I feel like I am always learning something new to better help our clients. With the diversity and complexity of clients that we serve, there are many opportunities to identify new tax strategies and apply my expertise in new circumstances and scenarios.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Coca-Cola chicken wings
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Earlier this year, my family and I went to Banff National Park for three days. We love being outside in nature and Banff offered a very refreshing and breathtaking escape after the spring busy season.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: Watching a movie at home with a delicious birthday cake.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Talk to the hand” – Terminator

name: Sony Dubey
body_html:
Sony Dubey holds a Masters of Commerce from Mumbai University. Upon graduation, she began her career at Datamatics Global Services Ltd., where she laid the foundation for her journey in tax compliance. Sony started by preparing individual (1040) tax returns and quickly advanced her knowledge across multiple areas, including the partnership and corporate prep and review process. Over the years she has also taken on mentoring roles, guiding new team members, and contributing to a collaborative learning environment. During her three-year tenure at Thomson Reuters (SurePrep), she gained deep experience and comprehensive knowledge in all aspects of tax compliance. In March 2025, she joined Prosperity Partners, where her dedication, versatility, and commitment to continuous learning were quickly recognized with a promotion to her current role.

Expertise: Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax Compliance

  • Favorite thing about my job: I thrive in dynamic environments where there’s always something new to learn. I enjoy the balance of preparing and reviewing tax returns and find particular fulfillment in mentoring peers – I believe that teaching is one of the best ways to solidify knowledge.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I love diving into fictional worlds and exploring diverse perspectives through storytelling. I’ve read that you can live thousands of lives through reading—and I truly believe that!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? A trip to Banaras with my mom two years ago. The Ganga Aarti, blessings at Kashi Vishwanath, and a peaceful sunset boat ride made it unforgettable.
  • What would your last meal be? Anything that’s cooked by my Mom.
  • bb A quote that resonates with me – “Just keep swimming”- first came to me through a book, and I later discovered it’s from the movie Finding Nemo.
  • Desert Island Book: Hard to choose just one. I’m an avid reader and love reading fiction. If I had to pick, I’d say my recent favorite: A Good Girl’s Guide to Murder series.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be: A puzzle full of clues, questions, and “aha!” moments! I love digging into details, connecting the dots, and figuring things out one step at a time. It’s not about being the fastest, just about loving the mystery.

name: Sree Pillay
body_html:
Sree graduated from the University of Kerala with major in accounting and later earned a master’s in accounting as well. She went on to earn post-graduate diplomas in Public Relation and Journalism and later in computer applications. In 2000, Sree came to the United States and settled with her family in Oklahoma and started working as an Accountant with Hobby Lobby before accepting a position as a Payroll Specialist in the accounting department with the Oklahoma State Department. Sree and her family moved to Houston in 2015 where she served as an HR Manager with for a local IT firm. In 2019, she accepted a position as an accountant with a local public accounting firm and formally started working with Jain & Jain (now Prosperity Partners) in July 2023.

EXPERTISE: Accounting, Billing, Payroll

  • Favorite thing about my job: For me, work is a form of worship – of putting all of my energy and talent toward to serve our firm and help our clients. I find working hard to be truly fulfilling and purposeful.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby: I have a green thumb and is an avid gardener with a knack for growing various fruits, vegetables. I enjoy spending time with her husband, children, and grandchildren and am an active participant in her local Hindu temple.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I like to do yoga and meditation. I was playing basketball at my college life. I like to watch sports in TV.

name: Stephen Smith
body_html:
Steve Smith received a bachelor’s of science degree in accounting from California State University, Northridge.  Steve spent five years at a local CPA firm in Oxnard, California, before going into private sector as a Chief Financial Officer of a local business to help bring the company out of financial difficulty. Upon successfully fulfilling that commitment, Steve decided public accounting was his love and joined McGowan Guntermann in 2008, becoming a partner in 2017.  Steve works primarily in the areas of audit and review of not-for-profits and small businesses, small business accounting and consulting, and individual, partnership, not-for-profit, and corporate taxation and planning. Steve is a member of the California Society of Certified Public Accountants and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. Steve is currently on the Board of Directors and Treasurer of two non-profit organizations, the Miracle League of the 805 (ML805) and Camarillo Girls Softball Association (CGSA).  Steve volunteers as a coach at various organizations, including AYSO, ML805 and CGSA.

EXPERTISE: Attest Services, Not-For-Profit Accounting and Taxation, Partnership Taxation, Corporate Taxation, Management and Accounting Services

  • Favorite thing about my job: The PEOPLE! Not only do I get to work with great people, but my clients are great people as well.  I enjoy being able to work side by side with my clients and help them succeed in their businesses and in life.  The job can really be rewarding.
  • What is the best dish you can cook?  Love to B-B-Q but Chicken Kiev is my favorite and best dish.  I learned to cook from my mom and making dishes like that remind me of her, which is a wonderful thing.
  • Favorite movie quote: “When given the choice between being right or being kind, choose kind.”
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Tim McGraw and Faith Hill in Vegas.  It was a small theatre, less than 1,800 seats and it felt like we were right there with them.  The acoustic set was like we were sitting in their living room listening to them sing.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Coaching (Baseball, Softball, Soccer). I really enjoy helping players fall in love with the sport and watching them get better every week we are out there. Plus, I love being on the field with my kids and spending the extra time with them.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song?  “Lady in Red” by Chris De Burgh.  I only say this because I can’t sing and this is the only karaoke song I have ever sang.  I sang it to my wife when we were engaged when at a friend’s party.  The things we do for love.
  • What would your last meal be? Anything, as long as it is with my family as that is the best part of any meal.

name: Steve Mizrach
body_html:
At twenty-three years of age, Steven Mizrach was one of the youngest people in New York State to be made Partner. Steve was previously the Partner-In-Charge of the Iselin office of a regional accounting and consulting firm, before securing Partner at Dorfman Mizrach & Thaler, LLP (DMT). In December 2025, the Mizrach team joined forces with Prosperity Partners, where he has remained a Partner and leader of the Iselin team.

Steve has extensive experience in dealing with the business community in matters that include structuring transactions, financing, financial analysis, and “visionary thinking.” Steve has a broad background in Taxation and Accounting for companies in the technology, manufacturing, transportation, publishing, advertising, real estate, healthcare, and entertainment industries. A perfectionist and excellent negotiator, Steve’s forte lies in his unparalleled ability to deal with complex transactions that develop into life-altering events for the clients.

Steve is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, the New Jersey State Society of Certified Public Accountants, and the New Jersey Medical Group Management Association. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Brooklyn College as well as a Master’s degree in Taxation from Pace University. Steve is a licensed CPA in both New Jersey and New York. He has lectured extensively for many professional and trade organizations, and frequently appears on television and radio as a Financial Commentator.

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Making everyone smile.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: My trips to the Amalfi Coast
  • Favorite movie quote: “You got me hotter than Georgia Asphalt” – Wild at Heart (1990) or “Did I stutter?”
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I LOVE the Knicks!
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: U2
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Golf or Pickleball

name: Steven Ip
body_html:
Steven originally started at Farkouh, Furman & Faccio in 2014 as an intern and has spent his entire career in public accounting with FF&F before merging with Prosperity Partners in 2025. He currently serves as a Manager in Prosperity’s Tax Department. In this role, Steven handles all aspects of corporate tax work, including income tax provisions, projections, estimates, tax returns, due diligence, tax memos, and tax modeling. He works with clients in a variety of industries, including transportation, oil, and financial services. Steven has worked on clients of all sizes, from large, publicly-traded companies to small, closely-held corporations. Steven was drawn to the stability of the accounting profession and has developed a real passion for his work and his clients. An honest professional, he attributes his career success to his drive to learn as much as possible!

Currently, Steven lives in Brooklyn, which he loves for the opportunity to explore different cuisines. In his downtime, he likes to play video games and work out at the gym. Steven is also a DIY enthusiast and enjoys taking on home projects.

EXPERTISE: Corporate Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: I love how the tax landscape is always changing. We are constantly learning and helping our clients navigate through the changes.
  • Favorite movie quote: “With great power comes great responsibility”. The Spiderman movie with Tobey Maguire will always have a place in my heart.
  • What would your last meal be? I’ve always wanted to try pufferfish.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: It would be a relaxing day spending time with my wife and son while enjoying delicious food!
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My wife and I loved our trip to Japan and enjoyed experiencing the culture and food. We are always looking for opportunities to go back and explore more!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: My favorite workout would be bench press because everyday is chest day.

name: Susan Wilson
body_html:
Susan graduated from Kansas State University with both her undergraduate degree and her master’s in Accountancy – Tax Emphasis. She is a Certified Public Accountant. After beginning her career at Deloitte, Susan worked at a boutique firm in Kansas City which focused on high-net-worth tax. In 2023, Prosperity Partners acquired this firm and Susan joined Prosperity as a tax manager. During her spare time she enjoys spending time with her family, reading, and spending time outside.

EXPERTISE: Tax Planning for High-Net-Worth Individuals, Estate and Trust Planning, and Charitable Foundations.

  • Favorite thing about my job: The people at Prosperity Partners are amazing co-workers! Everyone is approachable, positive and very knowledgeable.
  • Favorite quote: “Be the change you wish to see in the world.” – Mahatma Gandhi
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is going out for a nice dinner with family and friends.
  • Favorite work outing: My favorite work outing was the first holiday party I attended. It was so fun to meet all my new colleagues in person. I left the event feeling so blessed that I get to work with such a caring and fun group!
  • What is the best dish you can cook? The best dish I can cook is homemade raviolis.

name: Sydney Hallums
body_html:
Sydney Hallums graduated from the University of South Florida in 2021 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting. She began her career with a tax-focused internship at a regional firm in Middle Tennessee where she was raised. Sydney always anticipated living in Florida, and she got the opportunity to take a full-time Tax Associate position in Melbourne, Florida in 2021. She was pleased to join Danaher, Attig, & Plante, PLC as a remote Tax Preparer in 2023, eventually becoming part of the Prosperity Partners team in 2025. She currently serves as a Tax Associate and is working towards her CPA certification.

In her free time, Sydney enjoys spending time with her friends and family either by the beach, pool, or at an amusement park. She is very grateful that working remotely allows her flexibility to spend time with her favorite guy – her corgi named Colin!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Trust, and Gift Tax Preparation

  • My favorite thing about my job: The best thing about my job is the amazing team of people I get to work with every day. I have found some of the most kind, caring, and inspirational mentors and friends during my time with this team. I look forward to working everyday knowing we are all in it together!
  • Desert Island Book: If I were stranded on a desert island, I would likely have a large selection of books until my kindle runs out of battery considering I take it everywhere! I am a big fan of romance and fantasy novels, and I feel like you need something with a lot of action and intrigue to keep rereading on a desert island, therefore I would choose Fourth Wing by Rebecca Yarros. The romance, political intrigue, and dragons are sure to keep you entertained for days.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? I have recently gotten into crochet as a hobby for myself. I often like to listen to audiobooks, but I prefer to have something to do with my hands. When I need to relax, I often pick up my crochet hook and make something. Currently, I am working on a blanket with different colored floral granny squares.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I am not always the best cook, but I have had to be creative and branch out because of my gluten sensitivity. My favorite meal that I make is a gluten free lasagna recipe that I found on a gluten free recipe blog! I also like to make it using my homemade meat sauce that I make in my instant pot.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: I was very fortunate to be able to get tickets to The Eras Tour by Taylor Swift. I am a huge Swiftie, and I have been from a very young age. I grew up right outside the Nashville area where she first rose to popularity. From her country music to her pop albums to her folk music I have loved it all, and it was such an incredible experience to see it all come together in one show.

name: Tanvi Bhanushali
body_html:
Tanvi Bhanushali graduated from Mumbai University with a Master’s degree in Accounting & Finance. Since 2017, she has worked in local CPA firms specializing in tax planning, preparing individual and business returns, and providing tax projections to help clients minimize their tax liability. Tanvi joined Prosperity Partners in August 2025, where she works on a team dedicated to preparing business and personal tax returns to ensure clients make the most of their financial opportunities. Outside of the office, Tanvi enjoys playing pickleball and gardening in her backyard when time permits!

EXPERTISE: Individual, Partnership, S-Corporation, C-Corporation, 990-Nonprofit organization, Trust and Tax planning

  • Favorite thing about my job: My favorite thing about my job is helping individuals and businesses make sense of their finances. I enjoy the challenge of interpreting tax laws and finding ways to save my clients money while ensuring they are in full compliance. There is a real sense of fulfillment when I know I have helped someone reduce their stress around taxes and made their financial situation more manageable.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was a trip to Cancun. The beaches were stunning, and I loved spending the days snorkeling, hiking, and just relaxing in the warm sun. The sunsets were unforgettable, and I came back feeling completely refreshed.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? My best dish is a hearty chicken pasta. I make everything from scratch—the flaky crust, creamy sauce, and grilled chicken! It is a crowd favorite in my house.
  • Favorite movie quote: “I am not a princess; I don’t need saving. I am a queen; I got this handled” – Frozen
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: My favorite performance was seeing Hasan Minhaj live. His mix of humor, personal stories, and social commentary made for an unforgettable night. The energy in the crowd was incredible, and I left laughing hard and feeling inspired.

name: Tejal Shah
body_html:
Tejal Shah graduated from Mumbai University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and Economics. She joined SurePrep India (Pvt) Ltd. in 2005 and began her career as a seasoned professional with a strong background in tax preparation. Over the years, she has developed expertise in leading the review of 1040 and 1041 returns using CCH Axcess, GoSystem, and UltraTax software for U.S. Individual, Federal, and State filings. She has led teams of more than five during both the busy and extension seasons for many years, and her dedication and performance quickly earned her a promotion to Senior Tax Reviewer. Tejal has also traveled to the United States to support onshore operations, where she prepared and reviewed complex 1040 and 1041 tax returns. In addition, she has strong expertise in OCR technology and has successfully implemented OCR solutions to streamline workflows, automate data entry, and significantly reduce manual errors. Her ability to learn quickly and her strong application-oriented attitude has consistently led to her success as a tax professional.

Expertise: Individual Tax Returns

  • Favorite thing about my job: I take pride in using my skills to create thoughtful tax solutions that ease my clients’ liabilities. Making a real difference by simplifying complex tax issues and contributing to their financial growth is what motivates me.
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: My favorite way to celebrate my birthday is by enjoying the love and generosity of friends and family through gifts and spending time together.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: One of my most memorable vacations was a week spent with my husband in Goa, India. The beautiful beaches, vibrant culture, and laid-back coastal vibe made the trip truly unforgettable.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? Carrom
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I enjoy staying active by playing badminton and participating in running games.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Almost all Indian dishes – I enjoy experimenting and trying new flavors in the kitchen!

name: Thomas Ulrich
body_html:
Thomas Ulrich graduated from William and Mary College with a Major in Finance and a concentration in Innovation & Entrepreneurship. Thomas began his career at Pipaya (now Prosperity) as an intern in the summer of 2022 and is now an M&A Associate in the Vienna office. In his spare time, Thomas enjoys golf, travel, and trying new restaurants!

EXPERTISE: Sell-side M&A, Financial Forecasting

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Analyzing a variety of different companies and meeting industry executives on diligence calls
  • Favorite Vacation You’ve Taken: My college graduation trip to Europe with stops in Barcelona, Ibiza, Amsterdam, and Berlin!
  • Favorite work outing you’ve been on: Pipaya’s offsite ski trip in Breckenridge, Colorado
  • What would your last meal be? Korean BBQ
  • Favorite Workout or Sport to Play: Outdoor pick-up basketball

name: Travis Neese
body_html:
Travis Neese graduated from Millikin University with a double major in Theatre and Human Services, with minors in Psychology and Sociology. Shortly after graduating, Travis moved to the Windy City to continue his journey as a theatre artist while also working in Early Childhood Education. He went on to pursue his master’s degree in Guidance and Counseling from The University of West Alabama. He made the transition out of education in the summer of 2023, beginning his journey at Prosperity Partners as an Office Manager. He is still heavily active in the theatre and film communities in Chicago not only as an actor, but as a writer and director as well. In his spare time, he enjoys walking his dogs with his partner, exploring new restaurants, and attending as much theatre as possible.

EXPERTISE: Administration, Harry Potter Trivia

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The culture! From my first day, everyone was so warm and welcoming and made me fit right in.
  • Desert island book: “Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone”
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I make a mean spicy Italian sausage pasta bake
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: I took a weeklong solo trip to Iceland for my birthday a few years back and got to celebrate my birthday under the Northern Lights. 10/10 would recommend!
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Writing and producing original content, specifically with a queer voice and lens.
  • If you were a board game, what game would you be? For sake of the questionnaire, let’s consider Dungeons and Dragons a board game.
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? “So Yesterday” by Hilary Duff
  • Favorite way to celebrate your birthday: I always have a “come and go” policy with my birthday and usually find a favorite bar and hang out for a few hours and let people stop by, have a drink, and go about the rest of their evening.
  • I have an irrational fear of: Mascots. And birds. ESPECIALLY bird mascots.
  • Favorite concert you’ve attended: Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour
  • Favorite workout or spot to play? I like to do “fun-runs”, like RunDisney, Color Run, etc – basically the lowest of stakes where I can jog with friends and get a shiny medal, with no worry about time or speed and I’m game.

name: Tristan Smith
body_html:
Tristan Smith graduated from George Washington University with a double major in Finance and Economics. As an M&A Transaction Advisory Analyst, he applies his education and continued desire to learn to help clients throughout the M&A process. After interning in the summer of 2024, he joined the firm full-time in 2025. In his spare time, Tristan enjoys exercising, exploring Washington DC, and learning about financial markets.

EXPERTISE: Financial Analysis

  • Favorite thing about my job: Learning every day from my colleagues and our clients
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Investing and learning about financial markets
  • What is your go-to karaoke song? Piano Man by Billy Joel
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Baked Mac and Cheese
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Tennis and Basketball

name: Tyler McIntyre
body_html:
Tyler McIntyre graduated from Arizona State University with a B.S. in Accounting in December of 2010. Post graduation, Tyler spent five years as an associate at a Regional Accounting Firm in central Iowa. There, he gained valuable experience preparing financial statements, performing bookkeeping, and preparing tax returns for individuals and businesses. Outside of accounting, Tyler has held a wide variety of jobs…from teaching English in Japan, to working on a tourist boat in the Caribbean, to building rainforest trails in a tree house village in the jungles of Costa Rica! Tyler has since been domesticated and enjoys exercising, mowing the lawn, and bathtime with his new infant daughter.

EXPERTISE: Small business bookkeeping and simple tax return preparation

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: As cliché as it sounds, what drew me to this company is the people. I have felt welcomed and supported from day one. As a fully remote employee, I was initially concerned with feeling disconnected from my coworkers. However, I have found intercompany communication to be top notch and find myself working with kind, helpful, and knowledgeable folks daily.
  • Desert Island Book: “Man’s Search for Meaning” by Viktor Frankl
  • What is your passion? As odd as it may sound being a cornfed Iowa farm boy, I found surfing at 20 years old, and it has captured my heart and soul!
  • Favorite Concert you’ve attended: Dave Matthews Band at Red Rocks Amphitheater in Morrison, Colorado. An incredible natural setting that allows for worldclass acoustics.
  • Last meal: Anything my wife cooks. Being born and raised in Japan, my wife Haruka often makes our kitchen smell like we never left her hometown.
  • Favorite Workout: With a little one in the house, it is harder to get to the gym as often as I would like. When I do, you will find me under the barbell doing squats, bench press, and dead lifts.

name: Vaibhav Parmar
body_html:
Vaibhav is a Tax professional with a strong academic foundation, holding both a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance from Mumbai University.
