He has over five years of hands-on experience in the preparation and review of U.S. Individual (1040) and Fiduciary (1041) tax returns and is proficient in multiple tax software platforms, including SP Binder, CCH, ProSystem fx, Go System, UltraTax, and Lacerte. Vaibhav has gained knowledge of business tax returns, including 1065 (Partnerships), 1120S (S Corporations), and 1120 (C Corporations), and has experience supporting a wide range of clients including high-net-worth individuals and trusts.

He began his taxation career in 2021, focusing on Individual tax compliance and strategic tax planning. Vaibhav started his professional journey with Datamatics, where he worked for two years before joining SurePrep. At SurePrep, he spent four years as a Senior Tax Analyst, honing his expertise in tax preparation through innovative, technology-driven processes. He joined Prosperity in January 2026 and currently supports the VGSL team, delivering Individual and Trust tax services while actively seeking opportunities to expand his experience with Partnership and S-Corporation tax returns.

Expertise: Project Management, Teamwork, Time Management, Leadership, Effective Communication, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving

  • Favorite thing about my job: I enjoy working with my team and appreciate the positive, supportive environment. The ongoing encouragement makes each day rewarding.
  • Favorite movie quote: “Kaabil bano, kamyabi jhak maarke peeche aayegi.” – from the movie 3 Idiots. Translated means “Focus on being capable, and success will follow.”
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: My favorite vacation was a trip to Goa, where I enjoyed the beaches, local food, and a relaxing break from daily routine.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Cricket, Market Trading, and Badminton!
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: Cricket
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Pani Puri.

name: Varad Salvi
body_html:
Varad Salvi holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and Finance from Mumbai University. He launched his career in 2018 with SurePrep, a part of Thomson Reuters, where he developed a strong foundation in tax operations, data validation, and team coordination. During his tenure, he not only ensured the accuracy of critical financial documents, but also took the lead in supervising contractors and conducting comprehensive training on process workflows. Varad’s role expanded into tech support, where he excelled in client communication across chat, phone, and email channels. He successfully led a team of 18 support agents, guiding them in resolving complex client queries while maintaining high service standards. His initiative in designing training modules significantly improved the onboarding experience for new clients. Additionally, as a key member of the UltraTax Tech Support team, he provided expert assistance to clients on tax software issues related to 1065s and 1120s. His consistent performance and leadership earned him the “Employee of the Month” recognition three times.

In February 2025, Varad brought his experience and versatility to Prosperity Partners as a Tax Preparer. He specializes in preparing tax returns and actively supports colleagues in resolving technical issues. His dual expertise in tax and technology continues to add value by enhancing efficiency and promoting team collaboration.

Expertise: Individual Tax Returns, Tech Support, Team Management

  • Favorite thing about my job: Gaining exposure to a variety of documents and embracing new opportunities each day.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Bike riding and trekking
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken? My trip to Pondicherry—a perfect blend of serene beaches, charming French architecture, and soulful cafes that made every moment unforgettable!
  • What would your last meal be? Traditional Maharashtrian cuisine – especially a plate of warm, sweet Modaks that reminds me of home.
  • Favorite sport to play: Soccer (or football as we call it!)

name: Vikesh Bansal
body_html:
Vikesh graduated from George Mason University in Fairfax, Virginia, with a major in Business, focusing on Accounting and Tax. After graduation, he began his career at Wiener and Garg CPAs, eventually becoming a Partner in 1995 and has maintained his Partner status during the transition to Prosperity! Vik focuses his practice on high-net-worth entrepreneurs and public company CEOs, as well as startup companies. One of his crowning achievements is passing all four parts of his CPA exam in his first attempt!

EXPERTISE: Tax planning, personal finance, asset backed loans, estate and gift planning

  • Favorite Thing About My Job: Working with the unique personalities of entrepreneurs! I am constantly fascinated and amazed with how entrepreneurs think and navigate their unique paths to success. It is the most rewarding aspect of my job.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? I love to grill and do a pretty good job with spicy burgers and lamb chops.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: 12 days in Croatia from Zagreb to Dubrovnik – don’t forget to make stops in Split, Hvar, and Plitvice Lakes on your way from Zagreb to Dubrovnik!
  • What would your last meal be? French Dip from 4 Charles in New York City
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Golf

name: Vinit Gala
body_html:
Vinit Gala is an Accounting and Finance professional with nine years of experience in managing comprehensive financial operations. His expertise includes the preparation of sales reports, MIS reports, and accounts receivable aging reports, enabling accurate financial insights and informed decision-making. He has hands-on experience in credit card accounting, including posting expenses, reconciling credit card accounts, and maintaining accuracy within accounting systems. In his previous role, he collaborated closely with sales teams and clients, providing timely and clear resolutions to accounting and billing queries to ensure smooth business operations. Vinit’s technical proficiency includes Advanced Excel, QuickBooks (Online and Desktop), and TASBooks. He has also managed key accounting functions such as preparing depreciation and prepaid expense schedules, generating usage reports, handling contract processing, and executing overage billing. With strong learning agility and a commitment to continuous skill development, Vinit has built a broad and adaptable understanding of diverse accounting processes, tools, and systems.

  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A memorable trip to Kashmir in 2024 with my wife – breathtaking landscapes, serene rivers and valleys, and our first snowfall experience! We also enjoyed skiing and a classic Shikara boat ride, making the trip truly unforgettable.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Traveling and capturing scenic landscapes on my cellphone camera.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: I like playing football (soccer) and I usually indulge in playing it on weekends.
  • I have an irrational fear of: heights and depth.
  • What would your last meal be? Any Indian dish, especially when prepared by my mom or my wife.

name: Walter M. McGrail
body_html:
Walt directs the tax planning and reporting practice for Prosperity’s Bloomfield Hills, MI office. Throughout his 40-year career, Walt has developed, implemented, and reported a variety of tax efficient strategies for family-owned and publicly held LLCs, partnerships, and corporations, as well as high-net-worth individuals and their estates. Walt is a member of the State Bar of Michigan and the Michigan Association of Certified Public Accountants.

Walt began his career with the Detroit office of Arthur Andersen and moved to Cendrowski Corporate Advisors where he practiced for four decades until joining Prosperity.

While working at Arthur Andersen, Walt completed his juris doctorate degree from the School of Law at the University of Detroit Mercy. Walt met his spouse of 40 years Susan while obtaining his bachelor’s in business administration from the University of Michigan – Dearborn School of Business.

Along with his spouse Susan, he has raised four children and welcomed five grandchildren into the family.

Walt has spent several years on the pitch as a parent and coach for both recreational and select youth soccer programs.

EXPERTISE: Succession planning including UPREIT and ESOP structures; Choice of Entity considerations with an emphasis in planning, structuring, and reporting for partnerships; and practice in the Real Estate space including, development, residential, multifamily, office, commercial, and hospitality uses.

  • Favorite Thing about my Job: People. Regardless of our specific role or function, we are ALL in the communication business.
  • Best prepared dish:  I get requests to prepare one of three dishes for get togethers, either: lobster tails, rack of lamb, or bone-in prime rib, but my favorite is a brunch / breakfast BELT sandwich.
  • Gig / passion project / hobby: In addition to youth soccer, I enjoy camping and homebrewing. Susan and I have included our entire family in camping adventures from infancy to adulthood. The highlight of homebrewing had to be constructing my first “keezer” to serve our Creamsicle lager and Brown ale at my oldest son’s wedding reception.
  • Favorite Concert: Definitely “Old School,” Santana, Lynard Skynyrd, and Peter Frampton at Rynearson Stadium in the day. I met my future spouse at the concert although as we laughed about it a couple of years later, it was more of a confrontation.

name: Ying Chun Yee
body_html:
Tony graduated from Bernard M. Baruch College with a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance and Investment and a Minor in Accounting. He started his career serving various private entities (banking, restaurants, printing production services, real estate entities, and financial institutions) for twenty-six years as an Accountant and Controller. Afterwards, Tony worked as a Senior Accountant for Guggenheim Partners, a private family office and wealth management company, for six years. Most recently, he has worked within public accounting firms for the last twelve years. Throughout his accounting career, he has been exposed to various areas of accounting, including financial reporting, business taxation, and government/regulatory agency compliance.

EXPERTISE: Corporate and Trust Financial Reporting, Business Taxation

  • Favorite thing about my job: Helping others meet their needs to the best of my knowledge and abilities while enhancing my personal and professional growth.
  • What is the best dish you can cook? Stir-fry Flat Noodles with Marinaded Sliced Beef and Bean Sprouts. It is a traditional Chinese dish that is often enjoyed at the end of a Dim Sum meal.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play: A game of Ping Pong! It helps me to practice speed and precision while providing a great full body workout.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: A few personal highlights are Yellowstone National Park and Banff National Park (Beautiful scenery and great outdoor experience), Portugal and Spain (Amazing food and rich European culture), Rome (Marveling at Great Corinthian structural landmarks and enjoying the world’s best pizza) and Beijing, China (Climbing the greatest wall in the world)!

name: Zach Lillig
body_html:
I was born and raised in the north suburbs of Chicago. I graduated from Carthage College in Kenosha, WI with a double major in Accounting and Finance. While at Carthage, I was a 4-year member of the nationally ranked Men’s Volleyball team where I was a 2x All-American Middle blocker. I began my career at Prosperity Partners in January of 2020 right before the pandemic as a Tax Associate and have slowly shifted to the accounting side while retaining some tax work. Prosperity Partners has allowed me the opportunity to stay remote and I currently live in Nashville, Tennessee enjoying the sun.

EXPERTISE: GAAP; Financial statement preparation; Individual, Partnership, and Corporate Tax

  • Favorite thing about Prosperity Partners: The company culture, our outings are always a blast. You wouldn’t guess it but, accountants can have a good time.
  • Favorite vacation you’ve taken: Going hiking in Sedona and the Grand Canyon. The Midwest is pretty flat so seeing the Grand Canyon and the red rocks of Sedona was an incredible experience.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Video Games, I enjoy a variety of PC games including old school Runescape, Hogwarts Legacy, and Valorant
  • Favorite movie quote: Monty Python and the Holy Grail: “She turned me into a newt! ……. It got better…”
  • I have an irrational fear of: Small spaces. I’m a bit too tall for narrow caves or small basements.
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Volleyball, although the prime of my career may be over, I try to keep up by playing in local leagues and tournaments where possible.

name: Zhishan Yao
body_html:
Zhishan Yao is a Certified Public Accountant with a Master of Science in Accounting from American University. She passed all four sections of the CPA exams on her first try and scored three sections over ninety!  Zhishan joined Prosperity Partners in January 2022, and since then, has been applying her solid tax law knowledge to provide accurate and efficient tax services for our clients. Before joining Prosperity Partners, Zhishan worked as an Office Manager at Lockheed Martin’s Beijing Representative Office. In her spare time, Zhishan loves cooking, working out, volunteering, and spending time with her family.

EXPERTISE Individual, Partnership, S-Corporation, Trust, and Tax-exempt Entity

  • What is the best dish you can cook? Salmon & leek dumplings from scratch. They are super delicious, nutritious, and healthy.
  • Favorite Vacation you’ve taken: Alaska – unmatched blend of natural beauty and untamed adventure.
  • What is your side gig/passion project/hobby? Cooking! I make fresh meals every day.
  • What would the title of your autobiography be? Relentless Pursuit: Turning Ambition into Action
  • Favorite workout or sport to play? Biking, hiking, or outdoor swimming
